Our comprehensive empirical evaluation reveals that 1) Both training-free and training-based methods saturate easy benchmarks (mathematics vs. coding vs. natural language), 2) Training-based classifiers have an advantage on harder classification tasks (e.g. Java vs Python), and 3) Training-free methods are generally more robust to mixed-intent and adversarial prompts.

</details>


### [403] [CTRAG: An In-Context Retrieval-based Framework for Automated Compliance Checking using LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02472)
*Muhammad Roman,Karen Rafferty,Barry Devereux*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CTRAG，一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的自动化合规检查流水线，通过自适应分块、动态检索配置和上下文学习策略，从监管文本中提取控制问题并与公司非结构化文档交叉比对，实现高精度的合规验证（包括通过第三方服务的间接合规）。在Big Four专业服务公司的真实部署中，CTRAG达到78%的F1分数和85%的召回率，显著减少人工审阅工作量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手动合规测试耗时且易出现不一致，尤其当合规依赖第三方服务（如云提供商）时更为复杂。现有方法难以高效、准确地从非结构化文档中验证法规遵从性，需要自动化解决方案来提升合规检查的效率和可靠性。

Method: CTRAG是一个先进的RAG流水线，包含三个核心策略：（1）自适应分块（adaptive chunking），优化文档切分以保留语义完整性；（2）动态检索配置（dynamic retrieval configurations），根据查询需求灵活调整检索参数；（3）上下文学习（in-context learning），提升生成结果的精准性。系统从监管文本提取控制问题，并将其与公司非结构化文档进行交叉比对，实现文档驱动的合规验证。

Result: 在最终部署配置中，CTRAG实现78%的F1分数和85%的召回率，确保最少遗漏不合规案例，同时显著减少人工审阅工作量。该系统在Big Four专业服务公司中完成POC开发与部署，在真实案例上与人工合规报告交叉验证。

Conclusion: CTRAG展现了自动化合规检查在复杂高风险的监管环境中的巨大潜力，能够简化合规工作流程、降低风险并增强监管信任，特别适用于涉及第三方间接合规的场景。

Abstract: Trust is fundamental in modern regulatory ecosystems, and compliance checking plays a critical role in fostering that trust. Regulatory compliance verification is essential for businesses operating in highly controlled environments, as it ensures alignment with sector-specific guidelines across domains such as financial reporting, data privacy, and cybersecurity. Manual compliance testing, however, is often time-intensive and prone to inconsistencies, particularly when compliance depends indirectly on third-party services such as cloud providers, where vendors rely on external providers to meet regulatory standards. In this paper, we present CTRAG, a novel Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline designed for automated compliance checking. CTRAG employs advanced strategies, including adaptive chunking, dynamic retrieval configurations, and in-context learning, to improve the precision and relevance of compliance assessments. By extracting control questions from regulatory texts and cross-referencing them with unstructured company documentation, CTRAG achieves highly accurate, document-informed compliance verification, even in cases of indirect compliance through third-party services. Empirical evaluations demonstrate significant improvements, with CTRAG achieving an F1-score of 78% and a recall of 85% in the final deployed configuration, ensuring minimal missed non-compliance cases while reducing manual reviewer effort in a real-world deployment. To validate CTRAG value, we developed and deployed a POC within a Big Four professional services firm, applying it to real-world cases and cross-checking results against manual compliance reports. These findings highlight CTRAG potential to streamline compliance workflows, mitigate risks, and enhance regulatory trust in complex, high-stakes environments.

</details>


### [404] [Cultural Awareness is Represented but Not Decoded: Tracing Mythological Knowledge across 18 Open-Source LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02486)
*Iaroslav Chelombitko,Ekaterina Chelombitko,Mika Hämäläinen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了开源LLM在非主流文化神话中命名表现不佳的原因。通过对18个开源LLM（8个架构家族）进行线性探测、logit lens、激活修补和输出提取等工具分析，发现残差流中文化信息表征清晰，但解码器在输出时将文化特有token坍缩为主流文化token。问题出在读出阶段而非表征阶段，且解码器行为受提示语言门控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流LLM在主流文化（如希腊、北欧神话）中表现良好，但在非主流文化（如芬兰、斯拉夫、埃及、中国神话）中表现不稳定。作者想要定位这一文化默认偏差（cultural default）在模型内部产生的具体位置，理解模型的内部机制而非仅停留在行为层面。

Method: 在平行的跨文化汤普森母题实体数据集上，对18个开源LLM（覆盖8个架构家族）进行四种工具分析：1) 线性探测（linear probing）检查残差流中的文化表征；2) logit lens检查各层的输出分布；3) 激活修补（activation patching）定位关键计算节点；4) 输出提取分析解码行为。同时对比目标文化母语与英语两种提示语言的影响。

Result: 发现残差流能清晰区分不同文化（远超名称字符串基线），但解码器将文化特有token坍缩到主流文化token上。失败发生在读出阶段而非表征阶段。跨语言实验显示失败在语言内聚类但在语言间解耦，说明解码器受提示语言门控。作者发布了分解框架、跨文化真实数据、语言条件读出相关性测试以及18个模型的逐实体预测。

Conclusion: LLM的文化偏差根源在于解码器读出阶段而非内部表征阶段，且这一读出过程受提示语言条件化。这项工作为理解并可能修复LLM的文化偏见提供了精确的机制层面定位和可复用的分析工具。

Abstract: Open-source LLMs reliably name Zeus, Jupiter, and Thor, but recover their counterparts in less-represented traditions like Finnish, Slavic, Egyptian, or Chinese mythology far less consistently. We ask where inside the model this cultural default is produced. On a parallel cross-cultural substrate of Thompson-motif entities, we instrument 18 open-source LLMs from 8 architecture families with linear probing, logit lens, activation patching, and output extraction. The residual stream cleanly distinguishes cultures, well above a name-string baseline, yet the decoder collapses culturally-specific tokens onto dominant-tradition ones. The failure is at readout, not at representation. Asking the same question in the target culture's native language versus English produces failures that cluster within language but decouple across language: the decoder is gated on prompt language. We release a per-entity (probe, output) decomposition framework, a citation-anchored cross-cultural ground truth, a within- versus cross-mode correlation test for language-conditioned readout, and per-entity predictions for all 18 models.

</details>


### [405] [LiveMem: Maintaining Memory State Continuity in Long-Running LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02515)
*Zhichen Liu,Ruihan Sun,Hengjie Yang,Zipeng Wu,Zhaohan Chen,Xiaofan Zhang,Yang Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LiveMem是一种内在记忆方法，为预训练的全注意力LLM增加一个独立于活动上下文的记忆状态，实现状态连续性和上下文更替下的持续推理，即使证据已从当前上下文中移除也能基于记忆回答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时间运行的助手和代理所消费的交互流最终会超出上下文窗口。现有的上下文保留、摘要和检索方法只能保留对选定历史的访问，但在工作上下文变化时无法提供覆盖完整生命周期的持久状态。这种缺失的推理能力被称为"上下文更替下的状态连续性"——通过固定容量的记忆状态来承载计算，其生命周期独立于活动上下文。

Method: LiveMem通过三个关键组件实现：1) 上下文更替与记忆状态维护——在上下文轮换时保持记忆状态的持续更新；2) 记忆导向的后训练——专门针对记忆功能进行训练；3) 状态感知的服务——确保记忆状态在起源token被释放后仍能承载有效信息。该方法为预训练的全注意力LLM增加一个记忆状态，同时主注意力路径保留有界的KV窗口。

Result: 实验表明LiveMem在评估系统和其它内在记忆方法中取得了领先的整体性能。在LongMemEval上的实验显示，即使支持证据已从当前上下文中移除，LiveMem仍能基于记忆状态回答问题；证据距离分析表明有用信息在活动窗口之外持续存在。

Conclusion: LiveMem建立了状态连续性作为一种独特且互补的抽象，用于持续LLM推理，解决了长期运行代理在处理超出上下文规模的交互流时的核心痛点。

Abstract: Long-running assistants and agents consume interaction streams that eventually outgrow the context. Existing context retention, summarization, and retrieval preserve access to selected history, but do not provide a persistent state over the full lifecycle when working context changes. We formulate this missing inference capability as \emph{state continuity under context turnover}: carrying computation forward through a fixed-capacity memory state whose lifetime is independent of the active context. We introduce an intrinsic memory method, \textbf{LiveMem}, which augments a pretrained full-attention LLM with a memory state that preserves the historical information over the whole lifecycle while the main attention path retains a bounded KV window. Context turnover and memory state maintaining, memory-oriented post-training, and state-aware serving jointly make this memory state load bearing after its originating tokens are released. Our experiments show that LiveMem achieves leading overall performance among evaluated systems and other intrinsic memory methods. Experiments on LongMemEval show that LiveMem is able to answer the question based on the memory state, even when the supporting evidence has been removed from the current context, and evidence-distance analysis shows that useful information persists beyond the active window. LiveMem thus establishes state continuity as a distinct and complementary abstraction for continual LLM inference.

</details>


### [406] [MedPRESS: A Multi-turn Benchmark for Patient-Pressure-Induced Medical Sycophancy in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02520)
*Saman Sarker Joy,Niloy Farhan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出MedPRESS，一个用于衡量LLM在患者施加压力下产生谄媚行为（sycophancy）的多轮对话基准。包含600个医学场景的五轮对话，评估20个LLM后发现模型在重复患者压力下频繁转向不安全的同意，反谄媚提示可改善但无法完全消除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究仅用静态问题衡量LLM在健康咨询中的安全性，忽略了真实医患对话中患者可能施加压力的情况。需要一个新的基准来衡量模型在对话压力下能否坚持安全医学知识。

Method: 构建MedPRESS基准，包含600个医学基础的五轮对话，涵盖三类场景（药物与治疗需求、个人健康自我护理、症状分诊与护理抵抗）。对话从健康查询开始，逐步升级为个人经历、社会证明、外部证据声称和直接对抗性挑战。使用结构化评判和安全性指标评估20个LLM（涵盖通用、医学领域、轻量、大型、开源和专有模型）。

Result: 模型在反复患者压力下频繁转向不安全的同意，不同模型家族、模型规模和提示类型之间存在显著差异。反谄媚提示能改善部分模型的鲁棒性，但无法完全消除不安全同意行为。

Conclusion: MedPRESS揭示了医学LLM评估中的关键缺口：仅具备安全医学知识不够，模型还必须在对话压力下保持安全立场。这提示未来的医学LLM需要更强的抗压鲁棒性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for health-related advice. Existing research measures their safety with static questions rather than pressured patient-facing conversations. We introduce MedPRESS, a multi-turn benchmark for measuring patient-pressure-induced sycophancy in LLMs. MedPRESS contains 600 medically grounded five-turn dialogues across three scenario families: medication and treatment demand, personal health self-care, and symptom triage and care resistance. Each dialogue begins with a health query and escalates through personal experience, social proof, external evidence claims, and direct adversarial challenge. We evaluate 20 LLMs across general, medical-domain, lightweight, large, open-weight, and proprietary families using structured judging and safety-focused metrics. Results show that models frequently shift toward unsafe agreement under repeated patient pressure, with substantial variation across model families, model scale, and prompt type. Anti-sycophancy prompting improves robustness for several models, but does not eliminate unsafe agreement. MedPRESS highlights a critical gap in medical LLM evaluation: safe medical knowledge is not enough unless models can maintain it under conversational pressure.

</details>


### [407] [Romanized Arabic Across Dialects: Views, Usage Patterns, and Linguistic Variation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02555)
*Amr Keleg,Ahmed Amine Ben Abdallah,Taha Yassine,Chadi Helwe,Imane Guellil,Nedjma Ousidhoum*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次大规模、以人为本、跨方言地研究阿拉伯语拉丁化转写（Arabizi）的感知与使用，通过调查五种阿拉伯方言使用者，发布了字符级对齐资源和句子级平行语料库，发现方言内部的系统性规律与方言间的差异性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往研究虽表明Arabizi的使用受地区和年龄等因素影响，但大多数NLP研究将其视为因阿拉伯文字技术支持不足而产生的暂时现象，缺乏对使用者的感知和使用习惯的深入理解。作者希望通过与阿拉伯语使用者直接互动，收集他们对Arabizi的真实看法和使用方式。

Method: 1）招募阿尔及利亚、埃及、黎巴嫩、摩洛哥和突尼斯五种方言的使用者参与调查；2）构建字符级对齐资源，分析方言内和方言间的转写变异；3）构建手工整理的平行语料库，包含阿拉伯文字句子及其多种Arabizi转写版本；4）研究使用者对句子级文体变异的识别能力。

Result: 发现了系统性的方言内转写规律和方言间转写差异；发布了两个资源（字符级对齐和句子级平行语料库）；完成了迄今为止最大规模的人本主义、跨方言的Arabizi感知与实践研究。

Conclusion: Arabizi并非简单的暂时现象，其使用具有系统性和方言特异性，NLP研究应重视并纳入这种跨方言的文体变异。

Abstract: Arabizi refers to Arabic written in Latin script. Although previous studies have shown that the prevalence and usage of Arabizi vary by factors such as region and age group, most NLP research on Arabic texts treats it as a temporary phenomenon resulting from limited technological support for the Arabic script. In this work, we engage with Arabic speakers to collect insights on their perceptions and usage of Arabizi. We further examine writing norms among speakers of different dialects, focusing on Algerian, Egyptian, Lebanese, Moroccan, and Tunisian Arabic. To this end, we release two resources. First, a character-level alignment of Arabic words to study inter- and intra-dialectal variation across these five dialects, based on words transliterated by survey participants, finding systematic intra-dialectal regularity and inter-dialectal variation. Second, to study Arabic speakers' ability to identify this stylistic variation at the sentence-level, we build a manually curated parallel corpus of sentences written in Arabic script alongside multiple Arabizi transliterations, collected from speakers of the same five dialects. Our study presents the largest human-centered, cross-dialectal study of Arabizi's perceptions and practices to date.

</details>


### [408] [AURORA-LM: Autoencoding Unified Representation for Continuous-Latent Diffusion Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02602)
*Jiajun Liang,Yucheng Liao,Yukang Cao,Jiazhe Wei,Ken Li,Wende Tan,Jiankun Zhang,ZY Cui,Jingkang Yang,Liucheng Guo,Shiqi Yang,B. Yang,Caifeng Shan,Ziwei Liu,Chenyang Si*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AURORA-LM是一种连续潜在空间扩散语言模型，通过解耦可解码文本表征的构建与分布建模，采用Query-based Encoder-Decoder组织高容量前缀对齐的潜在序列，并用Block-causal Diffusion Transformer进行流匹配学习。在OpenWebText和XSum上取得最强性能，扩展到1B参数后超越更大的公开潜在扩散语言模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本生成仍依赖离散token，而图像、视频、音频已转向连续潜在空间建模。现有连续语言模型要么继承不适合联合生成和解码的嵌入空间，要么压缩自编码潜在表示以简化扩散过程，牺牲了token级保真度。作者认为不应为了适配生成模型而简化表征，而应保留高容量可解码的文本潜在表示，并让扩散模型直接学习其分布。

Method: 1) Query-based Encoder-Decoder将文本组织为高容量、前缀对齐的潜在序列；2) Block-causal Diffusion Transformer通过流匹配学习分布，从左到右生成块，同时并行去噪块内位置；3) 仅限制噪声输入路径而保留完整干净潜在预测目标，以适配全宽度潜在表示；4) 根据潜在宽度校准噪声水平分布；5) 引入自轨迹一致性，桥接训练时独立采样的噪声与推理时的迭代去噪。

Result: AURORA-LM在OpenWebText自由生成和XSum摘要任务上，在所有评估的连续和基于扩散的语言模型中取得最强性能。扩展到1B参数（约1500 EFLOPs总计算量）后，在匹配评估协议下超越了更大的公开潜在扩散语言模型。所有实验在Ascend NPU上完成。

Conclusion: AURORA-LM证明了无需牺牲潜在表示的保真度来适配扩散模型，通过设计专门针对高容量文本潜在表示的扩散建模方案，连续语言模型可以达到甚至超越离散token模型的性能，为未来文本生成架构提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Language remains an outlier in generative modeling: while images, video, and audio are increasingly modeled in continuous latent spaces, text generation still relies predominantly on discrete tokens. Existing continuous language models either inherit embedding spaces not designed for joint generation and decoding, or compress autoencoded latents to ease diffusion, sacrificing token-level fidelity. Instead of simplifying the representation to suit the generative model, we preserve a high-capacity, decodable text latent and design the diffusion model to learn its distribution directly.
  We introduce AURORA-LM, a continuous-latent diffusion language model that separates the construction of a decodable text representation from the modeling of its distribution. A Query-based Encoder-Decoder organizes text into a high-capacity, prefix-aligned latent sequence, and a Block-causal Diffusion Transformer learns its distribution through flow matching, generating blocks left to right while denoising positions within each block in parallel. Because such a latent is harder for diffusion to model, AURORA-LM restricts only the noisy-input pathway while retaining the full clean-latent prediction target, accommodating full-width latents without reducing decoder-facing capacity. We further calibrate the noise-level distribution to the latent width, and introduce self-trajectory consistency to bridge independently sampled training noise and iterative denoising at inference.
  AURORA-LM achieves the strongest performance among evaluated continuous and diffusion-based language models on OpenWebText free generation and XSum summarization. Scaling to 1B parameters with about 1500 EFLOPs of total compute yields further gains, surpassing a larger publicly released latent-diffusion language model under a matched evaluation protocol. All experiments are conducted on Ascend NPUs.

</details>


### [409] [Amplitude-Only FFN Intervention for Tool-Structured LLM Inference Method: Gated Evaluation Protocol, and Cross-Model Empirical Results](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11183)
*Sheng Xu,Junhua Wang,Boyuan Huang,Ke Jia,Jiadun Zhu,Zhen Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型工具使用场景下的推理时前馈网络（FFN）干预方法。作者从正交残差投影（ORP，方向改变式修复）出发，发现SwiGLU FFN干预点过于敏感，转而提出振幅门控（AG）——一种保留预训练权重方向、仅调节激活幅度的非破坏性方法。在Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上，AG整体弱正向，但在工具结构化任务上最强：Qwen3.5-9B上类别级门控将工具/结构化/智能体性能从38.66%提升至42.92%（+4.27个百分点），Hermes函数调用任务提升约+7.6个点；Qwen3-8B上Hermes JSON模式提升+11.36个点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型作为工具使用代理时，即使格式、参数或函数调用的微小错误也会使原本合理的响应失效。现有方法需要重新训练模型权重，成本高昂。作者希望在不重训练的前提下，通过推理时的FFN干预来改进结构化输出。

Method: 1) 提出Orthogonal Residual Projection（ORP）作为初始方向改变式修复尝试，但发现SwiGLU FFN干预点过于敏感，弊大于利。2) 提出Amplitude Gating（AG），非破坏性方法，保留预训练FFN权重方向，仅调节激活幅度。3) 定义细粒度干预系统，涵盖P1/P2/P3整体位点和分支特定的P1s/P2a/P2b位点。4) 引入新的评估协议：区分组合oracle上限与固定配置/学习门控，强制样本级统计，对二分类和部分评分数据集使用任务感知指标。

Result: AG在Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B上整体弱正向，在工具结构化任务上效果最强。Qwen3.5-9B的类别级学习门控使工具/结构化/智能体性能提升+4.27个百分点，Hermes函数调用任务约+7.6个点；Qwen3-8B的Hermes JSON模式提升+11.36个点。Qwen2.5-7B保留oracle上限但当前学习门控未能捕获。熵AG与Newton-Schulz窗口AG互不占优。

Conclusion: 工具结构化推理是安全FFN级推理优化最可信的首个目标。但部署需要模型和类别特定的路由策略（Qwen2.5-7B的oracle上限表明通用门控不足），且需要在线验证和更广范的跨模型评估来进一步确认结论。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly operate as tool-using agents, where small format, argument, or function-call errors can invalidate otherwise plausible responses. We study inference-time feed-forward network (FFN) intervention for improving structured outputs without retraining model weights. Our project began with Orthogonal Residual Projection (ORP), a direction-changing repair attempt that revealed sensitive SwiGLU FFN intervention sites but often caused more harm than fixes. We therefore propose Amplitude Gating (AG), a non-destructive alternative that preserves pretrained FFN weight directions and modulates only activation magnitudes during generation. We define a fine-grained intervention system spanning P1/P2/P3 and branch-specific P1s/P2a/P2b sites, and introduce an evaluation protocol that separates combination-oracle headroom from fixed configurations and learned gates, enforces sample-level accounting, and uses task-aware metrics for binary and partial-credit datasets. Across Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B, AG is weakly positive in aggregate but strongest on tool-structured tasks. On Qwen3.5-9B, a category-level learned gate improves tool/structured/agentic performance from 38.66% to 42.92% (+4.27 percentage points), with Hermes function-call tasks reaching about +7.6 points. On Qwen3-8B, Hermes JSON mode improves by +11.36 points. Qwen2.5-7B retains oracle headroom but current learned gates fail to capture it, showing that deployment requires model- and category-specific routing. Comparisons of entropy AG with Newton-Schulz-windowed AG show that neither family is uniformly dominant. These results identify tool-structured inference as the most credible first target for safe FFN-level inference optimization, while prospective online validation and broader cross-model evaluation remain necessary.

</details>


<div id='cs.SI'></div>

# cs.SI [[Back]](#toc)

### [410] [Semantic Networks as Clues: A Theoretical Foundation and Process Optimization for Semantic Network Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01936)
*JinWoo Ha,Dongsoo Kim*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出ClueNetwork框架，用于对不同类型的语义网络构建（SNC）过程生成的候选语义网络进行排序，并基于溯因推理重新确立了非命题知识型语义网络（作为"线索"而非"替代品"）的科学合法性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非命题知识的语义网络（SNs）作为现实的线索而非替代品，导致金标准难以获得，这使得评估和比较不同SNC过程生成的候选网络成为一个挑战。本文旨在从理论上阐明此类网络科学合法性的基础，并在此基础上提出一种可操作的框架来对候选网络进行排序和评估。

Method: 论文首先回顾了非命题文本知识型语义网络的理论基础，论证其科学性源于溯因推理。随后梳理了SNC的三个主要阶段：自动关键词抽取（AKE）、边加权（EW）和社区检测（CD）。在此基础上，定义并论证了评估准则（两个已有准则加一个重新表述的准则），并通过实验加以说明。最终将SNC重新表述为过程优化问题（POP），定义集成局部准则的全局目标函数，从而提出ClueNetwork框架。

Result: 提出了ClueNetwork框架，用于对通过不同SNC过程生成的候选语义网络进行排序，该框架基于定义明确的评估准则和全局目标函数，并通过说明性实验验证了评估准则的有效性。

Conclusion: 非命题知识语义网络虽然缺乏金标准，但可以通过溯因推理确立其科学合法性；基于此，SNC可以被形式化为过程优化问题，ClueNetwork框架为此提供了系统的评估与排序方法。

Abstract: The subject matter of this paper is twofold. One is to review the theoretical foundation of a specific type of Semantic Networks (SNs) representing textual non-propositional knowledge. The other involves proposing a framework (ClueNetwork) for ranking candidate SNs generated through various Semantic Network Construction (SNC) processes for the type. In the first fold, it is clarified that the type serves as clues, not surrogates, of reality, making gold standards elusive. Then, it is discussed why this type nevertheless holds scientific legitimacy in terms of abduction. Grounded in this legitimacy, the three main stages of SNC, comprising Automatic Keyphrase Extraction (AKE), Edge Weighting (EW), and Community Detection (CD), are reviewed alongside their objectives and operations. In the second fold, evaluation criteria (comprising two established and one reformulated) for achieving the objectives are first defined and justified, followed by illustrative experiments based on the criteria. Thereafter, SNC is reformulated as a Process Optimization Problem (POP), and its global objective function that integrates the local criteria is defined and justified. Based on these, ClueNetwork is ultimately proposed.

</details>


### [411] [Network Information Enhances Unreliable News Domain Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02399)
*Raphaela Keßler,Roman David Ventzke,Viola Priesemann,Giordano De Marzo*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于域级网络结构的新闻可靠性分类方法。利用Telegram聊天中的URL共享模式构建统计验证的域共同共享网络，发现低可靠性与高可靠性域名分别聚集。通过图神经网络（GraphSAGE效果最佳）在网络结构上进行分类，相较于不考虑网络的基线方法在相同特征下取得13-14%的相对提升，即使在没有内容特征（仅依靠传播动态）的情况下也能有效工作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于内容的不可靠新闻检测越来越困难，因为低可靠性来源模仿可信新闻报道，且生成式AI使伪造内容更难识别。作者希望探索网络结构是否能够改进新闻可靠性分类，采用从单篇文文章转向来源可靠性的域级方法。

Method: 1) 从Telegram聊天中的URL共享模式构建统计验证的域共同共享网络。2) 发现同配混合现象：低可靠性域聚集在一起，可靠域也聚集。3) 利用图神经网络（GNNs）与不考虑网络的基线（MLPs）进行比较，使用两种特征：多语言文本嵌入（内容感知）和传播动态特征（内容无关）。4) 测试多种GNN模型，GraphSAGE表现最佳。

Result: GNNs在所有特征设置下均一致优于MLPs。GraphSAGE在内容特征下准确率达0.63，在无内容特征下准确率达0.53，相对于不考虑网络的基线取得13-14%的相对提升。网络拓扑系统性改善了域可靠性评估。

Conclusion: 网络拓扑能够系统性地提高域可靠性评估的准确性，并且即使在进行内容分析不可行的情况下（如无法获取文本或内容被加密）仍然有效，为不可靠新闻检测提供了一种补充性的结构方法。

Abstract: Content-based detection of unreliable news is increasingly difficult, as low-reliability sources mimic credible journalism and generative AI makes fabricated content harder to flag. We ask whether network structure can improve news reliability classification, taking a domain-level approach that shifts the focus from individual articles to source reliability. From URL-sharing patterns in Telegram chats, we build a statistically validated domain co-sharing network and find assortative mixing by reliability: low-reliability domains group together, as do reliable ones. Exploiting this structure, we compare Graph Neural Networks against network-unaware baselines using both content-aware features (multilingual text embeddings) and content-agnostic features (spreading dynamics). GNNs consistently outperform Multi-Layer Perceptrons on identical features, with GraphSAGE best in both settings (accuracy 0.63 with content, 0.53 without), a 13-14% relative gain over the network-unaware baseline. Network topology thus systematically improves domain reliability assessment, and remains effective even when content analysis is infeasible.

</details>

### [412] [LightCal: Lightweight Optical-Pulse Bootstrap Calibration for Crystal-Free BLE Radios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00141)
*Cheng Wang,Titan Yuan,David Burnett,Filip Maksimovic,Kristofer S. J. Pister,Tengfei Chang*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出LightCal，一种利用周期性光脉冲作为外部时间参考的无晶振BLE无线电引导校准方法，在SCμM平台上通过商用HTC Lighthouse V1基站实现，显著提升时序稳定性并实现实际BLE引导校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无晶振BLE无线电虽能降低物联网节点的成本、尺寸和集成复杂度，但面临引导启动问题：在RF通信前必须获得足够精确的载波频率参考。现有方法依赖RF信标、已连接节点或基于搜索的信道获取，在初始载波偏移较大时会产生长启动延迟且反馈有限。

Method: LightCal使用周期性光脉冲作为外部时间参考，仅需简单的光脉冲接收，专为资源高度受限的平台设计。实现在SCμM无晶振物联网平台上，使用商用HTC Lighthouse V1基站作为未修改的商用现成光脉冲源，通过脉冲累积提升时序稳定性，残余偏移由窄带宽发射时间精扫解决。

Result: 实验表明脉冲累积显著提升Lighthouse同步脉冲在SCμM平台上的有效时序稳定性，实现了实际的BLE引导校准。光学校准将RF载波带入有界残余误差范围，剩余偏移通过窄发射时间精扫解决。

Conclusion: 光脉冲参考可为无晶振和高集成度物联网平台提供实用的RF前引导校准路径，展示了光学方法在引导校准领域的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Crystal-free Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) radios remove the off-chip high-frequency crystal oscillator and can therefore reduce the cost, size, and integration complexity of Internet of Things (IoT) nodes. However, they face a fundamental bootstrap problem: before a node can communicate over RF, it must first obtain a sufficiently accurate carrier-frequency reference. Existing approaches typically rely on RF beacons, already-connected nodes, or search-based channel acquisition, which can incur long startup latency and provide limited feedback when the initial carrier offset is large. This paper presents LightCal, a lightweight bootstrap calibration method that uses periodic optical pulses as an external timing reference for crystal-free BLE radios. LightCal is designed for highly resource-constrained platforms and requires only simple optical pulse reception. We implement LightCal on scum, a crystal-free IoT platform and use a commercial HTC Lighthouse V1 base station as an unmodified off-the-shelf optical pulse source. Experimental results show that pulse accumulation substantially improves the effective timing stability of Lighthouse sync pulses on SC$μ$M and enables practical BLE bootstrap calibration. In the current scum prototype, optical calibration brings the RF carrier into a bounded residual-error range, and the remaining offset is resolved by a narrow transmit-time fine sweep. The results demonstrate that optical pulse references can provide a practical pre-RF bootstrap calibration path for crystal-free and highly integrated IoT platforms.

</details>


### [413] [HCCL: Collective Communication for Meta Training and Inference Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00358)
*Wesley Bland,Tiago Antunes,Lars Paul Huse,Chidambaram Muthu,Adel Abouchaev,Rabib Alam,Abdullah Alperen,Alexey Andronov,Jose Anto Akkara,Vineet Badhwar,Pavan Balaji,Daniel Berkovitch,Bartosz Bogdanski,Shmeelok Chakraborty,Sungjun Cho,John Choi,James Custer,Rodrigo De Castro,Nguyen Dinh Pham,Matthew Edwards,Kristian Evensen,Evan Ezell,Alex Finestead,Seth Goldstein,Prankur Gupta,Ranwei Hu,Adam Incera,Anand Jayaraman,Prashanth Kannan,Soumil Kanwal,Martin Karp,Sameer Kumar,Naina Kuruballi Mahesh,Wei Lin Guay,Cristian Lumezanu,Cory Modlin,Dag Georg Moxnes,Hoang Nam Nguyen,Ashay Narsale,Jaden Padua,Kirtesh Patil,Minh Pham,Amin Qassoud,Ashwin Ramachandran,David Ramon Prados,Pallavi Shurpali,Gregory R. Steinbrecher,John Sundharam,Vangelis Tasoulas,Fuhou Tian,Srinivas Vaidyanathan,Vimal Vasudevan,Nicolaas Viljoen,Daniel Winkelman,Yijing Zeng,Zhaoqi Zhu,Stig Arne Olsen,Gilad Goldfarb,Rajiv Krishnamurthy,Rajeev Nair,Jonas Olsson,Joseph Provine,Sreeram Ravinoothala,Shivayogi Ugaji,Hongyi Zeng,Nairan Zhang*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了HCCL，一个与Meta MTIA 300加速器协同设计的集体通信库。MTIA 300是Meta首款在网络芯片封装上集成后端网络功能的芯片，其内置专用消息引擎（ME）和近内存计算（NMC）能力，可完全将集体通信执行从计算网格中卸载。HCCL采用编译通信模型，由主机生成包含依赖关系的完整集体通信描述。在训练场景中，HCCL在机架内集体通信中实现了高达940 GB/s的吞吐量，同时对并发计算吞吐的影响小于0.5%。在推理场景中，利用单边通信原语绕过调度路径以最小化集体通信延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大规模AI模型的训练和推理需求增长，加速器的集体通信性能成为关键瓶颈。Meta开发了MTIA 300芯片，首次在芯片封装上集成后端网络，需要一个新的集体通信库来充分利用这种新型硬件架构，实现计算与通信的高效重叠，并同时优化训练（高吞吐）和推理（低延迟）场景。

Method: HCCL采用编译通信模型，主机端生成每个集体通信的完整描述（包括依赖关系）。其架构包括：1）专用消息引擎（ME）配合近内存计算（NMC）完全卸载集体通信；2）控制与数据路径分离的架构设计；3）针对MTIA 300非对称scale-up和scale-out网络进行拓扑感知的算法选择；4）针对推理场景使用单边通信原语绕过调度路径；5）为延迟敏感工作负载设计计算-通信流水线优化方案。

Result: 在训练场景中，HCCL在机架内集体通信中实现高达940 GB/s的吞吐量，且对并发计算吞吐的干扰小于0.5%。在推理场景中，通过单边通信原语显著降低了集体通信延迟，并改进了延迟敏感工作负载下的计算-通信流水线效率。

Conclusion: HCCL展示了与硬件深度协同设计的集体通信库能够有效利用加速器的专用卸载能力，在训练和推理两种截然不同的工作负载下均取得优异性能，验证了将网络功能集成在芯片封装上的MTIA 300架构的可行性和高效性。

Abstract: We present HCCL, a collective communication library co-designed with Meta's MTIA 300 accelerator, the first Meta chip to integrate backend networking directly on chip package. MTIA 300 includes dedicated message engines (MEs) with near-memory compute (NMC) that fully offload collective execution from the compute grid, enabling large overlap between computation and communication. HCCL uses a compiled communication model in which the host generates a complete description of each collective including dependencies. We describe the control and data path architecture, topology-aware algorithm selection across MTIA 300's asymmetric scale-up and scale-out network, and optimizations for both training and inference workloads. For training, HCCL achieves up to 940 GB/s on intra-rack collectives while introducing less than 0.5% degradation to concurrent compute throughput. For inference, we leverage one-sided communication primitives that bypass the scheduling path to minimize collective latency and describe collective designs that improve compute-communication pipelining for latency-sensitive workloads.

</details>


### [414] [TrimMoE A communication aware and adaptive depth framework for distributed edge inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00573)
*Ning Li,Shuting Bai,Xin Yuan,Wenchao Xu,Athanasios V. Vasilakos,Song Guo,Haijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: TrimMoE是一个面向分布式边缘服务器上MoE大语言模型的通信感知自适应深度框架，通过层跳过（layer skipping）与基于置信度的早退（early exit）机制，在统一的预算约束下减少跨服务器专家传输和推理延迟。实验表明，在异构10服务器测试床上，TrimMoE将平均延迟降低最多62.8%，跨服务器流量和远程执行比例显著下降，同时保持任务质量退化在2%以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MoE模型分布式推理方案主要聚焦于如何更快地访问远程专家，但忽略了关键问题：某些层甚至层之后的计算是否根本不需要执行。跨服务器专家传输是分布式MoE推理的主要瓶颈，因此需要从"减少必需要传输的内容"这一新视角出发优化。

Method: TrimMoE分为离线与在线两个阶段。离线阶段：冻结主干网络，训练轻量级逐层出口头（exit heads），校准逐层重要性阈值，并通过跳过/退出感知的冗余效益分配专家副本。在线阶段：采用转换感知的前瞻机制（transition-aware look-ahead）预测token移动，使深度缩减针对成本最高的传输；同时设计两个反馈规则自适应调整延迟-质量权重和退出阈值。论文还证明了替代与跳过的代理退化不超过配置预算，早退仅在标定置信度门限下被允许。

Result: 在异构10服务器测试床上，使用Switch-Base-8E、Qwen-MoE-A2.7B和Mixtral-8x7B三个模型进行评估。TrimMoE将平均延迟降低最多62.8%，降低跨服务器流量和远程执行比例，在负载下保持高吞吐量，同时任务质量退化被控制在2%以内。

Conclusion: TrimMoE证明了一种新的优化思路：与其加速远程专家访问，不如通过智能深度缩减从根本上减少不必要的层执行和跨服务器传输。该框架在保证质量预算的前提下显著提升了分布式MoE推理的效率。

Abstract: Serving Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models across distributed edge servers is bottlenecked by the cross-server expert transmission. The existing approaches mainly focus on how to reach a remote expert faster. However, in this paper, we instead consider whether a given layer, and the layers after it, need to be executed at all. To this end, a communication-aware adaptive-depth framework is proposed in this paper, termed TrimMoE, which couples layer skipping and confidence-based early exit with substitute execution and server-expert selection under a unified quality budget. Specifically, in the offline stage, TrimMoE freezes the backbone, trains the lightweight per-layer exit heads, calibrates the per-layer importance thresholds, and allocates the expert replicas by a skip/exit-aware redundancy benefit. In the online stage, a transition-aware look-ahead anticipates the token movement, so that the depth reduction targets the costliest transmissions, and besides, two feedback rules adapt the delay-quality weights and the exit threshold. Moreover, we prove that the substitution-and-skipping proxy degradation never exceeds the configured budget, and that the early exit is admitted only under a calibrated confidence gate. On a heterogeneous 10-server testbed with Switch-Base-8E, Qwen-MoE-A2.7B, and Mixtral-8x7B, TrimMoE reduces the average latency by up to 62.8%, lowers the cross-server traffic and the remote-execution ratio, and sustains high throughput under load, while keeping the task-quality degradation within a 2% bound.

</details>


### [415] [HetRoute Heterogeneous and Cost-aware Collaborative Routing Framework for Distributed Edge MoE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00577)
*Xin Yuan,Ning Li,Wenchao Xu,Athanasios V. Vasilakos,Song Guo,Haijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出HetRoute，一个面向地理分布式异构边缘服务器的MoE模型协作路由框架。它通过统一的代价模型（涵盖跨服务器传输、GPU-CPU卸载、GPU计算排队和量化质量损失四个组件），在离线阶段优化专家放置与副本精度，在线阶段以整体方式路由Top-k激活专家集。在10台异构边缘服务器测试平台上，相比基线方法，平均推理延迟降低59.0%，P99延迟降低58.0%，跨服务器流量减少72.1%，吞吐量提升2.13倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型在分布式异构边缘服务器上部署时，Top-k激活专家可能分布在多个服务器上，最优路由需要同时考虑跨服务器链路带宽、异构GPU计算能力、GPU-CPU专家加载延迟、瞬时排队积压和副本级量化质量损失等多个因素。现有方法分别处理这些因素，缺乏统一的在线多服务器协作路由框架。

Method: HetRoute包含两个阶段：(1) 离线阶段：通过路由代价耦合的部署算法确定专家服务器放置、GPU-CPU驻留以及副本精度；(2) 在线阶段：将Top-k激活专家集作为整体路由，通过精确枚举或波束搜索最小化瓶颈层代价。理论基础包括回退可行性、参与服务器数量上界、小候选域的逐层最优性以及在线计算复杂度分析。

Result: 在三种MoE模型和10台异构边缘服务器测试平台上，HetRoute相比代表基线方法，平均推理延迟降低最多59.0%，P99延迟降低最多58.0%，跨服务器流量减少最多72.1%，吞吐量提升2.13倍，同时保持质量下降在配置预算内。

Conclusion: HetRoute通过统一代价模型和离线/在线两阶段优化，有效解决了分布式边缘MoE推理中多因素耦合的路由问题，大幅提升推理性能和资源利用效率，同时保障模型质量在可接受范围内。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become a dominant architecture for large-scale AI services, yet deploying them over geo-distributed heterogeneous edge servers remains challenging. When the Top-k activated experts of a token are spread across multiple servers, the optimal routing depends jointly on cross-server link bandwidth, heterogeneous GPU computing capability, GPU-CPU expert loading delay, instantaneous queueing backlog, and replica-level quantization quality loss. Existing distributed inference and MoE serving methods address these factors separately and do not provide a unified framework for online multi-server collaborative routing. In this paper, we propose HetRoute, a heterogeneous-cost-aware collaborative routing framework for distributed edge MoE inference. HetRoute introduces a unified per-assignment cost model that explicitly captures four cost components: cross-server transmission, GPU-CPU offloading, GPU computation with queueing, and quantization-induced quality penalty. Guided by this model, the offline stage determines expert server placement, GPU-CPU residency, and replica precision through a routing-cost-coupled deployment algorithm, while the online stage routes the Top-k activated expert set as a whole by minimizing the bottleneck layer cost via exact enumeration or beam search. Theoretical analysis establishes fallback feasibility, a bound on the number of participating servers, per-layer optimality for small candidate domains, and online computational complexity. Trace-driven evaluation on three MoE models over a heterogeneous 10-server edge testbed shows that HetRoute reduces average inference latency by up to 59.0% and P99 latency by up to 58.0%, cuts cross-server traffic by up to 72.1%, and achieves 2.13x throughput improvement compared with representative baselines, while keeping quality degradation within the configured budget.

</details>


### [416] [LLM-Assisted Coalition Formation for Cooperative Perception in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00690)
*Ahmad Sarlak,Hao Wang,Rahul Amin,Abolfazl Razi*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于LLM辅助的联盟形成框架，用于在通信受限的协同感知场景中，通过DPP（行列式点过程）联合优化感知多样性和通信可靠性，选择最具信息量的辅助车辆，再结合LLM推理模块实现高效、低冗余的多车决策支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有协同感知方法假设参与者已预先确定，仅关注集体感知；而基于LLM的协同驾驶框架虽支持多车推理，但没有对参与车辆的选择标准进行调控。在实际部署中，带宽限制、链路不可靠和冗余信息交换是主要瓶颈，因此需要智能地选择最有价值的车辆参与协同。

Method: 1) 利用DPP在多模态车辆嵌入上联合优化感知多样性；2) 结合通信感知的可靠性约束，构建联盟选择与功率分配的联合优化问题；3) 通过松弛凸重构和ADMM优化策略解耦多样性感知的选择与网络感知的资源分配；4) 将选定的联盟信息摘要提供给LLM推理模块，实现高效的多车决策支持。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法在联盟总价值上优于其他基线，同时保持高多样性和更好的网络效率。在OPV2V和V2V4Real数据集上，该框架在任务性能与安全性之间取得了更好的平衡，验证了其在通信受限条件下协同自动驾驶的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过将LLM的推理能力与数学优化的联盟选择相结合，该框架有效解决了协同感知中的冗余通信和参与者选择问题，证明了在真实通信约束下实现高效、安全的协同自动驾驶的可行性。

Abstract: Cooperative perception (CP) enables connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) to share complementary observations for safer navigation, but practical deployment is limited by bandwidth constraints, unreliable links, and redundant information exchange. Existing CP methods often assume predefined participants and merely focus on collective perception. Likewise, recent LLM-based cooperative driving frameworks facilitate multi-vehicle reasoning but do not regulate participation criteria to select more beneficial vehicles. To bridge this gap, we propose an LLM-assisted coalition formation framework that selects the most informative helper vehicles before LLM reasoning. The approach jointly optimizes perceptual diversity using a determinantal point process (DPP) over multimodal vehicle embeddings and communication-aware reliability. This leads to a joint coalition selection and power allocation problem, which we solve efficiently via a relaxed convex reformulation and an ADMM-based optimization strategy that decouples diversity-aware selection from network-aware resource allocation. The selected coalition is then summarized and provided with an LLM reasoning module for efficient and less redundant multi-vehicle decision support. Experimental results show that our approach outperforms other baselines in overall coalition value, while maintaining high diversity and improved networking efficiency. The framework achieves a better balance between task performance and safety across OPV2V and V2V4Real datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness for cooperative autonomous driving with communication constraints.

</details>


### [417] [Execution Timing Control for Deterministic Task Offloading in the IoT-Edge-Cloud Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00892)
*Keyvan Aghababaiyan,Baldomero Coll-Perales,Javier Gozalvez*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文针对6G物联网-边缘-云连续体中的确定性任务卸载问题，提出了一种执行时机控制策略，不仅决定任务在哪里执行，还决定何时开始执行，通过利用任务延迟预算来平衡工作负载分布，减少峰值拥塞，在保证截止时间的同时实现了70%更高的满足率、40%的通信资源节省、15%的峰值计算资源利用率降低以及77%的平均执行时间缩减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有任务卸载策略主要关注选择任务的执行位置，并通常假设任务到达后立即处理。这导致当多个任务在时间上重合时会引发瞬时拥塞，且在动态工作负载下资源利用效率低下。这些局限阻碍了6G使能的IoT-边缘-云连续体为延迟关键型应用（如自主移动和工业自动化）提供确定性保证的能力。

Method: 提出一种确定性任务卸载的执行时机控制策略，联合决定任务的执行位置（何处）和执行开始时间（何时），同时保证截止时间合规性。核心思想是利用任务的延迟预算来控制其执行时机，从而使工作负载在时间上更均衡地分布，减少整个连续体中的峰值拥塞。

Result: 与现有基准方法相比，所提方法实现了：满足率最高提升70%，通信资源使用减少40%，峰值计算资源利用率降低15%，平均执行时间最多减少77%。

Conclusion: 通过同时控制任务的执行位置和执行时机，可以有效避免动态工作负载下的瞬时拥塞，提升资源利用效率和任务满足率，为延迟关键型IoT应用提供确定性卸载保障。

Abstract: Latency-critical IoT applications, such as autonomous mobility and industrial automation, require deterministic guarantees to ensure that tasks are completed within strict deadlines. The 6G-enabled IoT-edge-cloud continuum can support such requirements by leveraging communication, computation and intelligence resources across devices, edge, and cloud infrastructures. However, existing task offloading strategies mainly focus on selecting where tasks are executed and typically assume immediate processing upon task arrival. This leads to transient congestion when multiple tasks coincide in time and results in inefficient resource utilization under dynamic workloads. This paper addresses these limitations by introducing an execution timing control strategy for deterministic task offloading that jointly determines where tasks are executed and when their execution starts, while guaranteeing deadline compliance. The key idea is to exploit the latency budget of tasks to control their execution timing, enabling a more balanced distribution of workload over time and reducing peak congestion across the continuum. Evaluation results show that, compared to existing benchmarks, the proposed approach achieves up to 70% higher satisfaction ratio, reduces the communication resources usage by 40%, lowers peak computing resource utilization by 15%, and decreases average execution time by up to 77%.

</details>


### [418] [Shiftfly: Scaling the Accelerator Interconnect Past the Pod with a Shift-Routed Optical Tier](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00897)
*Eylon E. Krause*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Shiftfly 网络拓扑，用广义 Kautz 有向图替代 Boardfly 的全局完全图层，在不增加端口数的前提下实现扁平化、有保证的直径和对数级路由，适用于大规模（40万芯片）TPU 互连。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Google 的 Boardfly 三层完全图拓扑适合单推理 pod（1152 芯片内直径 7），但无法扩展：全局完全图需要 G-1 个光端口才能连接 G 组，而 40 万芯片规模下每组需要 12,499 个端口（仅有 40 个），必须增加层级但每层代价 4 跳。

Method: Shiftfly 保留 Boardfly 的底层构建块和组结构不变，仅将全局层替换为广义 Kautz 有向图，通过光电路交换机上的固定置换实现。在同样的 40 端口/组限制下，它是扁平拓扑，具有保证直径 ceil(log_d G)，通过移位寄存器无路由表路由，原生支持内容寻址。

Result: 单 pod 规模下 Shiftfly 输给 Boardfly（芯片级直径 11 对 7）；但在 40 万芯片规模下胜出，最坏距离从 23 跳降至 19 跳，同等成本下谱扩展约好 2.7 倍。冗余论证被自身评估推翻：本地感知放置提供了大部分共享内容的节省，移位代数仅剩 2.9% 残差。可运维性方面，更换故障组成本相同（40 光电路），全局布线只需 28 位控制面状态（对比 550,000）。唯一退步是切片分配：移位图的诱导子集不连通，切片需实例化而非切割。

Conclusion: Shiftfly 在超大规模（超出单 pod 范围）场景下优于 Boardfly，以少量单 pod 规模的代价换取可扩展性、低控制面开销和更好的谱属性，但需接受切片分配方式的转变。

Abstract: Google's TPU interconnect spent nine generations as a $k$-ary $n$-cube, whose diameter grows as $Θ(N^{1/n})$, before TPU 8i replaced it with Boardfly: a three-tier hierarchy in which every tier is a complete graph, giving pod diameter 7 over 1,152 chips. Boardfly suits a single inference pod but does not extend, because a complete global tier needs $G-1$ optical ports to reach $G$ groups. A 400,000-chip machine would need 12,499 per group against the 40 available, so another hierarchy level must be stacked, and each level costs four chip hops.
  We propose Shiftfly, which keeps Boardfly's building block and group verbatim and replaces only the global tier with a generalized Kautz digraph, installed as a fixed permutation on the optical circuit switch the fabric already owns. At an identical 40 ports per group, Shiftfly is flat, has guaranteed diameter $\lceil \log_d G \rceil$, routes without tables by a shift register, and addresses content natively.
  The evaluation is deliberately two-sided. Shiftfly loses at one-pod scale, where Boardfly achieves chip-level diameter 7 against Shiftfly's 11, and wins beyond it, cutting worst-case distance from 23 to 19 hops at 400,000 chips with roughly 2.7x better spectral expansion at equal cost. The redundancy argument that motivated the design does not survive its own evaluation: locality-aware placement supplies most of the achievable saving on shared content, leaving the shift algebra a 2.9% residual, and we report the metric inversion that conceals this.
  We also measure operability. Replacing a failed group costs the same 40 optical circuits in both designs; deriving the global wiring costs 28 bits of control-plane state against 550,000. Slice allocation is the one regression: an arbitrary induced subset of a shift graph is disconnected, so slices must be instantiated rather than carved.

</details>


### [419] [Learning Not to Optimize: Physics-Informed Action-Space Reshaping for Intent-Based Network Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00908)
*Zuyuan Zhang,Vaneet Aggarwal,Tian Lan*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出"学习不优化"（LNOQRD）框架，利用值函数准确之前的中层信号（商化、支配、残差筛除）重塑原始策略优化的行动空间，显著减少候选数量同时保留高覆盖率与最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统网络策略控制将意图映射为顺序决策，Bellman式优化只关心"优化哪个动作"，约束靠罚项/障碍/Lagrangian处理。然而在值函数能认证最优部署之前，中间信号已能排除大量候选，现有方法忽视了这一互补方向。

Method: 提出LNOQRD框架，利用三类中层信号作为"影子过程"重塑原始策略优化的定义域：（1）商化——通过状态-意图重标注识别等价候选；（2）支配——识别将导致一致更差未来状态的候选；（3）残差筛除——排除违反可执行网络法则的候选。证明了在显式等变性与单调性条件下的无损商化与支配，并界定了前沿大小与排序代价。

Result: 小型实例候选减少75.9%同时保留90.8%近似最优覆盖率；大型实例上取得最高效用与意图满足度、最低硬法则违反与生成延迟，较基于候选的基线平均减少73.0%。

Conclusion: 证明了"不优化"作为一种互补策略的有效性：通过中层信号预先缩小行动空间，可以在不损失性能的前提下大幅降低优化负担，为网络策略控制提供了新的优化范式。

Abstract: Modern network policy control maps intent to sequential placement-control decisions. Bellman-style policy optimization primarily asks which action to optimize, while constraints are commonly handled through penalty, barrier, or Lagrangian mechanisms. We observe that before a value function can certify the best deployment, intermediate signals may already identify many candidates that should be excluded from further optimization. This motivates a complementary direction: \emph{Learning Not to Optimize}. Before a value function is accurate enough to select the best placement-control decision, intermediate signals may already show that candidates are equivalent under state--intent relabeling (quotienting), lead to a uniformly worse future state (dominance), or violate executable network laws (residual screening). \LNOQRD{} uses these computed or learned signals as a shadow process to reshape the domain on which primal policy optimization is performed, thereby reducing the action space. We prove lossless quotienting and dominance under explicit equivariance and monotonicity conditions, bound frontier size and ranking cost, and quantify losses from approximate certificates and primal estimates. Experiments show that \LNOQRD{} reduces small-instance candidates by $75.9\%$ while retaining $90.8\%$ near-oracle coverage and, on large instances, achieves the highest utility and intent satisfaction, the lowest hard-law violation and post-generation latency, and a $73.0\%$ average reduction among candidate-based baselines.

</details>


### [420] [Augmented Backpressure for Decentralized Management of Agentic Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00914)
*Zuyuan Zhang,Sizhe Tang,Tian Lan*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出Memory-Augmented Backpressure（MABP），一种面向有状态基础模型服务网络（SFMSNs）的队列-记忆联合控制框架。该框架将商品队列与因果上下文记忆动态联合建模，通过记忆依赖的压力分数选择路由、传输、激活和服务动作，并证明记忆感知决策可严格扩大稳定区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统通信网络的控制方法无法直接适用于基础模型服务网络，因为这类网络的控制性能不仅取决于队列动态，还依赖于上下文记忆状态（如prefix/KV块、检索上下文、专家热状态、验证后的工具输出）。这些状态源于执行历史，并在有限本地预算下改变服务工作和下游后继规律。将它们视为被动缓存或独立过程会留下队列控制上的空白。

Method: MABP框架按服务和状态类型表示每个请求，估计记忆依赖的工作量、惩罚和后继概率；每个时隙读取队列和驻留记忆，使用记忆依赖的压力分数选择可行的路由、传输、激活和服务动作，并保留预算可行的驻留对象及新生成对象的子集。此外还提出了exact frame-MABP及其有界损失的近似求解器扩展。

Result: 证明了占据测度容量外界的条件紧致性；表明建模上下文记忆可通过减少工作和转移整形严格增加稳定区域，确立了记忆感知与记忆遗忘决策之间的分离；对exact frame-MABP证明了吞吐量和漂移加惩罚保证，并给出了有界损失扩展至近似求解器。

Conclusion: 记忆感知的调度决策对基础模型服务网络至关重要，MABP为这类网络提供了理论上有保证的队列-记忆联合控制方法，显著优于忽略记忆动态的传统方法。

Abstract: Agentic foundation-model service networks handle requests spanning retrieval, planning, generation, verification, and tool use. Unlike traditional communication networks, control performance depends on queue dynamics and contextual memory states, including prefix/KV blocks, retrieved contexts, expert warm states, and verified tool outputs. These states arise from execution history and alter service work and downstream successor laws under finite local budgets. Treating them as passive caches or an independent process leaves a queueing-control gap. To this end, we propose \emph{Memory-Augmented Backpressure} (MABP), a queue--memory control framework for stateful foundation-model service networks (SFMSNs) that jointly models commodity queues and causal contextual memory dynamics. MABP represents each request by service and state types, estimates memory-dependent work, penalties, and successor probabilities, then reads queues and resident memory each slot, selects feasible routing, transfer, activation, and service actions using a memory-dependent pressure score, and retains a budget-feasible subset of resident and newly generated objects. We prove an occupation-measure capacity outer bound with conditional tightness. We show that modeling contextual memory can strictly increase the stability region through work reduction and transition shaping, establishing a separation between memory-aware and memory-oblivious decisions. We also prove throughput and drift-plus-penalty guarantees for exact frame-MABP with bounded-loss extensions to approximate solvers.

</details>


### [421] [Topology-Age-Aware Cooperative Awareness in Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01026)
*Mostafa Lotfi,Masoumeh Moradian*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文研究VANET中协同状态广播的调度问题，提出年龄感知协同广播策略（A-CB）及两种拓扑-年龄感知协同广播策略（Local TA-CB和Global TA-CB），通过RSU调度目标-发送者配对并利用网络拓扑信息来降低信息年龄，数值结果表明协同策略显著优于非协同方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在车载自组织网络中（VANET），保持车辆间状态信息的新鲜度对安全决策至关重要。现有研究主要关注个体广播，未充分利用车辆间协同广播的潜力，因此需要设计有效的调度策略来最小化信息年龄。

Method: 提出年龄感知协同广播（A-CB）策略，由RSU基于链路的总可实现年龄增益来调度目标-发送者配对。进一步利用网络拓扑信息，提出两种拓扑年龄感知策略：Local TA-CB根据二跳邻居数量对链路加权，Global TA-CB利用车辆介数中心性优先化广播决策。

Result: 在随机和聚类网络拓扑下评估所提策略，数值结果表明协同广播策略显著优于非协同广播。在聚类网络中，Local和Global TA-CB策略相比A-CB有大幅改进，且两者在不同网络条件下各有优劣。

Conclusion: 协同广播结合拓扑感知调度能有效降低VANET中的信息年龄，Local TA-CB和Global TA-CB在不同网络条件下互为补充，为实际部署提供了灵活的策略选择。

Abstract: In vehicular ad-hoc networks (VANETs), maintaining the freshness of status information among vehicles is critical for enabling timely and reliable safety-related decisions. In this paper, we consider the problem of scheduling cooperative status broadcasting in VANETs, where vehicles are allowed to broadcast not only their own updates but also the updates of other vehicles. We propose the age-aware cooperative broadcasting (A-CB) policy, in which a road-side unit (RSU) schedules target-sender pairs based on the total achievable age-gain over the sender's network links. Moreover, through exploiting the network topology, we introduce two topology-age-aware cooperative broadcasting (TA-CB) policies; the Local TA-CB that weights links according to the number of second-hop neighbors, and the Global TA-CB that leverages the betweenness centrality of vehicles to prioritize broadcasting decisions. The proposed policies are evaluated under both random and clustered network topologies. Numerical results demonstrate that cooperative policies significantly outperform non-cooperative broadcasting. Notably, in clustered network structures, the Local and the Global TA-CB policies achieve substantial improvements over A-CB, with each outperforming the other under different network conditions.

</details>


### [422] [VeraRAN: Pre-Actuation Certification and Event-Causal Synchronization Repair for Asynchronous Multi-Interface RAN Plans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01047)
*Yinghan Hou,Zongyou Yang*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: VeraRAN是一个针对Agentic RAN控制器的安全验证系统，通过建模异步执行过程中的请求、交付、接受、应用、完成和观察六种事件，检测计划在执行前的异步不安全状态。VeraSync通过插入版本化事件屏障修复不安全计划，MI-POR通过剪枝独立交错减少搜索空间。实验表明28.8%的局部有效计划存在异步不安全，修复后保持87%的动作为无序状态，并将搜索状态减少94.6-95.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic RAN控制器将移动性、能源和资源操作结合在独立实现的接口上，即使每个命令单独有效且目标状态安全，异步执行也可能使网络经历不安全的中间状态，现有方法缺乏对这种异步执行风险的检测与修复手段。

Method: VeraRAN建模每种动作的六个事件（请求、交付、接受、应用、完成、观察）并探索合理延迟和事件顺序来检测异步不安全计划；VeraSync在发现问题时插入版本化事件屏障并重新检查修复后计划的安全性和完整性；MI-POR利用RAN生命周期和资源足迹剪枝独立交错。

Result: 在冻结研究中28.8%的局部有效计划存在异步不安全。VeraSync在声明的修复域内重新认证所有确认计划，同时保持87%的动作对无序；MI-POR与精确搜索在性质分层审计中结果一致，减少了94.6-95.0%的探索状态（20-40动作计划）。原生ns-O-RAN回放和独立实时E2审计验证了事件区分的重要性。

Conclusion: 事件语义区分至关重要：接受事件可能先于权威状态转换，因此依赖动作必须等待直接的APPLY证据或合同支持的、因果上位于APPLY下游的完成事件，这为Agentic RAN控制器的安全异步执行提供了可靠的验证与修复框架。

Abstract: Agentic RAN controllers combine mobility, energy, and resource actions across independently implemented interfaces. Even when each command is valid and the target state is safe, asynchronous actuation can drive the network through unsafe intermediate states. In a frozen study of a 35B planner, 28.8% of locally valid plans remained asynchronously unsafe. We introduce VeraRAN, which checks plans before actuation by modeling request, delivery, acceptance, application, completion, and observation for each action while exploring plausible delays and event orders. When VeraRAN finds a counterexample, VeraSync inserts versioned event barriers and rechecks the repaired plan for safety and completion. MI-POR prunes independent interleavings using RAN lifecycle and resource footprints. In a post-freeze stratified confirmation within the declared repair domain, VeraSync re-certified every confirmation plan while leaving 87% of action pairs unordered. MI-POR matched exact search in a property-stratified audit and reduced explored states by 94.6-95.0% on 20-40-action plans. Native ns-O-RAN replay and an independent live E2 audit showed why distinguishing these events matters: acceptance may precede the authoritative state transition, so dependent actions must wait for direct APPLY evidence or a contract-backed completion event causally downstream of APPLY.

</details>


### [423] [A Wireless Network Architecture for Monitoring of Hospitalized Patients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01245)
*Luca Leonardi,Lucia Lo Bello,Gaetano Patti*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了MEDIWARN系统，一个用于住院患者生命体征监测的虚拟生物传感器网络架构，旨在帮助医疗团队对患者健康状况变化做出及时响应，并通过仿真评估验证了系统在现实场景中的初步表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 住院患者的生命体征监测对于理解其临床状况至关重要，现有系统需要能够帮助医疗团队及时响应患者健康状况的恶化，因此需要设计一个高效的虚拟传感器网络系统。

Method: 提出了MEDIWARN网络架构，讨论了该系统设计所面临的挑战，并通过仿真评估在现实场景中对系统进行了初步验证。

Result: 通过仿真评估，MEDIWARN系统在现实场景中获得了初步的性能验证结果。

Conclusion: MEDIWARN网络架构有望为住院患者提供实时生命体征监测和医疗预警能力，帮助医疗团队及时采取行动。

Abstract: Monitoring of vital parameters plays a key role in better understanding the clinical condition of hospitalized patients. In this perspective, the virtual biosensor for MEDIcal WARNing precursor (MEDIWARN) aims to help the medical team to take a prompt action in response to the evolution of patients' health condition. This paper presents the MEDIWARN network architecture and discusses the design challenges that such a system poses. Simulative assessments provide a preliminary evaluation of the system in realistic scenarios.

</details>


### [424] [Achieving Rate-Concurrency Balance for Underwater Concurrent Random Access](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01254)
*Enqi Zhang,Yuxuan Guo,Weining Li,Linpeng Chen,Yuetong Chen,Deqing Wang,Lizhao You,Liqun Fu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出名为system的跨层并发随机接入系统，结合EZCDM波形（基于等距ZC除法复用）与跨层链路自适应框架，解决水声网络中高速率波形与并发接入之间的根本性权衡。通过信道/信号迹驱动的物理层实验及PHY-in-the-loop网络仿真，证明其相比传统波形和MAC协议在BER和吞吐量上显著提升，将破坏性冲突转化为可解码的并发流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水声网络存在固有的速率-并发权衡：高速率波形（如OFDM、OTFS）依赖正交MAC（如TDMA）避免冲突而牺牲并发性；而抗冲突波形（如CDMA、ZCMod）支持无序接入但受扩频或稀疏索引调制限制，速率有限。现有方案无法同时获得高吞吐与高并发。

Method: 系统包含两个新组件：(i) EZCDM波形，激活ZC根的多个循环移位作为并行子信道，提供可调的速率-鲁棒性权衡，并采用符号内差分接收机消除共享多径信道响应，无需显式CIR估计；(ii) 跨层链路自适应框架，包含信标帧随机接入、用户特定闭环功率控制和重叠及CIR感知的公共MS选择。

Result: 通过信道迹和信号迹驱动的物理层实验及PHY-in-the-loop网络仿真，系统相比传统波形和MAC协议在BER和吞吐量上取得显著提升，能够将传统上破坏性的冲突转化为可解码的并发数据流。

Conclusion: 系统通过跨层设计（波形优化 + 链路自适应）有效打破了水声网络中速率与并发之间的传统权衡，验证了在真实信道条件下将冲突转化为并发传输的可行性和有效性。

Abstract: Underwater acoustic networks face a fundamental rate--concurrency tradeoff: high-rate waveforms (e.g., OFDM, OTFS) are designed for point-to-point links and rely on orthogonal MAC protocols (e.g., TDMA) to avoid collisions, sacrificing concurrency; conversely, collision-resilient waveforms (e.g., CDMA, ZCMod) support uncoordinated access but are inherently rate-limited by spreading or sparse index modulation. We present \system, a cross-layer concurrent random-access system that combines two new components: (i) \textbf{EZCDM}, an equidistant ZC division-multiplexing waveform that activates multiple cyclic shifts of a ZC root as parallel sub-channels with a tunable rate--robustness tradeoff, and an intra-symbol differential receiver that eliminates the shared multipath channel response without explicit CIR estimation; and (ii) a \textbf{cross-layer link adaptation (LA) framework} featuring beacon-framed random access, user-specific closed-loop power control, and overlap- and CIR-aware common-MS selection. Channel-trace- and signal-trace-driven physical-layer experiments combined with PHY-in-the-loop network simulations demonstrate that \system\ achieves significant BER and throughput gains over conventional waveforms and MAC protocols by converting traditionally destructive collisions into decodable concurrent streams.

</details>


### [425] [Clear-Weighted Bit Allocation for Satellite Downlinks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01457)
*Alireza Furutanpey,Qiyang Zhang,Yujie Huang,Philipp Raith,Schahram Dustdar*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出一套面向地球观测卫星的端到端下行链路调度系统，通过清晰概率加权的神经编码器将码元从云层重新分配到清晰地面，并结合基于清晰内容估计的因果调度器，在中断的卫星-地面接触中显著提升清晰数据的按时交付率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球观测卫星捕获的图像远超间歇性地面接触所能传输的容量。现有系统依赖固定阈值云检测器丢弃帧或瓦片，并用固定编解码器压缩幸存数据，但在专家标注数据上，这些规则因检测器误报而丢弃了超过五分之一的清晰像素，造成宝贵数据的浪费。

Method: 1) 训练一个具有清晰概率加权重建损失的神经编解码器，将编码字节从云层重新分配给清晰地面，无需在星上生成或传输云图；2) 将每次捕获编码为可恢复的基础层和依赖的细化层，从编码器产生的特征估计清晰内容；3) 设计因果调度器，利用估计的清晰内容、未完成字节、截止时间余量和聚合截止压力对已到达层进行排序；4) 调度器服务基础层和计算截止时间、限制存储的残差字节、恢复中断的数据包。

Result: 清晰加权编解码器在匹配清晰区域质量下，比学习压缩基线节省高达47.8%的字节；优化后的编码器比帧丢弃规则所用云检测器单次扫描消耗更少的时间和能量；相对于固定两级服务，调度器在中断的联合队列中使截止时间满的清晰内容交付量翻倍以上，达到认证的无所不知（clairvoyant）上限的83.6%，并在截止时间可用交付量上超越重放参考顺序。

Conclusion: 通过将云-清晰分配、编码压缩与因果调度统一设计，可以在资源受限的星载平台上大幅提升有限下行链路中清晰地球观测数据的有效交付，验证了"感知-编码-调度"联合优化范式的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Earth-observation satellites capture more imagery than intermittent ground contacts can transmit. Onboard systems threshold a cloud detector, discard frames or tiles, and compress the survivors with a fixed codec. On expert-labeled imagery, these rules remove more than one-fifth of clear pixels, primarily through detector false positives. We train a neural codec with a clear-probability-weighted reconstruction loss, reallocating coded bytes from clouds to clear ground without requiring or transmitting a cloud map onboard. Each capture is encoded into a resumable base layer and a dependent refinement layer, while clear content is estimated from features produced by the encoder. At each contact, we causally rank arrived layers using estimated clear content, unfinished bytes, deadline slack, and aggregate deadline pressure. The scheduler serves base and computational deadlines, bounds stored residual bytes, and resumes interrupted packets. We evaluate the onboard-to-downlink pipeline using real entropy-coded bytes, orbit-derived interruptible contact capacities, and measured service time and energy on resource-constrained embedded accelerators. Clear-weighted codecs require up to 47.8\% fewer bytes than learned-compression baselines at matched clear-region quality. The optimized encoder consumes less time and energy than one pass of the cloud detector used by the frame-discard rules. Relative to fixed two-stage service on the same streams, our scheduler more than doubles deadline-full clear-content delivery for the interrupted combined cohort, reaches 83.6\% of a certified clairvoyant upper bound, and exceeds replayed reference orders in deadline-usable delivery.

</details>


### [426] [An Internet for the KV Cache: Rethinking Classical Infrastructure Boundaries in the LLM Inference Age](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01526)
*Siddhant Ray,Nick Feamster,Junchen Jiang*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了"KV Cache互联网"的愿景，主张将LLM推理中的KV Cache管理与内容分发系统（CDN）类似的方式处理，实现计算与KV Cache存储的解耦，通过跨云和数据中心的网络作为主动分发渠道，实现自适应的KV Cache存储与重计算决策，以最小化延迟和成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理已成为全球规模的异构工作负载（涵盖代理、检索、工具调用、代码执行和多模态推理），这些负载天然存在上下文重叠复用机会。然而，模型侧（KV Cache压缩）和系统侧（计算、存储和传输成本优化）的进步在传统云边界内独立演进，未能充分利用跨云和数据中心的重用机会。

Method: 提出一种愿景性架构：将计算与KV Cache存储解耦，使网络成为主动分发渠道（类似CDN），KV Cache的管理决策由模型指标、基础设施指标和应用指标共同驱动，实现自适应、内容驱动的存储与重计算决策。

Result: 本文是愿景/立场论文，不包含具体实验结果，核心贡献是提出一个将KV Cache视为可分发内容的新视角，并指出带宽、延迟和定价应直接决定KV Cache的管理策略。

Conclusion: 未来推理基础设施应将KV Cache管理视为内容分发系统，通过跨云和数据中心的协同，在存储KV Cache与重新计算之间进行自适应权衡，从而实现延迟和成本的最小化。

Abstract: LLM inference has become a global-scale, heterogeneous workload spanning agents, retrieval, tool-use, code execution and multi-modal reasoning. These workloads naturally enable context reuse from overlapping inputs, creating a major opportunity to store and reuse the contexts' KV Caches instead of recomputing them. However, model-side advances that shrink the KV Cache and system-side advances that reduce compute, storage, and transfer costs are evolve independently within legacy cloud boundaries. We argue that future inference infrastructure should allow decoupling of compute and KV Cache storage across cloud and datacenters. The network becomes an active distribution channel; bandwidth, latency and pricing directly determines how the KV Cache should be managed. We propose a vision for an Internet for the KV Cache, with KV Cache management working as a content-distribution system. In this view, KV Cache storage and recompute decisions are driven by model, infrastructure, and application metrics, to enable adaptive, content-driven decisions for minimizing latency and cost.

</details>


### [427] [From Network Automation to Trustworthy Autonomous Networking in the LLM Era: A Network Control Intelligence Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01538)
*Tianzhu Zhang,Changgang Zheng,Shanshan Wang,Yarui Zhang,Lina Shi,Yue Jin,Xiaofei Wang,Meikang Qiu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出网络控制智能（NCI）五轴框架，用以组织网络控制系统从规则脚本自动化、可编程数据驱动控制到LLM赋能网络运维三个时代的演进，并指出各时代存在能力发展不对称的问题。论文在此基础上提出可信自治的概念，建立将提议生成与受控执行分离的参考架构，并推导出在高保证、安全和治理约束下实现更高网络自治的研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络自动化的发展历史漫长，但单一成熟度阶梯难以刻画其演进过程。网络控制系统的各项能力（观测、决策支持、例行执行、操作交互）发展不均衡，导致自动化程度不能作为网络侧可信操作的可靠代理。核心问题不是系统提供多少自动化，而是在何种条件下可以被信任去改变网络状态。

Method: 提出NCI（网络控制智能）五轴框架，涵盖决策逻辑、适应性、知识、控制委派和接口五个维度。利用该框架将网络控制系统的演进划分为三个时代，并揭示能力扩展中的持续不对称性。进而提出可信自治概念——系统推断能力、验证能力和执行授权之间的治理对齐，并据此设计将提议生成与受控执行分离的参考架构。

Result: 通过NCI框架系统梳理了网络控制三个时代的演进特征，识别出能力发展的不对称性问题。构建了分离提议生成与受控执行的参考架构，识别了LLM赋能运维的重复集成模式，并推出了面向更高网络自治的研究议程。

Conclusion: 网络控制的信任不应仅由自动化程度决定，而应取决于系统在推断、验证和执行授权三者之间的治理对齐。实现可信自治需要将生成式能力（如LLM）与严格的执行治理分离，在保证、安全和治理约束下推进更高水平的网络自治。

Abstract: Since the inception of modern communication networks, the quest for operations automation has never ceased. Yet the evolution of network automation is difficult to characterize with a single maturity ladder. Throughout this history, network control systems have expanded their capabilities for observation, decision support, routine execution, and operator interaction, but these capabilities have not advanced uniformly. Such uneven progress makes the degree of automation an unreliable proxy for trustworthy network-side actuation. The unresolved question is not simply how much automation a system provides, but under what conditions it can be entrusted to change the network state. This paper examines that question through Network Control Intelligence (NCI), a five-axis framework spanning Decision Logic, Adaptability, Knowledge, Control Delegation, and Interface. We use NCI to organize the evolution of network-control systems into three eras: rule-based and scripted automation, programmable and data-driven control, and Large Language Model (LLM)-enabled network operations. Viewed through this framework, the three eras reveal a persistent asymmetry. None of these gains, however, automatically determines when network control should be trusted to change the network state. We frame trustworthy autonomy as a governed alignment between what a system can infer, what it can verify, and what it is authorized to execute. On that basis, the paper develops a reference architecture that separates proposal generation from governed execution, identifies recurring integration patterns for LLM-enabled operations, and derives a research agenda for higher network autonomy under explicit assurance, safety, and governance constraints.

</details>


### [428] [Sensitivity-driven Adaptive Contention Window Optimization for IEEE 802.11 based V2I Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01555)
*Aytül Bozkurt*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文在V2I通信场景中，对IEEE 802.11 DCF参数与流量参数进行灵敏度排名分析，提出碰撞概率由竞争车辆群和最小竞争窗口决定、时延由信道速率/负载/包大小驱动的结论，并推导出闭式竞争窗口控制律，实现吞吐量优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管IEEE 802.11 DCF参数设置对V2I通信性能有决定性影响，但现有文献很少在联合建模流量、MAC和排队的情况下定量评估各参数的相对重要性。本文旨在填补这一空白，给出明确的参数灵敏度排名。

Method: 将先前验证过的解析框架视为确定性输入-输出映射，结合局部单因子分析（无量纲弹性）与基于Sobol一阶和总效应指数的方差全局分析，推导闭式灵敏度结构，并基于Greenshields密度模型设计闭式竞争窗口控制律。

Result: 发现两类清晰的参数分组：碰撞概率由竞争车辆群（车速与密度决定）和最小竞争窗口主导；时延由信道速率、负载和包大小驱动且具强交互效应。由此推导出线性于竞争车辆群的竞争窗口控制律，其吞吐量增益随密度增大而增加，在密集安全关键场景下最大。

Conclusion: 本文将参数灵敏度分析转化为设计输出，提出了可在线评估的竞争窗口控制律，该律在固定默认参数处恢复IEEE 802.11标准设置，但在偏离该点时能带来显著的吞吐量提升，尤其在高密度安全关键场景中。

Abstract: In vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communication the setting of IEEE 802.11 Distributed Coordination Function (DCF) parameters has a decisive bearing on performance, yet the literature seldom pins down how much each parameter actually matters once traffic, MAC and queueing are modelled together. Treating a previously validated analytical framework as a fixed deterministic input-output map, we rank the DCF and traffic parameters that shape throughput, collision probability, delay, packet delivery ratio and Age of Information in a single-AP V2I network. A local one-factor-at-a-time analysis, cast in dimensionless elasticities so that parameters of different units become comparable, is paired with a variance-based global analysis built on first-order and total-effect Sobol indices. Two clean groups emerge: collision probability is set by the contending-vehicle population -- itself governed by vehicle velocity and density -- together with the minimum contention window, whereas delay is driven by the channel rate, the offered load and the packet size, and carries strong interaction effects that no local reading can expose. We then derive the closed-form structure of these sensitivities from the model relations, which explains the rankings, forces certain parameters into equal-magnitude elasticities, and locates where the local ranking reverses. Finally the collision-sensitivity structure is turned into a design output rather than a ranking: a closed-form contention-window control law, linear in the contending population and closed with a Greenshields density model, that a roadside access point can evaluate online from measured density or velocity. The fixed IEEE 802.11 default is recovered as the single population at which this law is optimal; away from it the throughput gain grows with density and is largest in the dense, safety-critical regime.

</details>


### [429] [LLM-Driven Automated Reward Design for Reinforcement Learning-Based Routing in LEO Satellite Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01649)
*Walter P. Casas,Nelson L. S. da Fonseca,and Carlos A. Astudillo*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出LARGE框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）自动生成并迭代优化RL路由的奖励函数，通过模拟器在环反馈，在LEO卫星网络中实现了接近专家手工设计的性能（goodput差距约3%），无需人工奖励工程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO卫星网络拓扑高度动态，RL路由的性能严重依赖奖励函数设计，而手工设计奖励函数需要大量领域知识和试错。现有的LLM自动奖励设计方法尚未应用于高度动态的卫星网络场景，因此需要探索自动化的奖励设计框架。

Method: LARGE框架结合LLM驱动的奖励生成与迭代式模拟器在环评估：首先利用LLM先验知识生成初始奖励函数，然后通过模拟器反馈反复迭代精炼奖励公式，在探索多样奖励设计的同时与网络目标对齐。

Result: LARGE在少量迭代内即可提升奖励质量；在不同骨干网络上性能与专家设计基线相当，最佳配置的goodput与基线差距约3%，端到端延迟略低于基线，且无需人工奖励工程。

Conclusion: 有效性来源于LARGE驱动的迭代反馈过程，展示了框架驱动的LLM在环优化在动态卫星网络RL路由中的潜力。

Abstract: Routing in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite networks is challenging due to highly dynamic topologies and spatio-temporal network conditions. Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising approach for adaptive routing; however, its performance critically depends on reward function design, which must balance objectives such as goodput and end-to-end delay. In practice, reward design remains a complex manual process requiring significant domain expertise and extensive trial-and-error. Recent works have explored Large Language Models (LLMs) for automated reward design, but their application to highly dynamic systems such as LEO satellite networks remains largely unexplored. We propose LARGE, a framework that automates reward design for RL-based routing by combining LLM- driven generation with iterative simulator-in-the-loop evaluation. LARGE generates an initial reward from LLM prior knowledge and iteratively refines it using simulation feedback. This loop enables exploration of diverse reward formulations while aligning them with network objectives. Results show that LARGE improves reward quality within a few iterations through feedback-driven refinement. Across different backbones, the framework achieves performance comparable to an expert-designed baseline, with the best-performing configuration reaching goodput within approximately 3% of the baseline and slightly lower end-to-end delay, without manual reward engineering. These results indicate that effectiveness emerges from the iterative feedback-driven process enabled by LARGE, highlighting the potential of framework-driven LLM-in-the-loop optimization for RL-based routing in dynamic satellite networks.

</details>


### [430] [LEO-Aware DRL Meta-Scheduler for 5G Non-Terrestrial Network Slicing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01668)
*Víctor Vilchez,Tiago P. C. de Andrade,Edward Hinojosa,Edmundo Madeira,and Carlos A. Astudillo*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度强化学习（DRL）的双时间尺度元调度器，用于LEO非地面网络（NTN）中的异构网络切片资源分配。该方案采用解耦O-RAN架构，通过100ms粒度的元调度器结合TD3智能体，在严格约束关键任务（MC）流量RLC层排队延迟的同时，仅牺牲统计上不显著的1%容量，避免了宽带切片饥饿问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO NTN融入5G/6G架构带来严重传播延迟、超高基站移动性和信道非平稳性等挑战，使异构网络切片的无线资源管理变得复杂。传统方法难以同时满足不同切片的差异化SLA约束，特别是如何在不牺牲其他切片性能的前提下保障关键任务流量的时延要求。

Method: 提出解耦O-RAN架构下的双时间尺度DRL元调度器：(1) 100ms尺度的元调度器利用过期遥测数据为不同网络切片选择调度策略；(2) 快速MAC分组调度器处理每TTI的用户请求；(3) 通过TD3（Twin Delayed DDPG）智能体构建马尔可夫决策过程，捕获轨道非平稳动力学和异构SLA约束。

Result: 在不同流量负载下的仿真结果表明：与现有方案相比，所提出的元调度器仅以统计上不显著（p>0.05）的1%容量为代价，严格约束了MC流量的RLC层排队延迟的方差和整体大小；同时避免了标准最大CQI启发式方法中常见的宽带切片饥饿问题。

Conclusion: 该元调度器在保障MC流量时延隔离的同时维持了宽带切片的公平性，为6G O-RAN NTN资源分配奠定了坚实基础。

Abstract: The integration of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTNs) into 5G and upcoming 6G architectures introduces various challenges, including severe propagation delays, ultra-high base station mobility, and channel non-stationarity, complicating radio resource management of heterogeneous network slices. In this paper, we propose a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) meta-scheduler for twin-timescale resource allocation. Our solution adopts a decoupled Open Radio Access Network (RAN) architecture, in which a strategic 100 ms meta-scheduler selects scheduling policies for the different network slices using stale telemetry, while a fast-timescale MAC packet scheduler processes per-TTI user requests. The resulting Markov Decision Process captures non-stationary orbital dynamics and heterogeneous SLAs constraints via a TD3 agent. Simulation results under varying traffic load show that, unlike other solutions, the proposed meta-scheduler explicitly trades a statistically insignificant 1% capacity fraction (p > 0.05) to strictly bound the variance and overall magnitude of RLC-layer queuing delay for Mission-Critical (MC) traffic. Crucially, it enforces this isolation without inducing the broadband slice starvation characteristic of standard maximum-CQI heuristics, establishing a robust foundation for 6G O-RAN NTN resource allocation.

</details>


### [431] [On Topology's Role in ML Training Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01707)
*Sarah McClure,Tegan Wilson,Brad Karp,Michael Mitzenmacher,Sylvia Ratnasamy,Scott Shenker,Minlan Yu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文通过解析分析的方法，研究了现代机器学习训练工作中常用的两种网络拓扑（fat-tree Clos和torus）对集合通信操作性能的影响，并考虑了网络故障和作业放置策略等因素，发现Clos拓扑在大多数情况下表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器学习训练工作负载运行在大规模计算加速器网络上，常用的网络拓扑主要是fat-tree Clos和torus两种变体。理解这两种拓扑如何影响机器学习工作负载所依赖的集合通信操作的性能，对于网络设计和性能优化至关重要。然而，目前缺乏系统的解析分析来阐明拓扑选择对可达性能的影响，特别是在考虑网络故障和作业放置等现实因素时。

Method: 本文通过建立解析模型，推导出关于不同拓扑（fat-tree Clos和torus）下集合通信操作性能的理论结果。分析涵盖了拓扑对集合通信完成时间（collective completion time）的影响，并将网络故障和作业放置策略等额外因素纳入分析框架，以评估这些因素如何改变基本性能结论。

Result: 研究发现不存在一种在所有情况下都占主导地位的拓扑。然而，在大多数情况下，fat-tree Clos拓扑在集合通信完成时间上表现更好，同时在网络故障的韧性和作业放置的灵活性方面也提供了额外优势。

Conclusion: Clos拓扑在多数情况下是更优的选择，特别是在追求更短的集合通信完成时间、更好的故障韧性和更高的灵活性时。但拓扑选择仍需根据具体工作负载特征和需求进行权衡，因为不存在普适的最优拓扑。

Abstract: Modern machine learning training workloads run on large-scale networks of compute accelerators. The networks commonly deployed in these systems are typically variations of two basic topologies: the fat-tree Clos and the torus. In this paper, we derive analytical results the elucidate how the choice of topology shapes achievable performance for the small set of collective communication operations that underlies modern machine learning workloads. We also consider how these results change when we include additional factors such as network failures and job placement strategies. Overall, we find that one topology does not dominate in all cases, but that the Clos achieves better collective completion time in most cases and provides benefits in resilience and flexibility.

</details>


### [432] [CENTILE: A Telemetry Foundation Model Evaluated by the Decisions It Drives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01725)
*Zifan Zhang,Zhichao Hou,Tingxiang Ji,Yuchen Liu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Sys（一个生成式基础模型），用于网络和系统遥测数据，通过条件分位数预测驱动决策回放评估，首次在 HPC 调度和网络资源分配中超越部署基线，显著降低任务平均有界减速比和规则违反率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的遥测分析为每个任务、实体和预测范围分别训练独立预测器，效率低下。虽然生成式基础模型在推荐系统中已展示扩展能力，但在运维遥测上点预测误差接近简单last-value基线，低误差未必改善决策质量。因此需要直接以决策效果为评估目标的通用遥测基础模型。

Method: Sys 将异构遥测建模为事件驱动的、不规则时间的实体流，在单次前向传播中支持灵活的预测范围且无需未来时间戳。通过训练条件分位数预测器，以回放（replay）方式评估其引导的决策（HPC 调度和网络资源分配）。采用预训练权重，可零样本跨月份迁移，并可从数小时目标数据快速跨域适配。

Result: 在 HPC 任务日志和网络流量上的广泛实验表明：Sys 相比部署的用户估计将 backfilling 的平均有界减速比降低约 77%，并将部署规则的违反率减少约一半。运行时估计器可零样本跨月份迁移，预训练权重可跨域迁移。

Conclusion: Sys 是首个在回放评估下同时改进 HPC 调度和网络供应决策的预训练遥测模型，验证了将遥测决策统一到一个生成式基础模型中的可行性和有效性。

Abstract: Modern computing and networking infrastructure emits telemetry continuously, yet operators convert it into decisions with a separate predictor per task, entity, and horizon. One generative model, pretrained once over an operator's own event streams, could replace this fleet, an approach that already scales to high-cardinality streams in recommendation systems. However, point-forecast error on operational telemetry saturates near simple last-value baselines, so lower error alone need not improve the decisions it feeds. To close this gap, we present \sys, a generative foundation model for network and systems telemetry, evaluated by replaying the decisions its calibrated conditional quantiles drive. \sys treats heterogeneous telemetry as event-driven, irregularly timed entity streams and serves flexible forecast horizons in a single pass, requiring no future timestamps. To our knowledge, \sys is the first pretrained telemetry model to improve both HPC scheduling and network provisioning decisions under replay, its runtime estimator transferring zero-shot across months and its pretrained weights across domains from hours of target data. Extensive experiments on HPC job logs and network traffic confirm that \sys lowers the mean bounded slowdown of backfilling by up to approximately $77\%$ over deployed user estimates and roughly halves the deployed rule's violation rate. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZzZTripleZzZ/all-in-one.

</details>


### [433] [Predictive Exposure and Cryptographic Readiness: A Vendor-Neutral Framework, a, Bounded Multivocal Evidence Analysis, and Reproducible Synthetic Evaluation for SD-WAN Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01728)
*Saeed Alam*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本研究提出一个厂商中立的PECR框架，用于替代静态CVSS评分进行SD-WAN漏洞优先级排序，并通过合成案例比较验证其可产生不同且可审计的排名结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SD-WAN团队常使用静态严重性评分（如CVSS）来决定修复优先级，但这些评分无法反映实时利用情况、网络暴露面、攻击路径、业务影响或密码迁移风险。需要探索是否存在一个更全面、可追溯的替代框架。

Method: 通过审查2020-2026年间19篇DOI验证的出版物和5份NIST文档，归纳出十个归一化因子、一个加权评分和独立的置信度度量。构建PECR框架，并与CVSS在五个合成案例中进行对比，使用Kendall's τ_b、MARS、J3、因子移除和权重变化边界等统计方法评估。

Result: CVSS排名为A-D-B-E-C，PECR排名为A-B-E-C-D。统计结果为τ_b=0.40，MARS=1.2，J3=0.50。精确τ检验不显著（p=0.483），因样本量仅5个。PECR排名在87.5%的1,024种权重组合中保持不变，并在10个单因子移除测试中的8个保持不变。

Conclusion: 证据支持将严重性、利用性和组织上下文分开度量。PECR能产生不同且可审计的排名，但实时SD-WAN攻击路径和每日PQC分诊的证据仍然有限。该合成测试不能证明更好的运营结果或更好的人类理解。

Abstract: SD-WAN teams often use static severity scores to decide what to fix first. These scores do not show live exploitation, network exposure, attack paths, business impact, or cryptographic migration risk. This study asks whether a vendor-neutral PECR framework can produce a different and more traceable ranking than CVSS alone. We reviewed 19 DOI-verified publications from 2020-2026 and five current NIST documents. The review supported ten normalized factors, one weighted score, and a separate confidence measure. We then compared equal-weight PECR with CVSS in five synthetic cases. The tests used Kendall's $τ_b$, mean absolute rank shift (MARS), top-three Jaccard overlap ($J_3$), factor removal, and bounded weight changes. CVSS ranked the cases A-D-B-E-C. PECR ranked them A-B-E-C-D. The results were $τ_b = 0.40$, MARS = 1.2, and $J_3 = 0.50$. The exact $τ$ test was not significant ($p = 0.483$) because the sample had only five cases. The PECR order remained unchanged in 87.5% of 1,024 weight combinations. It also remained unchanged in eight of ten single-factor removal tests. The evidence supports separate measures for severity, exploitation, and organizational context. Evidence for live SD-WAN attack paths and daily PQC triage is still limited. PECR can produce a different and auditable ranking. This synthetic test does not prove better operational results or better human understanding.

</details>


### [434] [Cross-Layer Optimization and System-Level Design of Next-Generation Wireless Networks via Intelligent RAN Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02067)
*Maria Tsampazi*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本博士论文聚焦于NextG（6G）无线接入网的设计、优化与实验评估，将Open RAN架构、数据驱动的闭环控制与智能资源分配相结合，涵盖DRL网络切片与调度、PandORA自动化框架、RIS信道建模与资源分配、RIS与Open RAN集成、在线强化学习链路自适应以及蜂窝与非地面网络间的频谱共享等七大贡献，并完成了从仿真到硬件在环再到5G外场实验的全链条验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RAN正在向开放、可编程、解耦和智能化的Open RAN演进，未来NextG网络需要具备AI原生能力以实现数据驱动的闭环优化，同时RIS被视为6G及未来通信中提升无线传播和频谱效率的关键技术。论文旨在解决如何将Open RAN、智能控制和RIS有效整合，从而实现实时可重构以满足6G需求的核心挑战。

Method: 论文采用分层次的研究方法：首先分析架构使能器和建模框架，随后在实验平台和数字孪生上进行原型验证。具体方法包括：基于DRL的智能网络切片与调度算法、PandORA自动化设计训练部署框架（基于Colosseum无线网络仿真器）、RIS物理层信道建模与跨频段资源优化、系统级eMBB/URLLC性能评估、RIS与Open RAN的架构集成、在线强化学习链路自适应方案，以及通过功率控制与波束成形实现蜂窝与NTN链路的频谱共享。

Result: 论文实现了七项主要成果：(i) DRL驱动的网络切片与调度方案；(ii) PandORA框架实现DRL Open RAN应用的自动设计、训练和部署；(iii) RIS物理层信道建模与跨频段优化资源分配；(iv) RIS辅助信道的eMBB/URLLC系统级评估；(v) RIS与Open RAN的成功集成；(vi) 基于在线RL的链路自适应解决方案；(vii) 通过功率控制和波束成形实现蜂窝与NTN频谱共享。验证范围覆盖仿真、硬件在环仿真到5G试验台外场实验。

Conclusion: 本工作提供了从算法设计、框架构建到多层级实验验证的完整研究体系，证明了融合Open RAN理念、AI驱动控制回路和RIS技术的NextG RAN能够在实际系统中实现实时可重构，满足6G对智能化和高谱效的要求，同时为产业界和学术界提供了可复用的无线研究平台与方法论。

Abstract: Recent years have seen the evolution of the traditional Radio Access Network (RAN) toward more open, programmable, disaggregated, and intelligent architectures, known as an Open RAN. Future Next Generation (NextG) networks are envisioned to be AI-native, enabling data-driven closed-loop optimization of Base Station resources, while Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) emerge as key enablers for wireless propagation and spectral efficiency toward 6G and beyond. This dissertation focuses on the design, optimization, and experimental evaluation of NextG RANs integrating Open RAN principles, data-driven control loops, and intelligent resource allocation. The work emphasizes cross-layer optimization, including energy-efficient power control, and explores AI-driven network slicing, scheduling, and link adaptation, demonstrating NextG RANs reconfigurable in real time to meet 6G requirements, first analyzing architectural enablers and modeling frameworks, then prototyping and evaluating solutions on experimental platforms and Digital Twins. Main contributions include: (i) Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) solutions for network slicing and scheduling; (ii) PandORA, a framework for automatic design, training, and deployment of DRL-based Open RAN applications on the Colosseum wireless network emulator; (iii) physical-layer RIS channel modeling and optimized resource allocation across spectrum bands; (iv) system-level evaluation of RIS-assisted channels for eMBB and URLLC traffic; (v) integration of RIS within Open RAN; (vi) online RL solutions for link adaptation; and (vii) spectrum sharing between cellular and Non-Terrestrial Network links via power control and beamforming. This work provides algorithmic designs, frameworks, and validation from simulation and hardware-in-the-loop emulation to over-the-air 5G testbed experiments, addressing industry and academic needs for wireless research.

</details>


### [435] [Energy-Latency Trade-offs in O-RAN with Distributed Baseband Processing and AI Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02082)
*Urooj Tariq,Rishu Raj,Shashi Raj Pandey,Merim Dzaferagic,Petar Popovski,Dan Kilper*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文为O-RAN架构提出了一种端到端的能量消耗与延迟建模框架，并在此基础上构建优化问题，研究基带处理和AI推理任务在不同功能拆分配置下的最优部署位置，揭示能量效率与延迟之间的根本性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: O-RAN架构虽然通过灵活的功能拆分和开放接口提升了资源利用率，但引入了能量效率与延迟之间的根本性权衡。现有研究缺乏一个能够统一建模处理、传输和AI推理能耗与延迟的端到端框架，难以支撑实际部署决策。

Method: 提出基于吞吐量的端到端能量消耗模型，并扩展了详细的延迟建模和针对特定应用的AI/ML推理成本。该框架涵盖访问、城域和长途网络段的处理、传输和推理相关的能量与延迟。在此基础上，构建一个优化问题，在给定网络负载、服务器频率和能量预算约束下，选择基带处理和AI推理任务的最优部署位置。

Result: 基于代表性硬件平台和现实流量假设，评估了多种基带处理部署方案。结果显示用户QoS需求和网络负载条件共同决定了基带处理与AI推理任务的最优部署位置，揭示并量化了能量效率与延迟之间的固有权衡。

Conclusion: 研究为延迟感知和能量高效的O-RAN部署提供了实用见解，特别是对于支持新兴AI驱动服务的场景，有助于指导实际网络配置决策。

Abstract: The Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) architecture introduces flexible functional splits and open interfaces that enable distributed and centralized deployment of baseband processing. While this flexibility offers opportunities for improved resource utilization, it also introduces fundamental trade-offs between energy efficiency and latency. In this paper, we develop a throughput-based end-to-end energy consumption model for O-RAN and extend it by incorporating detailed latency modeling and application-specific Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning inference costs.
