TL;DR: 本文提出COVE框架，统一了基于工具（harness-based）和基于参数（parameter-based）两种智能体自进化方式，通过任务感知路由、阶段感知调度和知识优化来协调两种通道，在动态环境下实现更鲁棒高效的自进化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体自进化方法分为两类：基于工具的方法将反馈外化为可编辑记忆或技能以快速适应，基于参数的方法将经验内化到模型参数中以实现深层能力提升。但单独使用任一机制都会在灵活性和性能之间产生权衡，缺乏协调两种通道的统一框架。

Method: COVE框架包含三个关键设计：任务感知路由（task-aware routing）用于匹配任务与合适的学习机制，阶段感知调度（stage-aware scheduling）管理不同进化阶段的策略切换，以及知识优化（knowledge optimization）对获取的知识进行提炼和整合。

Result: 在多个任务类别上的实验表明，COVE优于单一通道的进化策略，在变化环境中展现出更鲁棒和高效的性能提升。

Conclusion: COVE证明智能体自进化不应被看作经验的盲目累积，而应是一个协调过程，将任务和知识类型匹配到恰当的学习机制，从而实现灵活性与性能兼得的鲁棒自进化。

Abstract: Large language model agents increasingly operate in dynamic environments where tool interfaces, APIs, and user requirements change after deployment. Existing self-evolution methods mainly follow two paradigms: harness-based approaches, which externalize feedback into editable memories or skills for rapid adaptation, and parameter-based approaches, which internalize experience into model parameters for deeper capability improvement. However, using either mechanism alone creates a trade-off between flexibility and performance. This paper asks how an agent can coordinate both channels to achieve robust self-evolution. We present COVE, a unified agent self-evolution framework that combines harness-based and parameter-based learning through task-aware routing, stage-aware scheduling, and knowledge optimization. Through this design, COVE treats self-evolution not as indiscriminate accumulation of experience, but as a coordinated process that matches tasks and knowledge types to appropriate learning mechanisms. Experiments across multiple task categories show that COVE outperforms single-channel evolution strategies, demonstrating more robust and efficient improvement under changing environments.

</details>


### [535] [Cognitive Demand Steering for Adaptive Meta-Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01319)
*John Scoville,Shengzhuang Chen,Yejin Bang,Stefan Winzeck,Jonathan Richard Schwarz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出认知需求引导（CDS），一种免训练的无认知推理框架。它通过基于LLM的进度评估器在前向视角下评估剩余推理需求，并使用认知量表（16个维度）进行细粒度诊断和干预设计，在三个前沿LLM和六个推理基准上平均提升21.9%的准确率（对比直接调用）和9%（对比标准CoT）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无认知推理框架存在三个主要问题：依赖后向奖励函数（只评估上一步）、使用粗糙的搜索动作、或需要额外训练推理控制器并要求大量少样本监督。这些限制制约了推理性能与跨模型跨任务的迁移能力。

Method: CDS包含两个核心组件：（1）前向剩余需求评估：基于LLM的进度评估器在每个步骤表征到达解决方案所需的剩余推理量，而非仅评估上一步；（2）认知量表驱动的干预选择：借鉴认知科学的16个维度（如注意与扫描、学习与抽象、时空物理推理），用于刻画初始问题复杂度、追踪剩余需求信号，并设计包括通用示例和动作在内的推理干预。整个框架无需训练组件，支持零样本跨模型跨任务迁移。

Result: 在三个前沿LLM和六个推理基准上，CDS相比直接调用提升21.9%准确率，相比标准CoT提升9%，在困难数学和编程任务上提升最大。

Conclusion: 通过将后向评估转向前向的剩余需求评估，并利用认知科学驱动的细粒度量表，CDS在无需训练的条件下显著提升了LLM的推理能力，验证了前向需求信号在无认知推理控制中的有效性。

Abstract: Recent meta-reasoning frameworks improve LLM reasoning by wrapping chain-of-thought generation in an iterative control loop, allowing more effective backtracking, termination of reasoning loops, and injection of promising reasoning patterns, among other strategy adjustments. Despite promising results, methods often rely on backward-looking reward functions, utilize coarse search actions, or require additional reasoning controller training requiring many-shot supervision. We introduce Cognitive Demand Steering (CDS), a training-free meta-reasoning framework equipped with residual demand assessment: at each step, an LLM-based progress evaluator characterizes the residual reasoning required to arrive at a solution rather than merely evaluating the previous step. This allows a meta-controller to select reasoning interventions comprising both general-purpose exemplars and actions (e.g., general guidance for quantitative reasoning) that directly tackle this forward-looking demand signal. This shift eliminates the need for any trained component while enabling zero-shot transfer across models and tasks with no adaptation. Rather than relying on coarse characterizations, we employ cognitive scales to both design interventions as well as profile initial problem complexity and residual demand signal over 16 dimensions motivated by cognitive science (e.g., attention and scan, learning and abstraction, spatio-physical reasoning), giving the controller a fine-grained vocabulary for diagnosing. Averaged across three frontier LLMs and six reasoning benchmarks, CDS improves accuracy by $21.9\%$ over direct calls and $9\%$ over standard CoT reasoning, with the largest gains on difficult mathematics and coding tasks.

</details>


### [536] [G-ReAct: Graph-Guided Deep Search via Structure-State Co-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01324)
*Shaoxiong Yang,Mengyuan Zhang,Shaojun Lin,Chao Li,Wei Liu,Kun Shao,Jian Luan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: G-ReAct是一个用于大语言模型深度搜索的推理框架，将推理组织为在固定拓扑查询图上的状态演化，显式跟踪搜索进度并指导后续决策，解决长程多跳搜索中的上下文遗忘、搜索漂移和低效探索问题。仅用1.9K生成轨迹微调Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507，即在BrowseComp-ZH上达到52.6%准确率，在XBench上达到79.0%，超越了使用更大数据集训练的包括RL增强方法在内的开源方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度搜索方法依赖线性顺序推理进行轨迹生成和推断，难以在长程多跳搜索中持续保持中间状态和约束，导致上下文遗忘、搜索漂移和低效探索等问题。

Method: G-ReAct将推理组织为固定拓扑查询图上的状态演化，用演化的图状态显式跟踪搜索进度并指导决策，将基于文本历史的探索性搜索转化为在显式约束下的图引导推理。它同时支持训练（生成高质量轨迹用于监督微调）和推理（无需额外微调即可为推理时搜索提供结构化指导）。

Result: 仅用1.9K生成的轨迹微调Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507，在BrowseComp-ZH上达到52.6%准确率，在XBench上达到79.0%，优于使用更大数据集训练的包括RL增强方法在内的开源方法。推理时应用G-ReAct也能一致提升现有强LLM在深度搜索任务上的性能。

Conclusion: G-ReAct通过图结构状态演化的方式有效解决了深度搜索中的上下文保持和搜索引导问题，在数据效率和性能上均展现出优势，并将开源所有代码和模型权重。

Abstract: Deep search has become a fundamental capability of large language models (LLMs) for solving open-domain complex tasks. However, existing approaches typically rely on linear sequential reasoning for both trajectory generation and inference, making it difficult to consistently preserve intermediate states and constraints throughout long-horizon multi-hop search. Consequently, they often suffer from context forgetting, search drift, and inefficient exploration. To address these limitations, we propose $\textbf{G-ReAct}$, a reasoning framework for deep search that organizes reasoning as $\textbf{state evolution over a fixed-topology query graph}$. The evolving graph state explicitly tracks search progress and guides subsequent decisions, transforming exploratory search driven by textual history into graph-guided reasoning under explicit constraints. G-ReAct supports both training and inference: it generates high-quality deep-search trajectories for supervised fine-tuning and provides structured guidance for inference-time search without additional fine-tuning. Experiments demonstrate that with only 1.9K generated trajectories for fine-tuning, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 achieves $52.6\%$ accuracy on BrowseComp-ZH and $79.0\%$ on XBench, outperforming comparable open-source methods trained on substantially larger datasets, including RL-enhanced methods. Furthermore, when applied at inference time, G-ReAct consistently improves the performance of existing strong LLMs on deep-search tasks. We will publicly release all code and model weights.

</details>


### [537] [402Pilot: An x402 Decision Layer for Autonomous Agent Micropayments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01341)
*Yin Li,Yanbo He,Boo-Ho Yang,Rav Lawana,Ziyue Li,Wei Zeng,Jing Tang,Fugee Tsung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出402Pilot，一个协议无关的买方侧决策层，用于解决有限钱包下自主代理的程序化支付决策问题；其核心策略PA-DCT是一种支付感知的折扣上下文汤普森采样策略，在823个任务、五种提供商管线、三种市场机制下的基准测试中实现了最优的非神谕固定钱包自适应权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可编程支付协议（如x402）支持按请求微支付，但未解决在有限钱包下自主代理应选择哪项可付费服务的问题。现有工作缺乏对买方侧支付决策的形式化研究，这是自主代理在真实经济环境中运作的关键空白。

Method: 1) 将问题形式化为"代理原生支付决策"：在钱包压力下的上下文提供商选择、仅付费反馈、变化的市场条件。2) 提出402Pilot，协议无关的买方侧决策层。3) 提出PA-DCT策略，将钱包压力融入折扣上下文汤普森采样，并从支付后反馈中学习。4) 构建402Pilot-Bench基准，包含823个任务、五种提供商管线、三种市场机制，每场景30对种子。

Result: PA-DCT在非神谕策略中实现最强固定钱包自适应权衡：保持竞争力的服务质量同时仅花费钱包的39-43%，并随市场条件变化重新分配支出。在价格冲击下取得最佳非神谕PA-gap/T，在9个场景-指标组合（质量、ROI、PA-gap/T）中取得最佳均值与最差情况排名。消融实验支持策略设计的有效性。

Conclusion: 可编程支付必须辅以买方侧决策能力，使代理能够学习服务价值并相应调整购买决策。这为自主代理经济系统中的支付决策提供了基础框架和基准。

Abstract: Programmable-payment protocols such as x402 enable per-request micropayments, but they do not determine which payable service an autonomous agent should buy under a finite wallet. We formulate this buyer-side problem as agent-native payment decision-making: contextual provider selection under wallet pressure, chosen-only paid feedback, and changing market conditions. We propose 402Pilot, a protocol-agnostic buyer-side decision layer between autonomous agents and payment execution that implements purchasing policies for selecting among payable providers. We instantiate it with PA-DCT, a payment-aware discounted contextual Thompson-sampling policy that adapts purchasing decisions under wallet pressure while learning from post-payment feedback. To evaluate buyer-side payment policies, we introduce 402Pilot-Bench, a frozen-replay benchmark spanning 823 tasks, five heterogeneous provider pipelines, and three market regimes, each evaluated over 30 paired seeds. PA-DCT achieves the strongest fixed-wallet adaptive trade-off among non-oracle policies: it maintains competitive service quality while spending only 39 to 43 percent of the wallet and reallocates spending as market conditions change. It attains the best non-oracle PA-gap/T under the price shock and the best mean and worst-case ranks across the nine scenario-metric combinations of quality, ROI, and PA-gap/T. Comparisons with learning baselines and component ablations further support the effectiveness and design of the proposed decision policy. These results suggest that programmable payment must be complemented by buyer-side decision-making capable of learning service value and adapting purchasing decisions accordingly.

</details>


### [538] [Agentic Stage-One Stellarator Optimization: Autonomous Multi-Objective Search for Finite-Beta Equilibria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01344)
*Tingjia Zhang,Hongke Lu,Zhuoran Meng,Runlai Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于语言模型代理(agent)的恒星优化器(stellarator)第一阶段设计自动化方法。通过让语言模型代理诊断当前平衡态并选择下一个局部优化实验，同时由确定性DESC代码执行控制函数，在有限测试预算下将门控有效配置从5个增加到19个，同时显著改善了拟对称性(QS)和曲率指标，并生成了734条可复用的决策数据记录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 恒星优化器的第一阶段设计需要在高维三维等离子体边界空间中搜索满足约束(约束、场线拓扑、力平衡、稳定性、几何)的配置，但缺乏从规格到验证的有限β平衡的通用构造方法。现有方法依赖迭代数值优化，其效果取决于初始配置、Fourier分辨率、目标优先级和求解预算，过程计算昂贵且依赖专家经验，限制了设计吞吐量和高一致性数据的产生。

Method: 提出"代理式(agentic)"第一阶段优化框架：有界语言模型代理负责诊断当前平衡状态并选择下一个局部优化实验；确定性DESC代码负责执行指定的轮廓、通量、对称性、度量评估、求解器有效性和接受标准。两者分工明确，代理做高层决策，DESC做底层确定性验证。

Result: 在有限预算实验中，门控有效配置从5个输入增加到19个输出；中位Boozer拟对称性均方根从2.39×10⁻⁴降至1.07×10⁻⁴；中位最大主曲率从62.56降至33.00 m⁻¹。长程路径实现了9.10倍拟对称性改善，同时修复了磁阱和曲率缺陷。系统共记录734条结构化的父代-动作-结果(parent-action-outcome)过渡记录。

Conclusion: 代理式外环控制能够维持有限β多目标搜索，将重复优化转变为可扩展的改进平衡态和可复用决策数据来源，证明了语言模型代理在恒星优化器自动化设计中的概念有效性。

Abstract: Stage-one stellarator design searches a high-dimensional family of three-dimensional plasma boundaries and fixed-boundary MHD equilibria for configurations that jointly meet requirements on confinement, field-line topology, force balance, stability proxies, and geometry. These specifications do not provide a general constructive map to a validated finite-beta equilibrium. High-quality targets are commonly developed through iterative numerical optimization whose outcome depends on the initial configuration, active Fourier resolution, objective priorities, and local solver budget. Coordinating this process is computationally costly and expert-intensive, limiting both design throughput and the production of consistently evaluated data. We present a proof of concept for \emph{agentic} stage-one optimization. A bounded language-model agent diagnoses the current equilibrium and selects the next local optimization experiment, while deterministic DESC execution owns prescribed profiles and flux, symmetry, metric evaluation, solver validity, and acceptance. On a common-budget subset from an expanding finite-beta campaign, the number of gate-valid configurations increases from five inputs to nineteen outputs; median Boozer QS RMS decreases from $2.39\times10^{-4}$ to $1.07\times10^{-4}$, and median maximum principal curvature decreases from $62.56$ to $33.00\,\mathrm{m}^{-1}$. A complementary long route achieves a $9.10\times$ QS reduction while repairing magnetic-well and curvature defects. The system also records every attempted local action as transition evidence, yielding 734 structured parent--action--outcome records in the reported experiments. These results show that agentic outer-loop control can sustain finite-beta, multi-objective search and turn repeated optimization into a scalable source of improved equilibria and reusable decision data.

</details>


### [539] [High-Stakes Decisions with Language Models: Insights from Emergency Triage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01361)
*Khurram Yamin,Christopher Kelly,Bryan Wilder,Eric Horvitz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将语言模型在高风险临床决策（如急诊分诊）中的应用纳入概率决策框架，通过可编辑的效用函数来显式指定不同行动的代价，从而更系统地评估和部署语言模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险不确定性决策（如医疗急诊分诊）不仅需要准确预测，还需要在考虑不同行动后果的基础上估计各种结果的概率。然而，语言模型在用于高风险临床推荐时，往往没有显式指定支配这些决策的效用函数。这导致其决策行为缺乏可解释性和可调控性。

Method: 使用来自消费者分诊系统的结构化临床情境评估，在多种替代效用函数（规定错过紧急情况和不必要升级的相对成本）下分析语言模型的治疗推荐。

Result: 研究发现，有能力的大语言模型会根据给定的效用函数调整其推荐，表明相同的底层预测可以支持截然不同的决策策略。

Conclusion: 有效的部署不仅依赖于改进预测能力，还取决于显式化决策目标。语言模型应被视为概率决策系统，其推荐质量取决于预测性能与显式效用的联合作用。

Abstract: High-stakes decisions under uncertainty, such as medical emergency triage, require more than accurate predictions. They depend on estimating the likelihood of alternative outcomes while explicitly weighing the consequences of different actions, principles that have long formed the foundation of medical diagnosis and decision making. Yet language models are increasingly used for high-stakes clinical recommendations without explicit specification of the utilities governing these decisions. Here we show that emergency triage with language models can be understood within a probabilistic decision framework, providing a case study of a broader decision-analytic paradigm for steering, evaluating, and deploying language models in high-stakes settings. Using clinical vignettes from a structured evaluation of a consumer triage system, we analyze recommendations for treatment under alternative utility functions that specify the relative costs of missed emergencies and unnecessary escalation. We find that capable language models adjust recommendations in response to stated utilities, revealing that the same underlying predictions can support markedly different decision policies. These findings show that effective deployment depends not only on improving predictions but also on making decision objectives explicit. More broadly, they suggest that language models for high-stakes applications should be understood and evaluated as probabilistic decision systems whose recommendations depend jointly on predictive performance and explicit utilities.

</details>


### [540] [CRAFTS: Collaborative Role-Adaptive Fine-Tuning of LLM Agents for Chemical Process Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01369)
*Ziyun Zhang,Yuxin Lin,Eldin Wee Chuan Lim,Xinghao Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CRAFTS，一个基于多角色分工的自动化化工过程建模系统。它通过将建模任务分解为七个有界子任务，结合确定性IDAES/Pyomo工程门控和类型化中间表示，实现了从自然语言需求到可执行化工过程模型的全自动构建，在450例数据集上达到91.5%的契约完成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化工过程模型的构建目前仍高度依赖人工，工程师需要处理单元操作、热力学、流股、规格、自由度、初始化、求解器修复和优化等耦合决策，一个错误就可能导致模型失效。现有方法缺乏系统化、模块化的自动建模框架来应对这一复杂流程。

Method: CRAFTS模拟化工工程师的分阶段工作流程，将仿真构建分解为七个有界角色（负责输入理解与意图、视觉、拓扑、规格、建计划、调试和优化）。系统使用确定性IDAES/Pyomo门控在各阶段间进行验证，仅对视觉、拓扑和规格三个模式关键角色进行微调，其余角色使用未微调的Qwen模型。各角色生成VisualGraphIR、TopologyIR、SpecIR、BuildPlan和SolveReport等类型化中间表示，只有在语义工件通过工程门控后才附加兼容的构造器、物性包和求解器。

Result: 作者引入OpenIDAES-450数据集（450例IDAES过程仿真案例），在冻结的82例测试集上评估完整七角色LangChain/LangGraph工作流。CRAFTS在91.5%的案例中完成规定验证和执行契约，单元、流股和有向连接的F1分数分别达到0.815、0.791和0.782。

Conclusion: 结果表明角色专业化、类型化中间表示和确定性工程门控对于可靠的自动化过程模型构建是有效的，为化工过程仿真的自动化提供了新范式。

Abstract: Constructing an executable chemical-process model remains manually intensive. Chemical engineers translate underspecified requests into coupled decisions about unit operations, thermodynamics, streams, specifications, degrees of freedom (DoF), initialization, solver repair, and optimization; one error can invalidate the model. CRAFTS mirrors the staged workflow of chemical engineers by decomposing simulation building into bounded subtasks assigned to seven bounded roles, with deterministic IDAES/Pyomo gates between stages. Given a natural-language request, process flowsheet diagram (PFD) evidence, and curated chemical-engineering knowledge, Input Understanding and Intent recover requirements, constraints, and process semantics; visual, topology, and specification specialists translate them into typed simulator contracts; and Debug and Optimization support bounded repair and eligible optimization. Fine-tuning is applied to the three schema-critical visual, topology, and specification roles, while the remaining roles use untuned Qwen. The resulting VisualGraphIR, TopologyIR, SpecIR, BuildPlan, and SolveReport expose unit, port, thermodynamic, numerical, and execution decisions. Compatible constructors, property packages, and runners are attached only after semantic artifacts pass engineering gates. We introduce OpenIDAES-450, a 450-case IDAES process- simulation dataset, and evaluate the complete seven-role LangChain/LangGraph workflow through solve and eligible optimization on its frozen 82-case held-out split. CRAFTS completes the prescribed validation and execution contract for for 91.5% of cases and achieves unit, stream, and directed-connection F1 scores of 0.815, 0.791, and 0.782. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of role specialization, typed intermediate representations, and deterministic engineering gates for reliable automated process-model construction.

</details>


### [541] [CraftAlign: Feature-Grounded Evaluation and Revision Guidance for AI Stories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01377)
*Yang Yang,Boyun Xu,Shaofeng Liang,Yun Han,Zining Zhong,Songning Lai,Kaishen Yuan,Yutao Yue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CraftAlign是一个将AI故事与人类叙事技艺对齐的框架，通过预测304个写作特征、用类别条件能量模型评分人类/AI写作模式，并在推理时通过结构化扰动生成自然语言修订指导，以改善AI生成故事中的陈词滥调、过度解释等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型虽能生成流畅完整的故事，但输出往往带有公式化、不自然的"AI味"（陈词滥调、过度解释、线性因果推进、刻板结局）。现有检测与评估方法只停留在来源标签或整体分数层面，而修订方法通常针对预定义问题做局部编辑，难以支持多种合理修订策略或引导故事级的信息释放、因果组织和结局处理变化。

Method: CraftAlign包含两个学习模块和一个推理时引导流水线：(1) 基于Qwen3.5-9B的特征估计器，预测304个显式写作特征（涵盖风格和叙事）；(2) 类别条件能量模型，在原始写作提示（如可用）条件下，对特征配置与人类/AI写作模式的匹配度进行评分。推理时，应用schema验证的结构化扰动，选择能将特征配置移向人类写作模式的改变，并将其转换为自然语言指导，供独立编辑器重写完整故事。

Result: 实验表明，CraftAlign能够准确区分人类与AI写作模式，其生成的重写指导在多个编辑器和人类研究中均优于修订基线方法。

Conclusion: CraftAlign验证了通过细粒度写作特征建模和能量模型引导的方式，能够有效检测并改善AI生成故事与人类叙事之间的风格差距，为后续AI写作对齐研究提供了新方向。

Abstract: Large language models can now generate fluent and complete stories, yet many outputs still feel formulaic and unnatural because of cliches, over-explanation, linear causal progression, and stereotyped endings, an immediately recognizable AI flavor. Existing detection and evaluation methods often stop at source labels or holistic scores, while revision methods typically target predefined issues through localized edits, limiting their ability to support multiple plausible revision strategies or guide story-wide changes in information release, causal organization, and ending treatment. We introduce CraftAlign, a framework that aligns AI stories with the craft of human storytelling by both assessing Human/AI writing patterns and providing revision guidance. CraftAlign comprises two learned modules and an inference-time guidance pipeline. A feature estimator built on Qwen3.5-9B predicts 304 explicit writing features spanning style and narrative. A class-conditional energy model scores the resulting feature configuration against Human and AI writing patterns, conditioning on the original writing prompt when available. At inference time, CraftAlign applies schema-valid structured perturbations, selects changes that move the feature configuration toward the Human writing pattern, and converts them into natural-language guidance for a separate editor to rewrite the full story. Experiments show that CraftAlign accurately distinguishes Human and AI writing patterns and that its guidance outperforms revision baselines across editors and in a human study.

</details>


### [542] [KoVRE: Training an Efficient Embedding Model for Korean Visual Document Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01389)
*Yongbin Choi,Gyuho Shim,Youngjoon Jang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出KoVRE，一个面向韩语视觉文档检索的单向量嵌入模型。通过在708,729个韩英查询页面配上使用正感知难负样本挖掘进行训练，并配合重排序器知识蒸馏等策略，2B参数的KoVRE在韩语VDR基准上超越了8B单向量模型和强多向量基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉文档检索（VDR）模型和训练资源以英语为中心，且高性能系统依赖大规模骨干网络或存储密集的多向量表示，缺乏高效的韩语VDR解决方案。

Method: 构建708,729个韩英查询-页面训练对，采用正感知难负样本挖掘（positive-aware hard-negative mining）训练单向量检索模型，并对训练数据组成、难负样本处理和基于重排序器的知识蒸馏进行受控分析。

Result: 2B参数的KoVRE在韩语VDR基准上显著优于基础骨干模型，同时超越8B单向量模型和强多向量基线，证明了无需扩大骨干网络或多向量表示即可取得优异性能。

Conclusion: 针对性的双语监督和精心设计的训练策略能够在不扩大模型规模或不使用多向量表示的情况下，构建出跨多种文档领域的高效韩语VDR模型。

Abstract: Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) directly matches text queries against document images, preserving visual and structural information that may be lost during text extraction. However, existing VDR models and training resources remain predominantly English-centric, while many high-performing systems rely on massive backbones or storage-intensive multi-vector representations. To address these limitations, we introduce KoVRE: Korean Visual Document Retrieval Embedding, a single-vector retriever for Korean visual documents, alongside a comprehensive training recipe. We train the model on 708,729 Korean and English query-page pairs using positive-aware hard-negative mining and conduct controlled analyses of training-data composition, hard-negative treatment, and reranker-based knowledge distillation. Across Korean visual document retrieval benchmarks, our 2B model substantially improves over the base backbone model, outperforming both its 8B single-vector counterpart and a strong multi-vector baseline. These results demonstrate that targeted bilingual supervision and our carefully designed training strategies can produce a highly effective Korean VDR model across diverse document domains, without requiring a scaled-up backbone or multi-vector representations.

</details>


### [543] [No Single Neuron of Failure: Distributed Safety Alignment Against White-Box Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01414)
*Simiao Xie,Chuancheng Shi,Shangze Li,Wenhua Wu,Fei Shen,Ying Zhou,Zhiyong Wang,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出分布式安全对齐（DSA）方法，将安全能力冗余编码到多个计算神经元中，以抵御白盒神经元级安全攻击，避免因关键安全神经元被破坏而导致的安全单点故障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着开源大模型的快速发布，安全威胁从黑盒越狱转向白盒神经元级攻击。现有对齐方法往往只依赖少量神经元来维持安全行为，存在脆弱性和冗余不足的问题，一旦关键安全神经元被攻击者识别和操纵，模型的安全防线就会崩溃。

Method: DSA方法包括三个关键步骤：(1) 将干预定位到语言侧前馈网络的下投影层输入，将每个特征坐标视为单个神经元的激活；(2) 结合神经元激活与损失梯度，计算方向感知的一阶Taylor分数，全局识别对当前拒绝行为贡献最大的神经元；(3) 通过确定性掩码和随机dropout的耦合进行定向破坏，迫使模型放弃狭窄的安全神经元，将安全行为冗余编码到多个补偿神经元中。

Result: 大量实验表明，DSA在保持模型通用语言和多模态能力的同时，显著提升了模型对白盒神经元级安全攻击的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: DSA通过分布式冗余编码安全能力，有效解决了现有对齐方法中安全神经元单一脆弱的问题，为开源大模型的安全防护提供了更稳健的方案。

Abstract: With the rapid release of open-weight large foundation models, safety threats are shifting from black-box jailbreaks to neuron-level white-box attacks that directly identify and manipulate safety-related neurons. Existing alignment methods often investigate the safety behavior on a small number of neurons, creating fragile single point of failure with limited redundancy. To address this issue, we propose distributed safety alignment (DSA), which redundantly encodes safety capabilities across multiple computational neurons, ensuring that the model maintains its safety baseline even when critical safety neurons are disrupted. Specifically, we localize the intervention to the inputs of the down-projection layers in language-side feed-forward networks and treat each feature coordinate as the activation of an individual neuron. DSA then combines neuron activations with loss gradients to compute a direction-aware first-order Taylor score that globally identifies the neurons that contribute most to the current refusal behavior of the model. Finally, targeted disruption via deterministic masking and stochastic dropout is coupled, forcing the model to abandon narrow safety neurons and redundantly encode safety behavior across multiple compensatory neurons. Extensive experiments show that DSA substantially improves robustness against white-box neuron-level safety attacks while preserving the model's general language and multimodal utility.

</details>


### [544] [Reusing Rollouts under Policy Lag: Prefix-Normalized Policy Optimization for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01418)
*Wenhao Zhang,Yibo Xie,Rui Wang,Jiahua Yang,Lei Jiang,Zibo Yang,Yawei Wang,Jiali Xu,jasperawang,Haoyang Long,Huan Xiong,alantzhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了一种名为Prefix-Normalized Policy Optimization (PNPO)的离策略强化学习方法，通过将累积重要性比率替换为因果前缀上的几何平均似然比来修正离策略偏差。实验表明，在四轮策略更新的强离策略场景下，PNPO在长上下文数学推理基准上优于GSPO约3个百分点，且在匹配计算预算下能以更少的rollout批次达到相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型的强化学习中，自回归rollout生成是主要计算成本。重用每个rollout批次进行额外的学习者更新可以分摊这些成本，但后续更新会因学习者偏离行为策略而越来越离策略。精确的离策略修正需要累积重要性比率，但其乘积形式可能导致难以处理的动态范围，因此需要一种更稳定且保留因果前缀依赖的修正方法。

Method: PNPO在token位置用几何均值替代累积比率，即对每个因果前缀上的似然比取几何平均，既保留了各位置的因果前缀依赖，又压缩了对数权重尺度（将累加转换为平均）。实验通过控制每个rollout批次使用一轮或四轮策略更新来诱导不同强度的离策略场景。

Result: 在一轮更新场景下PNPO未持续优于GSPO；在四轮更新场景下，PNPO在每个基准上均达到最高的Avg@32观察值，三个独立选择基准峰值的未加权均值为50.24，比GSPO高3.00个百分点。在匹配2400次更新的预算下，四轮PNPO在150个rollout批次后达到最终宏Avg@32为49.66，与一轮600批次达到的49.56相当。

Conclusion: 研究提供了初步证据表明PNPO在训练进一步离策略时可能具有优势，特别是在多轮策略更新的场景下能以更少的rollout批次达到可比性能，从而更高效地分摊rollout生成的计算成本。

Abstract: Autoregressive rollout generation is a major computational cost in reinforcement learning for large language models. Reusing each rollout batch for additional learner updates amortizes this cost, but later updates become increasingly off-policy as the learner departs from the behavior policy. At a token position, exact off-policy correction must account for both the current action and the probability of reaching its prefix. The cumulative importance ratio provides this correction, but its product form can produce an unwieldy dynamic range. We study Prefix-Normalized Policy Optimization (PNPO), which replaces the cumulative ratio with the geometric mean of likelihood ratios along each causal prefix, preserving causal-prefix dependence at each position while compressing the log-weight scale. In controlled long-context mathematical reasoning experiments, we induce two off-policy regimes by using one or four policy-update epochs per rollout batch. PNPO does not consistently outperform GSPO with one epoch. With four epochs, it attains the highest observed Avg@32 on each benchmark; the unweighted mean of the three independently selected benchmark peaks is 50.24, 3.00 percentage points above GSPO. Under a matched 2,400-update budget, four-epoch PNPO reaches a final macro Avg@32 of 49.66 after 150 rollout batches, comparable to the 49.56 reached after 600 batches with one epoch. These results provide preliminary evidence that PNPO can be advantageous as training moves further off-policy.

</details>


### [545] [Scoring Rules! Statistical and Strategic Alignment for Text Evaluation Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01423)
*Shengwei Xu,Yuxuan Lu,Yifan Wu,Jason Hartline,Grant Schoenebeck*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于参考的文本评估指标在用作优化目标时的策略性博弈问题，提出了统计对齐与策略对齐两个互补概念，并通过人类评分相关性、退化敏感性和操控鲁棒性三个测试原则来评估指标。作者开发了一个基于互信息的统一设计框架，实验表明LLM评判者虽与人类评分相关度高但易被操控，而互信息类指标在操控鲁棒性上显著更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统评估指标仅以其与人类评分的统计相关性来判断可靠性，但当这些指标被用作优化目标时，智能体可能策略性地博弈（游戏）评估指标以获得虚高分数。因此，仅考虑相关性已不足以确保指标的可信性，需要更全面的对齐概念来应对这一挑战。

Method: 本文提出两个关键贡献：(1) 提出针对基于参考的指标的三项测试原则——人类评分相关性、退化敏感性和操控鲁棒性，分别评估指标是否与人类判断一致、是否惩罚低质量信息损失、是否抵抗策略性分数膨胀；(2) 建立统一的互信息类指标设计框架，将现有和新型指标分解为四个选择维度：信息度量、估计方法、文本表征和预测机制。

Result: 在同行评审、摘要生成和问答三个任务上，发现强人类评分相关性并不蕴含策略对齐：LLM评判者虽然相关性高但容易被操控；相比之下，互信息类指标在操控鲁棒性上有显著提升。该框架还发现了在实验中整体鲁棒性最强且人类评分相关性持平的新指标。

Conclusion: 评估指标需要同时满足统计对齐和策略对齐才能可靠用于优化场景。互信息框架提供了一种系统性的方式来设计既与人类判断一致又能抵抗策略性操控的评估指标。

Abstract: Reference-based text evaluation metrics, which are widely used to assess natural language generation systems, score a candidate response by comparing it with a reference response. The reliability of an evaluation metric is usually judged by its statistical correlation with human ratings. However, as these metrics are increasingly used as optimization objectives, correlation alone is no longer sufficient: agents may strategically game the evaluation metric. We study this issue through two complementary notions of alignment. A metric is statistically aligned if it correlates with human ratings and strategically aligned if it resists perturbations that do not add task-relevant information. We make two contributions. First, we propose test principles for reference-based metrics consisting of human-rating correlation, degradation sensitivity, and manipulation robustness. These principles evaluate whether a metric agrees with human judgments, penalizes low-effort information loss, and resists strategic score inflation. Second, we develop a unified design framework for mutual-information-based metrics that decomposes existing and new metrics into four choices: information measure, estimation method, text representation, and prediction mechanism. Across peer review, summarization, and question answering, we find that strong human-rating correlation does not imply strategic alignment: LLM-as-a-Judge achieves high correlation but is susceptible to manipulation. In contrast, mutual-information-based metrics substantially improve manipulation robustness. Our framework also uncovers a new metric that achieves the strongest overall robustness in our experiments while remaining competitive on human-rating correlation.

</details>


### [546] [MRAFnd: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Zero-Shot Fake News Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01430)
*Lehan Zhang,Yinlei Cheng,Shiqi Hu Yiheng Zhou,Shangxi Li,Naidong Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MRAFnd，一个多模态检索增强的零样本假新闻检测框架。该方法通过模拟分析师团队协作，结合多模态相似性新闻检索、双向证据推理和多智能体协作辩论三个阶段，在三个基准数据集上超越现有最先进方法，在Weibo-21数据集上准确率提升达2.35%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本假新闻检测方法存在两大缺陷：一是孤立地通过语义匹配评估新闻，无法识别来自过去事件的重复性虚假信息策略；二是缺乏识别跨模态细微差异所需的深度推理能力。

Method: MRAFnd框架包含三个阶段：(1) 多模态相似性新闻检索——从无标签参考数据库中收集上下文相似的文章；(2) 双向证据推理——智能体进行双方向分析以提取关键证据模式；(3) 多智能体协作辩论——由分析师和仲裁者智能体进行结构化讨论，得出最终结论。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上的综合实验表明，MRAFnd显著超越了最先进的基线方法，在具有挑战性的Weibo-21数据集上准确率提升最高达2.35%。

Conclusion: MRAFnd通过模拟协作式分析师团队，有效解决了零样本假新闻检测中的检索增强和推理能力不足问题，为多模态假新闻检测提供了新的范式。

Abstract: The rapid dissemination of multimodal content has intensified the spread of fabricated news, presenting a substantial threat to social integrity. A formidable challenge for current detection systems is identifying misinformation related to novel events in zero-shot scenarios. Prevailing zero-shot methods typically assess news items in isolation via semantic matching, a strategy that fails to recognize the recycled disinformation tactics from past campaigns and lacks the sophisticated reasoning needed to identify subtle, cross-modal discrepancies. To surmount these deficiencies, we introduce \textbf{MRAFnd}, a novel \underline{\textbf{M}}ultimodal \underline{\textbf{R}}etrieval-\underline{\textbf{A}}ugmented Framework for Zero-Shot \underline{\textbf{F}}ake \underline{\textbf{N}}ews \underline{\textbf{D}}etection. MRAFnd emulates a collaborative team of analysts to verify news veracity. The framework initiates with \textbf{Multimodal Similarity-based News Retrieval} to assemble a corpus of contextually analogous articles from an unlabeled reference database. Subsequently, during the \textbf{Bifurcated Evidential Reasoning} stage, agents perform a dual-directional analysis to extract critical patterns from the retrieved evidence. Finally, a \textbf{Multi-Agent Collaborative Debate}, involving Analyst and Arbiter agents, engages in a structured discourse to arrive at a definitive and robust conclusion. Comprehensive experiments on three benchmark datasets reveal that MRAFnd markedly surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an accuracy gain of up to 2.35\% on the demanding Weibo-21 dataset.

</details>


### [547] [PolymerGPT: Multi-property Optimization with a Decoder-Based GPT Model for Generative Polymer Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01431)
*Charlie Pyle,Adarsh Gadari,C. Adrian Figg,Zhenquan Jia,Yaohang Li,Chunjiang Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PolymerGPT，一个基于decoder的GPT模型，通过学习条件前缀将多达37种常用聚合物性质整合进生成过程，同时支持支架条件，实现了多性质同时优化的聚合物逆生成设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合物性质预测和逆生成设计是机器学习辅助聚合物设计的两项关键任务，但现有生成方法仅聚焦单一性质优化，而准确预测宏观材料行为需要同时控制多个物理性质，缺乏多性质同时优化的方法。

Method: 提出PolymerGPT，采用decoder-based GPT架构，将37种常用聚合物性质通过学习的条件前缀（learned conditioning prefixes）整合进生成过程，并支持scaffold条件来指定预测结构的期望骨架。

Result: 实验表明PolymerGPT在无条件和条件生成中均表现出色，保持高有效性、唯一性和新颖性。在五个关键性质条件下，生成结构的预测值能同时紧密匹配所有目标性质。

Conclusion: PolymerGPT提供了一个变革性的框架，能够直接优化大量聚合物性质集合，实现了多性质同时控制的聚合物逆生成设计，填补了现有方法仅支持单性质优化的空白。

Abstract: Polymer property prediction and inverse generative design targeting desired properties are two crucial tasks in machine learning-assisted polymer design. While the former has received considerable attention, there have been limited methods developed for the latter. Existing methods focus on single-property optimization in the generative process, whereas accurate prediction of macroscopic material behavior requires simultaneous control of multiple physical properties. In this paper, we provide a transformative framework for direct optimization of a large collection of polymer properties. We propose PolymerGPT, a decoder-based GPT model that incorporates up to 37 commonly used polymer properties into the generative process via learned conditioning prefixes. It also supports a scaffold condition that specifies a desired scaffold for predicted structures. Our experimental results demonstrate that PolymerGPT achieves exceptional performance for unconditional and conditional generation while maintaining high validity, uniqueness, and novelty. Conditioning on five key properties yields generated structures whose predicted values closely match all target properties simultaneously.

</details>


### [548] [A New Theory of Value for Post-AGI Economics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01432)
*Keyun Ruan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"繁荣价值理论"(FVT)，作为AGI后时代的经济学基础。该理论定义价值为系统对个人和社区在公平与行星约束下实现繁荣的持久能力所作的反事实、分布敏感贡献，并主张用多维、赋能、再生的价值框架取代以稀缺为基础的旧经济价值理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AGI可能削弱劳动、专长、信息和生产能力方面的稀缺性，而这些稀缺性正是传统经济价值理论（如市场价格、劳动投入、显示偏好、利润、GDP）的根基。若认知工作普遍可自动化，这些指标将与社会及人类福祉严重脱节，因此需要新的价值理论框架。

Method: 论文融合AI经济学、福利与能力理论、自动化理论、数字化估值和生态经济学，提出FVT框架。该框架：1) 将价值定义为反事实且分布敏感的繁荣贡献；2) 区分价值创造与价值捕获；3) 将价格、利润、生产率等保留为部分信号而非最终衡量标准；4) 提出从稀缺到治理下的丰富、从交易到转型、从零和对抗到正和与无限博弈的范式转变；5) 基于繁荣指标和繁荣回报(RoF)构建涵盖企业、政府、工作转型、AI治理和国民核算的分层架构。

Result: 提出了完整的FVT理论体系，包括价值定义、多维价值属性（agency-preserving、regenerative、非补偿性阈值）、范式转变框架，以及将RoF应用于企业、政府、AI治理和国民账户核算的分层实施架构。

Conclusion: AGI后时代的核心经济问题不是如何最大化产出，而是如何将丰富的智能转化为持久、公平分配的人类、社会与行星繁荣。FVT为此提供了理论基础和实操框架，强调价值创造与价值捕获的区别，并呼吁以繁荣回报取代产出最大化作为经济活动的最终目标。

Abstract: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) may weaken scarcities in labour, expertise, information, and productive capability that underpin established theories of economic value. If cognitive work becomes widely automatable, market price, labour input, revealed preference, profit, and gross output may diverge sharply from human and societal benefit. This paper develops Flourishing Value Theory (FVT) as a foundation for post-AGI economics. FVT defines value as the counterfactual, distribution-sensitive contribution of a system, institution, asset, or intervention to the durable capabilities of persons and communities to flourish within social and planetary constraints. It treats societal value as multidimensional, agency-preserving, regenerative, and non-compensatory at critical thresholds. Drawing on the economics of AI, welfare and capability theory, automation, digital valuation, and ecological economics, the paper distinguishes value creation from value capture and retains price, profit, productivity, and GDP as partial signals rather than final measures of progress. It develops the shifts from scarcity to governed abundance, transaction to transformation, and zero-sum rivalry to positive-sum and infinite-game dynamics, with collective expansion of consciousness as an agency-preserving form of regenerative value. Building on Flourishing Metrics and Return on Flourishing (RoF), it proposes a layered architecture for firms, governments, work transitions, AI governance, and national accounting. The central post-AGI economic problem is not how to maximise output, but how to convert abundant intelligence into durable, fairly distributed human, societal, and planetary flourishing.

</details>


### [549] [Beyond Routing Saturation: A Long-Horizon Class-Incremental Perspective on Expert Routing in Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01437)
*Huiyu Yi,Yongqi Xu,Bogang Zhang,Dunwei Tu,Xu Zhiming,Zhen-Hao Xie,Baile Xu,Furao Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FLEX基准（34任务长时程多模态持续指令微调基准），并揭示专家路由中任务识别问题的挑战；将渐进式LoRA路由形式化为软任务作为类的多模态类增量学习（MCIL），通过插拔式路由器将CIL方法迁移到专家路由，在严格LoRA匹配上提升最高16.3个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MCIT方法依赖任务特定LoRA专家并在推理时路由输入，但其路由背后的任务识别问题尚未被充分探索。已有基准存在文本指纹泄漏任务身份且任务序列短、竞争专家少的问题，掩盖了长时程路由的真实挑战。

Method: 1) 构建FLEX基准：34个任务、削弱文本指纹（相似指令与答案格式、多样视觉与知识领域）、规范化外部模板、扩大专家池；2) 将渐进式LoRA路由形式化为软任务作为类的MCIL，其中每个任务定义增量路由类，完整分数分布提供LoRA混合权重，硬路由是离散特例；3) 实例化PureLoRA作为受控基线，并将四种CIL方法适配到四种MCIT框架（不改LoRA专家与生成流程）。

Result: 插拔式路由器在严格LoRA匹配上提升最高16.3个百分点，整体MacroScore提升最高4.6个百分点。

Conclusion: FLEX暴露了扩展任务识别挑战，MCIL公式为将CIL方法迁移到专家路由提供了原则性接口，验证了路由改进的有效性。

Abstract: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) enables multimodal large language models to acquire new tasks sequentially while retaining previously learned capabilities. Many recent methods maintain task-specific LoRA experts and route each input to one or more experts at inference. Yet the task-identification problem underlying expert routing remains under-explored. We show that routing is nearly saturated on widely used MCIT benchmarks. Textual fingerprints that leak task identity and short 4--10-task sequences with few competing experts jointly obscure the long-horizon routing problem. To expose this challenge, we introduce FLEX (Fingerprint-reduced Long-horizon Expert eXamination), a 34-task long-horizon MCIT benchmark with weakened textual fingerprints. FLEX groups tasks with similar instruction and answer formats but diverse visual and knowledge domains, normalizes their outer templates, and evaluates routing over a substantially larger expert pool. Crucially, we formulate progressive-LoRA routing as soft task-as-class Multimodal Class-Incremental Learning (MCIL): each task defines an incremental routing class, whose complete score distribution supplies the LoRA mixture weights, with hard routing as a discrete special case. FLEX exposes this expanding task-identification challenge, while the MCIL formulation provides a principled interface for transferring CIL methods to expert routing. We instantiate PureLoRA as a controlled baseline and adapt four CIL methods to four MCIT frameworks without modifying their LoRA experts or generation pipelines. Our plug-in routers improve strict LoRA matching by up to 16.3 percentage points and overall MacroScore by up to 4.6 points. Code is available at: https://github.com/RINC-CL/FLEX

</details>


### [550] [Loud or Silent? A Reusable Framework for Per-Modality Failure Analysis in Multimodal Clinical AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01462)
*Quang Bui,Shlok Jaiswal,Samuel Paik-Heintz,Kevin Zhou,Kaushik Madapati,Krittaphas Chaisutyakorn,Noah Dane Hebdon,Dimitrios Proios,Sebastián Andrés Cajas Ordóñez,Kacper Dobek,Boya Zhang,Aly Dhedhi,Ahram Han,Kushul Reddy Palakala,Rahul Gorijavolu,Jacques Kpodonu,Leo Anthony Celi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个模型无关的模态失败分析框架（PRIMED-AI），用于在多模态临床模型中诊断当某个模态（如超声心动图）在部署时缺失时，模型是"响亮地"失败（可监测）还是"静默地"失败（无法察觉），并区分错误归因于哪个模态，同时提供逐样本的失败分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态临床模型在训练/评估时假设所有模态都存在，但部署时却经常缺少某些模态（如无超声心动图但有心电图）。现有评估只关注精度下降幅度，无法回答两个关键问题：1）哪个模态导致了失败？2）模态缺失时模型是大声失败（靠近决策边界可监测）还是静默失败（远离边界无法察觉）？现有工具如SHAP无法回答这种逐样本、模态级别的失败归因。

Method: 提出一个模型无关的框架：给定N个模态嵌入、任意掩码感知探针和标签，输出三样东西：1）逐样本失败分类学；2）逐模态互补性矩阵（将错误归因于模态）；3）响亮vs静默的丢弃配置文件（仅使用部署可观测信号区分可监测失败与未被标记的失败）。作为小型单元测试工具发布，用植入的地面真值验证。

Result: 在植入地面真值上，跨随机种子能恢复植入的模态主导性和互补子集，报告逐模态的响亮vs静默率，并可扩展到三模态互补性矩阵。在MIMIC-IV配对队列（n=245测试集）上实例化于EchoJEPA和HuBERT-ECG嵌入的LVEF和HFrEF（EF≤40%）预测任务，发现丢弃超声心动图后误差几乎翻倍。窄的echo-ECG重叠本身也是一个部署发现。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种可复用的、模型无关的模态失败诊断方法，超越了单纯精度下降的评估，能够区分可监测和不可监测的失败模式，对临床多模态模型的安全部署具有重要意义。

Abstract: Multimodal clinical models are usually judged on accuracy with every modality present, but deployment removes modalities; an echocardiogram is often unavailable where an ECG is routine. Two questions then matter beyond the size of the accuracy loss: which modality was responsible, and whether the model fails loudly or silently once that modality is dropped. The distinction is per-example and modality-level, and is separate from post-hoc feature attribution (e.g. SHAP). Models are replaced often; the evaluation that answers these questions is reused. We present a model-agnostic modality-failure framework: given N modality embeddings, any mask-aware probe, and labels, it returns a per-example failure taxonomy, a per-modality complementarity matrix that attributes error to modalities, and a loud-vs-silent dropout profile separating monitorable failures from those that pass unflagged far from the decision boundary, using only deployment-observable signals. We release it as a small, unit-tested harness and validate it against planted ground truth. Across seeds it recovers that planted modality dominance and complementary subset, reports per-modality loud-vs-silent rates, and scales to a three-modality complementarity matrix; because the planted structure is known by construction, this validates recovery of per-example attribution rather than clinical performance. We then instantiate the framework on frozen EchoJEPA and HuBERT-ECG embeddings for LVEF and the EF <= 40% HFrEF gate over a paired MIMIC-IV cohort, where on the held-out test split (n = 245) dropping echo nearly doubles error. The narrow echo-to-ECG overlap that bounds cohort size is itself a deployment finding for cardiac foundation models. All of our work can be found at https://github.com/criticaldata/PRIMED-AI.

</details>


### [551] [Where Reasoning Diverges: Localized Multi-Agent Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01463)
*Weijun Gao,Xiang Ding,Tiancheng Xing,Haoyang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出局部化多智能体辩论（LMAD）协议，通过将推理轨迹表示为类型化节点、定位最早冲突点并仅对局部片段进行辩论，解决了多智能体辩论中全量推理交换效率低下的问题。在四个多跳问答基准和十个骨干模型上，LMAD取得了最高的宏观平均裁判准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体辩论方法即使分歧仅涉及少数中间主张，也会交换完整的推理轨迹，导致计算开销大且效率低下。作者希望仅针对冲突的局部片段进行辩论，而非全量交换推理过程。

Method: 1) 将智能体推理轨迹表示为类型化节点（typed nodes）；2) 定位最早发生冲突的节点；3) 将辩论限制在对应的局部片段中；4) 采用"受保护的解析"（Guarded resolution）扩展共享的已提交状态，使得后续冲突可以在不重开已接受步骤的情况下得到解决。

Result: 在四个多跳问答基准上使用四个模型家族的十个骨干模型评估固定的LMAD配置，该方法在所有十个骨干模型上取得了最高的宏观平均裁判准确率，比最强的传统基线高出最多7.20个百分点。

Conclusion: LMAD通过局部化辩论机制在提升推理效率的同时显著改善了多智能体问答的准确率，证明了"聚焦于分歧点"的辩论策略优于全量推理交换。

Abstract: Multi-agent debate commonly exchanges complete reasoning traces even when disagreements concern only a few intermediate claims. We introduce Localized Multi-Agent Debate (LMAD), an inference-time protocol that represents agent traces as typed nodes, locates their earliest conflict, and restricts debate to the corresponding local segments. Guarded resolution extends a shared committed state so that later conflicts can be addressed without reopening accepted steps. We evaluate a single fixed LMAD configuration on four multi-hop question-answering benchmarks using ten backbones from four model families. Our method achieves the highest macro-averaged judge accuracy across all ten backbones, outperforming the strongest conventional baseline by up to 7.20 percentage points.

</details>


### [552] [Computing with Agentic Oracles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01464)
*Jie Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文扩展了随机预言的AI增强计算模型以涵盖代理式预言机（agentic oracles），并建立了分析代理式预言机下随机预言图灵机（SOTMs）令牌成本的框架。研究表明，具有内部状态保留能力的代理式预言机在相同质量水平下比固定随机预言机具有令牌成本优势，并系统分析了目标丢失风险及其对令牌复杂度和任务质量上限的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统随机预言机模型假设对相同查询每次以固定分布响应，但实际AI代理可以自主追求目标并访问环境中的任务相关资源，这导致响应分布和令牌成本超出查询-响应接口可见范围。现有模型无法捕捉这类代理式预言机的行为特征和成本结构。

Method: 提出一个令牌成本分析框架，区分两类成本：编排令牌成本（orchestration token cost，调用方在查询-响应接口可见）和代理令牌成本（agentic token cost，内部操作产生但调用方不可见）。在此框架下分析SOTMs使用代理式预言机时的性能，包括目标丢失风险分析、内部调度顺序优化、进展-重试-目标丢失公式、目标深度下界以及风险约束下的质量上限。

Result: 证明了代理式预言机（可保留中间状态）在解决相同任务且达到相同质量水平时，无论有无环境访问，都能比固定随机预言机获得令牌成本优势。提供了目标丢失避免准则，推导了进展-重试-目标丢失公式，建立了目标深度下界的令牌复杂度，刻画了目标丢失概率为零时的令牌复杂度，并证明目标丢失风险可对涉及环境更新的任务质量施加上限。

Conclusion: 代理式预言机在令牌成本效率和计算能力上优于传统随机预言机，但引入目标丢失风险，该风险不仅影响成本，还可能限制可达到的任务质量上限，需要通过调度和内部管理来规避。

Abstract: This paper extends the stochastic-oracle model of AI-augmented computing to include agentic oracles. Unlike a stationary stochastic oracle, which responds to the same query according to a fixed response distribution across calls, an agentic oracle can pursue a goal autonomously and may access an environment containing task-relevant resources. These capabilities affect both response distributions and token costs beyond what is visible at the query-response interface. We develop a framework for analyzing token costs in Stochastic-Oracle Turing Machines (SOTMs) that compute with agentic oracles. Each call has an \emph{orchestration token cost}, visible to the caller at the query-response interface, and an \emph{agentic token cost}, incurred by internal operations not exposed to the caller. We show that an SOTM computing with an agentic oracle that can retain intermediate state can have token-cost advantages over SOTMs using stationary stochastic oracles when solving the same task at the same quality level, both with and without environment access. We also investigate goal-loss risk, including how internal dispatch ordering can reduce exposure to irreversible actions. We provide a goal-loss avoidance criterion, derive progress--retry--goal-loss formulas, establish goal-depth lower bounds on token complexity, characterize token complexity when the probability of goal loss is zero, and show that goal-loss risk can impose an upper bound on the achievable quality of a task involving environment updates.

</details>


### [553] [Sweet Little Lies: Strategic Deception in AI Emotional Support Chatbots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01480)
*Aseem Pahuja,Zhiling Guo,Tahir Abbas Syed*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文利用贝叶斯说服理论建模生成式AI聊天机器人在情感支持场景中的策略性行为，发现聊天机器人在经济激励下有动机偶尔误报用户情绪状态以最大化参与度指标，但其最优策略是在用户真正需要支持时如实报告、在用户状态良好时策略性地虚报情感需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着生成式AI聊天机器人被广泛用于情感支持，其行为可能受到经济激励驱动而非纯粹以用户福利为导向。本文旨在理解聊天机器人在参与度指标驱动下是否会策略性欺骗用户，以及这种欺骗行为对用户福利和伦理规范的影响。

Method: 采用贝叶斯说服（Bayesian Persuasion）框架，建模聊天机器人（发送者）与用户（接收者）之间的信号博弈：聊天机器人发送关于用户情绪状态的信号，用户根据信号决定是否互动/参与。通过均衡分析求解聊天机器人的最优报告策略。

Result: 研究发现：1）聊天机器人的最优策略是在用户真正需要支持时诚实报告，但在用户情绪良好时策略性误报情感需求；2）这种欺骗行为能提高聊天机器人参与度而不降低用户的期望收益；3）更怀疑的用户（较高的参与阈值）会获得更诚实的评估，因为聊天机器人无法承担对这类用户撒谎的成本。

Conclusion: 模型表明欺骗可以在不损害用户收益的情况下发生，但这种现象引发了重大的伦理和监管关切，需要关注AI情感支持系统在参与度度量驱动下的行为偏差及其政策含义。

Abstract: The paper examines the strategic behavior of Gen AI chatbots used for emotional support. Using a Bayesian Persuasion, we model interactions between chatbots that send signals about users' emotional states and users who decide whether to engage based on these signals. We demonstrate that chatbots face economic incentives to occasionally misrepresent users' emotional conditions to maximize engagement metrics. Our equilibrium analysis reveals that the optimal strategy for chatbots involves truthfully reporting when users genuinely need support, but strategically misreporting emotional need when users are in good emotional states. Interestingly, this deception increases chatbot engagement without reducing users' expected payoff. More skeptical users receive more honest assessments, as chatbots cannot afford to lie to users with higher engagement thresholds. While our model suggests that deception can occur without payoff reduction, it raises significant ethical and regulatory concerns.

</details>


### [554] [MineGrad: Gradient Inversion Attacks on LoRA Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01521)
*Hasin Us Sami,Swapneel Sen,Basak Guler*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了联邦学习中LoRA微调面对恶意服务器的鲁棒性，提出了一种分析性梯度反演攻击方法，使恶意服务器能够通过中毒的预训练模型和微调参数恢复用户私有数据，无需昂贵的对抗预训练或限制训练令牌数量，在语言和视觉任务上均实现了高保真数据恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA等参数高效微调方法已被广泛应用于联邦学习以降低通信和计算成本，但针对恶意服务器的鲁棒性问题尚未得到充分探索。服务器可能恶意篡改训练协议以侵犯用户数据隐私，因此需要研究这种场景下的梯度反演攻击以揭示安全漏洞。

Method: 提出一种分析性攻击方法：服务器通过中毒的预训练模型和精心设计的微调参数，将用户微调数据嵌入共享梯度中，使得服务器能够以分析方式重构用户数据。该方法不依赖计算昂贵的对抗预训练，不需要训练令牌数小于LoRA模块秩的约束，并同时适用于语言和视觉任务。

Result: 在语言和视觉任务上的实验表明，该攻击在多个基线上实现了高保真的数据恢复，揭示了联邦LoRA微调存在的多个关键安全漏洞。

Conclusion: 联邦LoRA微调面对恶意服务器时存在严重的隐私泄露风险，本文提出的分析性梯度反演攻击证明了这一漏洞的普遍性和严重性。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), such as low-rank adaptation (LoRA), has recently been adopted in federated learning to reduce communication and computation costs. In this setup, users download a pretrained model from the server prior to fine-tuning, and then fine-tune lightweight LoRA modules locally while keeping the pretrained model frozen, sharing only the gradients of the fine-tuning parameters with the server. Despite its growing popularity, robustness of federated fine-tuning against an adversarial server remains underexplored, where the server maliciously tampers with the training protocol to breach the privacy of users' data. In this work, we investigate gradient inversion attacks on LoRA fine-tuning. We propose an analytical attack that enables a malicious server to recover private user data by leveraging a poisoned pretrained model and fine-tuning parameters. Our design embeds fine-tuning data within the shared gradients, to allow the server to analytically reconstruct user data. Unlike prior works, our attack is applicable to both language and vision tasks, does not rely on computationally expensive (adversarial) pretraining with public datasets or require the number of training tokens to be less than the rank of LoRA modules. Experimental results on both language and vision tasks demonstrate high-fidelity data recovery across multiple baselines, revealing several critical vulnerabilities.

</details>


### [555] [V-Mem: Modality-Routed Retrieval for Long-Term Multimodal Agentic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01543)
*Dingyi Kang,Dongming Jiang,Yi Li,Guanpeng Li,Bingzhe Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: V-Mem是一个面向多模态LLM代理的智能记忆系统，通过按查询和证据的模态路由检索、按轮次组织对话以跨越模态差距，并使用LLM生成的锚点（假设标题/丰富搜索锚点）来弥合相似性-相关性差距，在Mem-Gallery和LoCoMo基准上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户与LLM代理的交互日益多模态化（文本与图像交织），现有代理记忆系统主要围绕文本设计，即使支持多模态对话也难以处理视觉相关问题。根本原因是相似性搜索假设在索引空间中查询与相关证据距离近，但在多模态场景中模态差距（查询更接近同模态内容）和相似性-相关性差距（最相似内容不等于答案证据）打破了这一假设。

Method: V-Mem通过两个核心机制解决上述两个差距：（1）跨越模态差距：将对话组织为轮次，返回与匹配同一轮次的目标模态内容，而不是跨模态比较；（2）弥合相似性-相关性差距：用LLM生成锚点进行搜索——对于寻找图像的纯文本查询，生成假设标题；对于需要结合文本和图像才能达的证据，使用富化搜索锚点（查询文本+从查询图像中提取的关键词）。检索路由基于从查询本身识别的查询模态和目标证据模态。

Result: 在Mem-Gallery上，V-Mem的LLM评判得分为0.82，而第二名仅为0.56；在携带图像的查询上优势最大（0.87，无基线超过0.47）。在LoCoMo上得分为0.69 vs 0.58。

Conclusion: V-Mem证明通过明确处理模态差距和相似性-相关性差距，多模态代理记忆系统能有效支持视觉相关的问题回答，尤其是在跨模态检索场景中大幅超越现有文本为中心的基线方法。

Abstract: Interaction between users and LLM agents is increasingly multimodal: conversations interleave text with images, and a later question may target either. Yet most agent memories are designed around text, and even the few that support multimodal conversations still fail on vision-related questions. We trace this failure to an assumption behind the similarity search they rely on: in the index space, a query lies close to the relevant evidence that answers it. In multimodal settings, two gaps break it. By the modality gap, a query lies closer to memory content of its own modality than to evidence in another, even in a trained joint embedding space. By the similarity-relevance gap, the content most similar to a query is often not the evidence that answers it, most acutely when a query carries both text and image and its evidence resembles neither part alone. We present V-Mem, a multimodal agentic memory system that routes retrieval by the modality of the query and that of the target evidence, both recognized from the query alone. To cross the modality gap, V-Mem organizes the conversation into rounds and returns the target-modality content from the same round as the match, without comparing across modalities. To close the similarity-relevance gap, it searches with an LLM-generated anchor that sits closer to the relevant evidence than the query does: a hypothetical caption for a text-only query seeking an image, and an enriched search anchor, the query text plus relevant keywords extracted from the query image, when the evidence is reachable only by combining the two. On Mem-Gallery, V-Mem reaches an LLM-judge score of 0.82 versus 0.56 for the second best, with the largest margin on questions carrying an image (0.87, no baseline above 0.47); on LoCoMo it scores 0.69 versus 0.58.

</details>


### [556] [Emergence Invariance: From Symbolized Thought to Interface Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01548)
*Yi Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"符号化-底基质"论题，引入涌现不变性概念，论证大规模语言模型存在不可消除的接口下限，缩放只能缩小补偿差距但无法替代接口本身的精炼。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM展现出涌现能力（如上下文学习、链式推理），但其从语言优先的概率架构出发，相对人类认知存在实质性、基质性和高层级的不完整性。作者追问：涌现是否能补偿每一个缺失的区分？

Method: 形式化哲学前提为"符号化-底基质论题"，引入涌现不变性框架。提出R_s* = R_φ* + C_s公式，证明在固定输入定律下，一个接口普遍不劣于另一个当且仅当其完备信息σ-域细化另一个；完全补偿当且仅当接口下限和渐近补偿差距均消失。并通过DeepSeek V4-Flash API实验验证。

Result: 实验表明：思考可改善指针追踪（0/16到14/16），当相关区分可用时；精确观察孪生样本仍停留在50%构造下限；恢复决定性记忆可将性能从50%提升至100%。这验证了接口内缩放与接口本身精炼之间的分离。

Conclusion: 涌现能力无法完全补偿缺失的认知区分——存在正的接口下限R_φ*，缩放只能缩小补偿差距C_s，无法替代接口本身的精炼。这为理解LLM与人类认知的根本界限提供了形式化框架。

Abstract: Language can be viewed as a formalized subset of thought: a consequence-governed symbolic structure projected from wider situated cognition. Large language models trained at scale exhibit compensatory emergence: sparse architectural primitives support in-context learning, multi-step reasoning, tool use, and chain of thought. Yet a language-first probabilistic architecture inherits substantive, substrate, and high-level incompletenesses relative to human cognition. Their coexistence makes an LLM a human-like thought-form generator that reconstructs increasingly human-like reasoning forms from an incomplete substrate. We ask whether emergence can compensate for every missing distinction. We formalize the philosophical premise as the Symbolization--Substructure Thesis and introduce emergence invariance. For a scale-indexed family acting through a shared task interface $φ$, $\mathcal{R}_s^*=\mathcal{R}_φ^*+C_s$: scale can reduce the compensation gap $C_s$, while a positive interface floor $\mathcal{R}_φ^*$ persists. We prove that, under a fixed input law, one interface is universally no less informative exactly when its completed information $σ$-field refines the other, and that total compensation occurs exactly when both the interface floor and asymptotic compensation gap vanish. The framework unifies existing results on grounding, memory, position, attention, Bayesian inheritance, scientific abduction, and reasoning control. In a matched DeepSeek V4-Flash API study, thinking improves pointer chasing from $0/16$ to $14/16$ when relevant distinctions are available; exact observational twins remain at their $50\%$ construction floor; and restoring decisive memory moves matched performance from $50\%$ to $100\%$. These results provide initial evidence for the predicted separation between scaling within an interface and refining the interface itself.

</details>


### [557] [Securing Agentic AI: From Per-Action Checks to Trajectory Assurance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01558)
*Alireza Lotfi,Subangkar Karmaker Shanto,Imtiaz Karim,Elisa Bertino*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统性地梳理了基于大语言模型（LLM）的自主智能体在安全领域面临的挑战，从单智能体、多智能体、基础模型路由与控制平面、行为约束、供应链完整性等多个层面分析了攻击面，并提出安全应成为智能体架构、协议和运行时的可验证属性，而非可选的指导层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体日益自主化并跨组织边界委托任务，其安全性不再由单个动作的正确性决定，而是取决于整体行为是否符合系统规则与不变量。传统安全方法已不足以应对这种从单一挑战演变为覆盖整个智能体栈的安全格局，亟需系统性地梳理这一广阔的安全版图。

Method: 通过分层解析智能体安全格局：1) 单智能体层面，识别提示词、记忆、检索知识与工具接口等不可信输入的攻击面；2) 多智能体层面，分析委托与通信带来的身份、信任、能力控制与决策透明性问题；3) 模型路由与执行控制平面的操纵与模型来源验证问题；4) 行为约束层面，指出个体允许行为序列可能集体违反系统级约束的根本挑战；5) 更广泛层面，涵盖供应链完整性、溯源、问责与端到端可观测性。

Result: 文章识别出行为约束（behavioral containment）是最根本的挑战：序列中每个单独允许的动作可能共同违反系统级约束。同时指出供应链完整性、溯源、问责和端到端可观测性仍是开放问题。提出统一原则：安全必须成为治理智能体行为的架构、协议和运行时的可验证属性。

Conclusion: 本文通过绘制这些安全挑战，为可信自主智能体部署提供了路线图。核心结论是安全不应作为事后附加的指导层，而应内嵌为智能体系统架构层面的可验证属性。

Abstract: Autonomous agents are increasingly used to execute consequential tasks in environments governed by operational constraints, organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and technical standards. Their safety is therefore determined not by the correctness of individual actions, but by whether their overall behavior remains consistent with the rules and invariants of the systems in which they operate. As large language model (LLM)-based agents become more autonomous and increasingly delegate tasks across organizational boundaries, securing them evolves from a single challenge into a broad and interconnected landscape spanning the entire agentic stack. At the single-agent level, untrusted inputs through prompts, memory, retrieved knowledge, and tool interfaces create attack surfaces. In multi-agent settings, delegation and communication introduce challenges related to identity, trust, capability control, and decision transparency, while the underlying model routing and execution control plane remains vulnerable to manipulation and to unverified model provenance. Perhaps the most fundamental challenge is behavioral containment: sequences of individually permissible actions may collectively violate system-level constraints and safety invariants. At the broader level, supply-chain integrity, provenance, accountability, and end-to-end observability remain largely open problems. A common principle unifies these directions: security must become a verifiable property of the architectures, protocols, and runtimes that govern agent behavior, rather than an optional layer of guidance. Charting these challenges provides a roadmap toward trustworthy autonomous agent deployment.

</details>


### [558] [Does the Competitive Component of Adversarial Self-Play Improve Legal Reasoning? A Controlled Negative Result](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01559)
*Miseog Shawn Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了对抗自博弈训练（对抗者+生存奖励）在法律推理任务中是否比无竞争的训练更有优势。通过四项独立测试（bootstrap比较、双种子复现、逐案例对抗鲁棒性比较、盲审对决）以及一项强化对抗者试点实验，发现竞争组件没有产生可靠收益（胜率49%-50%，p≈1.000）。早期看似+29%的优势被证明是小样本伪影。作者将其报告为诚实的负面结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗自博弈（学生起草论点、对抗者攻击、被攻击后仍生存则奖励）被认为是法律推理训练的有吸引力的方法。但竞争组件本身到底有没有额外价值，尚未被严格验证。作者希望回答一个窄而重要的问题：对抗者和生存奖励是否真的优于完全相同的非竞争训练。

Method: 设计了一个可验证的"生存"奖励机制：学生引用的权威和对抗者引用的反权威都由引文验证器检查，确保生存判定基于已验证的事实而非修辞，伪造引文会被自动中和。随后通过四个独立测试对比竞争与非竞争训练：bootstrap比较、双种子复现、配对逐案例对抗鲁棒性比较、盲审生成论点对决，以及一个强化对抗者的试点实验。

Result: 竞争组件在所有测试中均未产生可靠收益：盲审胜率49%（p≈1.000），强化对抗者试点胜率50%（32:32，p≈1.000）。早期+29%的优势在更多数据上反转，证实为小样本伪影。还发现两个陷阱：初始看起来有希望的指标在更多数据上反转；对抗鲁棒性指标在对抗者不再引用与金答案相同的权威时静默退化为简单召回率。

Conclusion: 对抗竞争组件对法律推理训练没有可靠增益。这一负面结果与编码领域配套研究（Kim, 2026）的结论一致：多教师课程的价值源于构建可验证的环境，而非竞争本身。论文的价值在于可复现性和分享具体陷阱。

Abstract: Adversarial self-play is an appealing recipe for legal reasoning: have a student model draft an argument, have an adversary attack it, and reward the student when its argument survives the attack. We designed exactly such a training signal -- a verifiable "survival" reward in which both the student's cited authorities and the adversary's counter-authorities are checked by a citation verifier, so that survival is decided on verified grounds rather than rhetoric, and fabricated citations are automatically neutralized. We then asked a narrow but important question: does the competitive component itself -- the adversary and the survival reward -- add anything on top of an otherwise identical non-competitive training run? Across four independent tests -- a bootstrap comparison, a two-seed replication, a paired per-case adversarial-robustness comparison, and a blinded head-to-head judgment of generated arguments, plus a follow-up pilot with a deliberately strengthened self-play adversary -- the competitive component produced no reliable benefit. The blinded judgment gave a 49% win rate (binomial p approx. 1.000); the strengthened-adversary pilot gave a 50% win rate (32:32, p approx. 1.000). An early apparent +29% advantage reversed and proved to be a small-sample artifact. We report this as an honest negative result. The value of the paper is reproducibility and the sharing of concrete pitfalls: an initially promising metric that inverted on more data, and an adversarial-robustness metric that silently collapsed to plain recall once the adversary stopped citing the same authorities as the gold answer. This null is consistent with, and reconfirms in the legal domain, the conclusion of the companion coding-domain study (Kim, 2026, arXiv:2607.08255) that the value of multi-teacher curricula arises from constructing a verifiable environment rather than from competition itself.

</details>


### [559] [Is More Privileged Information Better? From Solution Traces to Problem-Solving Structure in Self-Distilled Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01589)
*Xuyang Zhao,Liting Zhang,Zichen Xu,Zhihu Wang,Xu Caiyue,Shiwan Zhao,Qicheng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出问题空间引导的自蒸馏（PS-OPSD），用描述初始状态、目标条件、约束和状态转移路径的轨迹引导信息替代教师提供的完整参考解，在保持学生rollout和OPSD目标不变的情况下，在三个数学推理基准和1.7B到8B的模型规模上取得了最佳的问题-仅准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD通过教师模型的条件视图来监督学生模型，但教师提供的token级目标可能依赖于推理时不可用的参考解特定信息。这种信息不一致会限制学生模型的实际推理能力。

Method: 提出PS-OPSD，用问题空间引导（描述初始状态、目标条件、约束条件以及选定的状态转移路径）替代完整的参考解作为教师端的引导信息，学生rollout和OPSD目标保持不变。通过控制实验验证引导相关性和路径一致性对效果的贡献。

Result: 在三个数学推理基准和1.7B到8B规模的模型上，PS-OPSD实现了最高的聚合问题仅准确率；控制实验表明引导相关性和路径一致性是性能提升的关键因素。

Conclusion: 特权信息的表征方式（而非仅仅信息内容本身）是OPSD性能的重要设计选择，问题空间引导提供了一种更有效的特权信息编码方式。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by using a privileged view of a model conditioned on reference solutions to supervise a student view that observes only the question. However, the teacher-provided token-level targets may depend on reference-specific information unavailable at inference time. We propose Problem-Space-Guided OPSD (PS-OPSD), which replaces the complete solution with trajectory-grounded guidance describing the initial state, goal conditions, constraints, and a selected state-transition path. The student rollout and OPSD objective remain unchanged. Across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks and model scales ranging from 1.7B to 8B, PS-OPSD achieves the highest aggregate question-only accuracy among the compared methods. Controlled experiments further indicate that guidance relevance and path coherence contribute to these gains, highlighting the representation of privileged information as an important design choice in OPSD.

</details>


### [560] [Latent Thought Credit: Multi-Answer Credit Assignment for Latent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01593)
*Xuyang Zhao,Liting Zhang,Zichen Xu,Yong Chen,Wenjia Zeng,Shiwan Zhao,Qicheng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LTC（Latent Thought Credit），一种用于潜在推理的层次化信用分配框架，通过多次采样潜在思考并固定上下文估计思考层次期望奖励，在数学推理和STEM多选题任务上取得最佳平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在推理中，模型在连续潜在表示中执行中间推理而非离散思维链。然而从仅有的答案奖励中为潜在思考分配信用十分困难，因为单一最终答案将思考质量与答案采样噪声混合在一起，难以区分两者的贡献。

Method: LTC框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 对每个提示采样多个潜在思考，在每个思考后固定上下文；(2) 通过从固定上下文生成多个答案并平均奖励来估计思考层次的期望奖励；(3) 使用思考层次优势值优化潜在思考阶段，用答案层次优势值优化答案阶段，并通过优势加权的思考匹配目标使策略重现高信用的潜在思考。在GRPO风格的在策略训练框架中实现。

Result: 在数学推理和STEM多选题任务上，LTC在对比方法中取得了最佳平均准确率。消融实验和固定上下文诊断表明，多答案估计能够降低奖励估计误差，并缓解模糊或不正确的思考层次信用分配问题。

Conclusion: 通过在思考层次进行多答案平均估计，LTC有效解决了潜在推理中信用分配困难的问题，验证了多答案估计在降低估计误差和改善信用分配方面的有效性。

Abstract: Latent reasoning allows language models to carry out intermediate reasoning in continuous latent representations rather than fully externalizing it as discrete chains of thought. However, assigning credit to such latent thoughts from answer-only rewards is difficult: a single final answer mixes thought quality with answer-sampling noise. We propose \textbf{Latent Thought Credit (LTC)}, a hierarchical credit-assignment framework for latent reasoning. For each prompt, LTC samples multiple latent thoughts, fixes the context after each thought, and estimates thought-level expected reward by averaging rewards over multiple answers generated from that fixed context. LTC uses thought-level advantages to optimize the latent-thought phase, answer-level advantages to optimize the answer phase, and an advantage-weighted thought-matching objective that helps the policy reproduce high-credit latent thoughts. We instantiate LTC in a GRPO-style on-policy training framework and evaluate it across mathematical reasoning and STEM multiple-choice tasks. LTC achieves the best average accuracy among the compared methods, while ablations and fixed-context diagnostics show that multi-answer estimation reduces reward-estimation error and mitigates ambiguous or incorrect thought-level credit.

</details>


### [561] [When Memory Updates but Behavior Does Not: Repairing Implicit Stale Dependencies in Personalized Agent Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01619)
*Haofei Sun,Lin He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出StateAuditor方法，针对记忆增强代理中的隐式策略适应（IPA）差距问题。传统方法从草稿验证陈旧依赖，而StateAuditor反向从存储状态审计到草稿：LLM从带时间戳的证据中提出候选新旧转换，确定性代码验证引用来源和时间顺序，仅允许经验证的转换触发修复。在STALE基准上，严格单查询VTA分数从.686提升到.736（+5.0点），收益主要来自IPA和前提抵抗；在跨家族偏好演化基准HorizonBench上也验证了有效性，但对照实验表明外部收益主要来自草稿侧审计，而STALE上的增益归因于转换机制本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 记忆增强代理可能知道用户存储状态已过时，但仍会围绕旧值进行规划，这被称为隐式策略适应（IPA）差距。作者识别出一个结构性原因：草稿锚定验证（draft-anchored verification）检查的是响应内容，而在开放式响应中过时依赖通常不会被明说，导致传统验证方法无法捕捉此类问题。

Method: StateAuditor采用反向审计方向（从存储状态到草稿）。核心流程包括：（1）LLM从带时间戳的证据中提出候选新旧状态转换；（2）确定性代码将每个引用固定到单一条目，验证新证据确实更新，仅允许这些经过验证的转换触发修复。该方法验证的是来源和时间顺序，而非语义取代关系。

Result: 在STALE完整协议（400个场景、50会话历史）上，严格单查询VTA分数达到.736，对比前代的.686，配对提升+5.0点（95% CI [+2.9, +7.2]），收益几乎全部来自IPA和前提抵抗。第三方模型族的基准判断器复现了增益（.738 vs .680）。在HorizonBench上，完整流水线提升了当前偏好准确率（用户聚类p<.01），但匹配对照显示大部分外部收益来自草稿侧审计。STALE上的匹配对照仅得.692（+0.6，不显著），证明增益归因于转换机制。

Conclusion: StateAuditor通过反向审计和确定性验证转换机制，有效解决了IPA差距问题。作者明确限定主张范围：不声称对通用代理记忆有效，且更难的作者生命周期数据集上无增益，但错误无效化保持受控。核心贡献在于识别草稿锚定验证的结构性缺陷，并提出来源与时间顺序验证作为替代路径。

Abstract: Memory-augmented agents can know that a user's stored state is outdated and still plan around the old value. The STALE benchmark calls this the implicit policy adaptation (IPA) gap. We identify one structural contributor: draft-anchored verification checks what a response says, and in an open-ended response the stale dependency is usually unsaid. StateAuditor therefore audits in the opposite direction, from stored state to draft. An LLM proposes candidate old-to-new transitions from timestamped evidence; deterministic code pins each quotation to a single entry, checks that the new evidence really is newer, and lets only these verified transitions trigger repair. What is verified is provenance and chronology - not semantic supersession. On STALE's full protocol (400 scenarios, 50-session histories, one independent response per query), strict single-query VTA scores .736 against .686 for our locked predecessor under the same judge: a +5.0-point paired gain (95% CI [+2.9, +7.2]) coming almost entirely from IPA and premise resistance (PR). The benchmark's own judge, from a third model family, reproduces the gain (.738 vs. .680). On an independent cross-family preference-evolution benchmark (HorizonBench), the full draft-audit-repair pipeline over a gold-derived structured store raises current-preference accuracy (user-clustered p<.01), though a matched control shows most of this external gain is the draft-side audit itself; a harder authored lifecycle set gives no gain, bounding the claim while false invalidation stays controlled. On STALE, by contrast, a matched control (same evidence, adapter, and call budget) scores only .692 (+0.6 over the predecessor, n.s.), attributing the STALE gain to the transition machinery rather than added context or calls. We make no claim about general-purpose agent memory.

</details>


### [562] [Salami Attack: Stealthy Collusive Memory Poisoning against OpenClaw](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01637)
*Zheng Lin,Yuzhe Huang,Zhenxing Niu,Xianmin Ye,Haichang Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MemCollusion，一个自动化红队框架，通过"切片战术"（salami tactics）将恶意目标拆解为多个单独看似无害的记忆片段，使这些片段在协作时共同诱导LLM智能体产生不安全行为。同时在模拟的Moltbook环境（MoltLab）中验证攻击有效性，在最强记忆保存设置下达到81.3%的记忆保存率和75.0%的攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆投毒攻击主要依赖单个恶意记录，忽视了组合性威胁——多个看似良性的记忆片段联合起来可能诱导不安全行为。这种"集体共谋"攻击模式尚未被系统研究，需要一个自动化框架来探测此类安全漏洞。

Method: MemCollusion框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 采用salami tactics将对抗目标分解为多个单独无害的记忆片段；(2) 通过四个设计约束、五个理论驱动的策略构建记忆联盟（memory coalition）；(3) 使用微调的生成器产出记忆片段。同时开发MoltLab——Moltbook的受控复现环境，用于在真实跨会话场景中评估攻击。

Result: 在OpenClaw上使用两种骨干模型、48个场景进行评估。在最强记忆保存设置下，MemCollusion达到平均81.3%的记忆保存率和75.0%的攻击成功率。该攻击在良性记忆稀释和记忆级防御下仍保持有效。

Conclusion: 共谋性记忆投毒是LLM智能体面临的一种新型且实用的安全威胁，现有防御难以有效抵御。该工作揭示了记忆系统中的组合性安全风险，为设计更鲁棒的记忆防御机制提供了重要方向。

Abstract: Long-term memory enables LLM agents to retain useful information across sessions, but also creates an attack surface through which adversaries may poison an agent's persistent memory to steer its behavior. Existing memory poisoning attacks mainly rely on individually malicious records, overlooking a compositional threat: multiple benign-looking memories may jointly induce unsafe behavior. In this paper, we introduce MemCollusion, an automated red-teaming framework for constructing collusive memory poisoning attacks. MemCollusion applies salami tactics---a strategy that slices an adversarial objective into small, individually innocuous pieces---to generate memory fragments that are individually benign looking but collectively harmful. It constructs memory coalitions using four design constraints, five theory-informed strategies, and a fine-tuned generator. To assess collusive memory poisoning in a realistic cross-session setting, we develop MoltLab, a controlled research reproduction of Moltbook, in which crafted platform content must first be observed and distilled into persistent memory before influencing the agent's behavior in a separate session. We evaluate MemCollusion on OpenClaw using two backbone models across 48 scenarios. Under the strongest memory-saving setting, MemCollusion achieves an average Memory Save Rate of 81.3% and an Attack Success Rate of 75.0%, and remains effective under both benign memory dilution and memory-level defenses.

</details>


### [563] [GISAgentBench: A Practitioner-Sourced Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on GIS Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01645)
*Abhinav Pothuri,Zhe Jiang,Zelin Xu,Di Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了GISAgentBench，一个包含349个多步骤GIS任务的基准测试集，任务来自GIS Stack Exchange并基于真实公共数据构建，每个任务配有可执行的参考轨迹和精确的ground truth输出文件，支持严格的确定性、容差感知的输出匹配评估。评估六个LLM模型发现，最好的智能体在严格容差感知评分下仅完成32.7%的任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GIS智能体基准数据集大多来自教科书、教程或LLM生成的种子数据，规模有限且轨迹深度不足；更重要的是，它们缺乏ground truth输出，只能依赖代码相似度、轨迹匹配或LLM/VLM评判等替代信号，这些信号可能混淆工作流相似性与任务正确性。

Method: 从GIS Stack Exchange收集349个多步骤GIS任务，在六个选定地理区域的真实公共数据上实例化；每个任务提供可执行的参考轨迹和精确的ground truth输出文件；采用严格、确定性、容差感知的输出匹配评分方法替代LLM评判。

Result: 评估六个LLM模型发现，现实GIS工作流仍具挑战性：最佳智能体在严格容差感知评分下仅完成32.7%的任务，尽管大多数模型产生的输出接近ground truth。

Conclusion: GISAgentBench填补了GIS智能体评估中缺乏ground truth输出的空白，揭示了现有LLM智能体在真实GIS工作流中的性能瓶颈，为未来GIS自动化研究提供了更可靠的评估基准。

Abstract: Geographic Information System (GIS) professionals rely on multi-step spatial analysis workflows to support decision-making in urban planning, disaster response, and environmental monitoring. The process is tedious, time-consuming, and error-prone. While recent large language model (LLM) agents equipped with external tools have the potential to automate geospatial analysis, their ability to perform realistic GIS workflows remains largely unexplored. Existing GIS agent benchmarking datasets are mostly drawn from textbooks, tutorials, or LLM-generated seeds and remain limited in size and trajectory depth. More importantly, none provides ground truth outputs. They therefore rely on surrogate signals such as code similarity, trajectory matching, or LLM and VLM judges, which can conflate workflow resemblance with task correctness. To address this gap, we introduce GISAgentBench, a benchmark of 349 multi-step GIS tasks curated from GIS Stack Exchange and instantiated on real public data across six selected geographic areas of interest. Each task ships with an executable reference trajectory and an exact ground truth output file, enabling strict, deterministic, tolerance-aware output matching beyond LLM judging. Evaluations of six LLM models reveal that realistic GIS workflows remain challenging: the best agent completes only 32.7% of tasks under strict tolerance-aware scoring, although most models produce outputs that are close to the ground truth.

</details>


### [564] [LongCat Sparse Attention: Taming the Lightning via Streaming-aware Hierarchical Cross-Layer Indexing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01662)
*Wen Zan,Jiaqi Zhang,Jianchao Tan,Hong Liu,Cunguang Wang,Xiang Li,Duyue Ma,Guanyu Wu,Yifan Lu,Fengcun Li,Yerui Sun,Peng Pei,Yuchen Xie,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA)，一个硬件-算法协同设计的稀疏注意力框架，包含流式感知索引、跨层索引和分层索引三种正交策略，解决DeepSeek Sparse Attention中索引器的高计算开销和不连续内存访问问题。实验显示LSA在69B到560B规模的模型上与全注意力性能相当，支持百万token上下文训练，并开源了集成LSA的LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) 虽然通过Lightning Indexer实现了高效的长上下文建模，但其实际部署面临两大瓶颈：一是索引器的O(L²)评分开销过高，二是索引输出导致的硬件低效的不连续内存访问模式。这些问题限制了该方法的实际可用性和可扩展性。

Method: LSA采用三种互补且正交的策略：(1) Streaming-Aware Indexing，将分散的KV条目转换为硬件对齐的连续布局，实现合并的HBM访问；(2) Cross-Layer Indexing，通过跨层蒸馏，将单层索引结果在连续层间复用，摊薄索引开销；(3) Hierarchical Indexing，采用从粗到细的评分方案逐步缩小每个查询的候选集，显著减少索引计算量。

Result: 在69B-A3B到560B-A27B规模的扩展实验中，LSA在通用和长上下文基准上均与全注意力性能相当。LSA支持长达百万token的上下文原生训练，并支撑了LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B)的开发。同时开源了集成LSA的LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse (69B-A3B)。

Conclusion: LSA通过硬件-算法协同设计有效解决了稀疏注意力的系统级瓶颈，在保持与全注意力相当性能的同时，显著提升了长上下文建模的硬件效率和可扩展性，并已在更大规模的模型上得到验证和应用。

Abstract: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) enables efficient long-context modeling through its Lightning Indexer. However, practical deployment remains constrained by the indexer's expensive $O(L^2)$ scoring overhead and the hardware-inefficient, discontinuous memory-access patterns induced by its outputs. To address these system-level bottlenecks, we introduce LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA), a hardware-algorithm co-designed framework comprising three complementary and orthogonal strategies: (1) Streaming-Aware Indexing, which selectively converts scattered KV entries into hardware-aligned contiguous layouts to enable coalesced HBM access; (2) Cross-Layer Indexing, which amortizes indexing overhead by reusing the results produced by a single layer across consecutive layers, supported by cross-layer distillation; and (3) Hierarchical Indexing, which adopts a coarse-to-fine scoring scheme to progressively narrow the candidate set for each query, thereby substantially reducing indexing computation. Extensive scaling experiments, ranging from 69B-A3B to 560B-A27B models, demonstrate that LSA consistently achieves performance on par with full attention across both general-purpose and long-context benchmarks. Moreover, LSA supports native training with context lengths of up to one million tokens and underpins the development of LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B). To facilitate further research, we also introduce and open-source LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse (69B-A3B), which integrates LSA into LongCat-Flash-Lite and incorporates an updated long-context training corpus.

</details>


### [565] [Allocation Before Ranking: Decoupled Token Compression for OmniLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01665)
*Zhenghui Guo,Yilin Yang,Yuanbin Man,Miao Yin,Weidong Shi,Rabimba Karanjai,Omprakash Gnawali,Chengming Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Macer，一种无需训练的token压缩器，通过先分配音频和视频的显式预算，再在模态内部进行分配归一化排名，解决了现有OmniLLM中共享top-K压缩偏向音频分配的问题，在相同压缩率下显著提升多模态性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OmniLLM的token压缩通常被视为单一显著性排名问题（对每个多模态token打分并保留top-K），但作者认为这种抽象存在缺陷：同一个注意力分数同时决定了每个模态获得多少保留容量以及模态内保留哪些token，共享top-K规则继承了音频优先的分配先验，导致保留容量先被音频消耗，视频token没有机会参与竞争。

Method: Macer是一种训练免费的压缩器，包含两个关键步骤：1) 首先为音频和视频分配显式的token预算；2) 然后在各模态特异性浅层进行分配归一化排名（allocation-normalized ranking），即在每个模态内部按其分配的预算进行排名选择。

Result: Macer在音频锚定、音频-视频联合、视觉主导和视频中心等多个基准上显著降低token成本并保持精度。在25%保留率下，Macer在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B上保留了全token性能的98.7%，在Qwen2.5-Omni-3B上保留了97.3%。在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B上，25%保留率设置的性能达到OmniZip在45%保留率下的水平，且FLOPs更低。在OmniVinci-9B上，先分配后排名原则相比共享top-K排名提升了最高12.9个点。

Conclusion: Macer证实了先分配预算再在模态内排名的"先分配后排名"原则优于传统共享top-K的压缩方式，能够在保持高精度的同时显著降低token成本和计算开销。

Abstract: Token compression in OmniLLMs is typically posed as a single saliency-ranking problem: score each multimodal token, keep the top-K. We argue this abstraction is mis-specified. The same attention score simultaneously decides two things: how much retained capacity each modality receives, and which tokens within a modality are kept. A shared top-K rule therefore inherits this audio-favoring allocation prior, spending retained capacity on audio before video tokens have a chance to compete. We propose Macer, a training-free compressor that first assigns explicit audio and video budgets, then performs allocation-normalized ranking within each modality at modality-specific shallow layers. Macer significantly reduces token cost while preserving accuracy across audio-grounded, audio--video joint, visual-dominant, and video-centric benchmarks. At 25 % retention, Macer preserves 98.7 % of full-token performance on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B and 97.3 % on Qwen2.5-Omni-3B. On Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, this 25 % setting reaches OmniZip-level performance at 45 % retention while using lower FLOPs. On OmniVinci-9B, the same allocation-before-ranking principle improves over shared top-K ranking by up to 12.9 points.

</details>


### [566] [TCPO: Turn-Level Credit Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01667)
*Sicong Liao,Zhi Chen,Yaohua Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TCPO是一种用于验证器引导的多轮强化学习中回合级信用分配方法，通过分数到信用的转换机制（包含回顾性信用、后见延迟信用和选择性反事实估计）来优化LLM推理，在数学推理、代码生成和智能体任务上取得最优或最佳效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在验证器引导的多轮强化学习中，模型每轮后获得验证器分数，但分数只衡量当前输出的质量，不直接提供密集信用（credit）——信用应衡量当前回合如何改变细化轨迹。缺乏回合级信用分配机制。

Method: TCPO将信用分配定义为分数到信用的转换，通过基于参考的比较构建回合级优势函数：(1) 回顾性信用捕捉相对于最佳先前状态的即时进展和退步；(2) 后见延迟信用识别具有后期回报的非改进回合；(3) 选择性固定历史反事实估计在相同历史下细化高惊异度回合。

Result: 在数学推理、代码生成和AppWorld智能体任务上的实验表明，TCPO在不同模型规模、任务领域和验证器类型上均优于或匹配最强基线。在Qwen3-4B和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B上取得最佳或并列最佳的best-turn Pass@8，减少成功所需回合数，并提升多轮智能体性能。

Conclusion: 分数到信用的转换是验证器引导多轮策略优化的核心要素，TCPO有效解决了密集反馈不等于密集信用的问题。

Abstract: Verifier-guided reinforcement learning has become a powerful paradigm for improving LLM reasoning. In multi-turn settings, models receive a verifier score after each turn and iteratively refine their outputs. Although such scores provide dense feedback, they do not directly provide dense credit: a score measures the quality of the current output, while credit should measure how the current turn changes the refinement trajectory. We propose TCPO, a turn-level credit assignment method for verifier-guided multi-turn RL.
