We first normalize an LTL formula into the syntactic reactivity fragment of the Manna-Pnueli hierarchy, to create the general fragment-based shape of LTLf+. We then present linear translations for each individual component of that fragment. As a consequence of this translation, the expanding body of techniques developed for LTLf+ now becomes available to many AI problems currently formulated in LTL. We further show that this comes at no asymptotic cost, as the pipeline from LTL to automaton via LTLf+ remains doubly exponential.

</details>


### [634] [Long-term Measurements: Towards a Longitudinal Understanding of Human-AI Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02491)
*Nicole Mitchell,Dhruv Agarwal,Maty Bohacek,Remi Denton,Roma Patel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出NLP领域需要从静态、短期的文本评估转向长期的行为变化测量，以理解人机交互的纵向风险（认知、发展和社会情感层面的变化），并主张将社会科学中的纵向测量方法引入NLP，用于在线检测和缓解语言模型对用户产生的长期负面影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型因其"类人"特性和快速融入日常生活，可能给用户带来认知、发展和社会情感层面的长期纵向风险，这些风险在短期交互中无法显现，但可能产生持久影响。现有NLP评估主要聚焦于静态、短期的文本生成质量，缺乏对长期行为变化的测量能力。

Method: 借鉴社会科学领域中用于理解纵向数据涌现现象的测量方法，将其与NLP计算方法相结合，建立以模型交互为函数的人类行为变化建模框架，实现对问题行为的在线（而非事后）检测。

Result: 提出了一个概念性框架：将纵向行为测量与NLP计算结合，以实现人类行为变化的建模、在线检测问题行为，并将这一能力整合到对齐框架中以缓解用户的长期风险。

Conclusion: NLP需要超越静态评估，建立对"历时性"人机交互的理解，将长期安全风险检测从"事后"转向"在线"，并将此纳入对齐框架，引导模型开发向积极而非消极的用户结果发展。

Abstract: Language models have taken on the role of a very new type of technology, by virtue of their "human-ness" and rapid integration into users' daily lives. This combination of features can introduce longitudinal risks---cognitive, developmental and socio-affective changes in humans---that might not surface in short-term interactions, but can have lasting long-term effects on users. This forms the basis of a critical new mission for NLP: to pivot from static, short-term evaluations of text generations to long-term measurements of behavioral changes, towards a diachronic understanding of human-model interactions. In this work, we draw from measurements used in social science fields that are crucial to understand emergent phenomena in longitudinal data. We discuss how computational methods in the field of NLP need to be combined with such measurements, not only to understand long-term safety risks of human-model interactions, but to help steer model development towards positive rather than negative outcomes for users. This ability to model human behavioral shifts as a function of model interactions can facilitate online rather than post-hoc detection of problematic behaviors, and should be leveraged in alignment frameworks to mitigate long-term risks in users.

</details>


### [635] [CMuon: Accelerating and Stabilizing Diffusion Transformer Training via Chunked Momentum Orthogonalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02502)
*Chuyan Chen,Peng Sun,Kun Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Chunked Muon (CMuon)优化器，解决Muon优化器直接应用于扩散Transformer（DiT）时出现的晚期收敛瓶颈问题。通过将DiT中融合的权重矩阵（如AdaLN和QKV层）拆分为独立子组件再进行正交化，避免隐式子空间耦合，实现了比AdamW快2倍以上的训练速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT在视觉生成建模中达到SOTA性能，但训练计算成本高昂。Muon优化器虽为AdamW的有力替代方案，直接应用于DiT时却出现次优的晚期收敛问题；作者旨在识别瓶颈根源并提供有效解决方案。

Method: 1) 识别标准DiT架构将功能不同的权重（AdaLN和QKV层）融为统一张量以提升计算效率；2) 发现直接应用Muon到这些融合张量会引发隐式子空间耦合，扭曲更新方向；3) 提出Chunked Muon (CMuon)——在正交化前将矩阵划分为独立子组件的简单高效策略。

Result: 675M参数的DiT使用CMuon在ImageNet 256上仅用200个epoch即达到FID 1.18；相比AdamW实现超过2倍的训练加速，同时有效克服了vanilla Muon的晚期收敛平台期。

Conclusion: CMuon是一个简单但高效的优化方法，通过解耦DiT中融合权重的子空间来充分发挥Muon优化器的潜力，显著加速DiT训练并超越AdamW性能。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in visual generative modeling, yet their training remains computationally prohibitive. While the recently proposed Momentum Orthogonalization (Muon) optimizer offers a promising alternative to AdamW, its direct application to DiTs yields suboptimal late-stage convergence. In this paper, we identify the root cause of this bottleneck: standard DiT architectures fuse functionally distinct weights (e.g., within AdaLN and QKV layers) into unified tensors for computational efficiency. Applying Muon to these fused tensors inadvertently induces implicit subspace coupling, which distorts update directions and degrades global optimization. To address this, we introduce Chunked Muon (CMuon), a simple yet highly effective strategy that partitions these matrices into independent sub-components prior to orthogonalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that a 675M-parameter DiT trained with CMuon achieves a FID of 1.18 on ImageNet 256 in just 200 epochs. This represents more than a 2x training speedup over AdamW, while effectively overcoming the late-stage convergence plateaus of vanilla Muon.

</details>


### [636] [Abduction Without a Body? Representational Grounding and the Abduction Loop for Scientific Hypothesis Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02505)
*Michael Farmer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文主张科学溯因（特别是身份溯因——推断两个独立发展的结构在显式对应下是同一对象）不必然需要连续的感知运动具身。作者提出"Abduction Loop"架构，通过表征生成、基序提取、惯例空间规范化、跨域检索、身份假说生成和对抗性验证六个环节，利用跨学科图表中体现的惯例空间来实现无身体交互的溯因推理，并给出DAB-30基准作为可证伪的评估方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI与科学哲学中近期论证认为真正假说生成需要智能体与物理世界连续耦合（在线具身）。作者反对这一过度宽泛的主张，旨在证明并非所有溯因科学行为都需要在线具身，特别是身份溯因可以通过表征落地（representational grounding）而非身体交互来获得新的推理可供性。同时解决一个现实问题：当两个领域缺乏共同判别性词汇时，如何检索数学上相关的工作。

Method: 提出"惯例空间"（convention space）概念——科学图表承载跨学科部分规范化的对称性、拓扑和算子结构。在此之上设计Abduction Loop架构，包含六个环节：表征生成（representation generation）、基序提取（motif extraction）、惯例空间规范化（convention-space canonicalization）、跨域检索（cross-domain retrieval）、身份假说生成（identity-hypothesis generation）与对抗性验证（adversarial verification），并以弃权（abstention）为设计默认行为。架构从一个文档化的可能性见证事件中抽象而来：多模态模型将引力记忆传输模型的中心微分复形与弱引力透镜学中球形Kaiser-Squires质量映射复形识别为等价。

Result: 作者提供的是一个机制提案、一个架构和一个测试程序，而非一般能力的实证证据。该可能性见证事件（gravitational-memory transport模型与Kaiser-Squires复形的等价性发现）仅作为架构抽象化的动机来源。为允许未来可证伪验证，提出了DAB-30基准测试。论文核心贡献在于论证了身份溯因可通过表征转换暴露潜在不变量的方式实现，而非必须有在线身体交互。

Conclusion: 作者对"所有科学溯因都需要在线感知运动具身"的论点提出限定性反驳：在线具身并非每一种溯因科学行为所必需。身份溯因可以通过表征转换（暴露潜在不变量）而非身体交互来完成。惯例空间为跨领域检索提供了词汇无关的桥梁，Abduction Loop架构为这种无具身溯因提供了可操作的机制化路径，而DAB-30基准则为未来的严格评估提供了可证伪的测试框架。

Abstract: Can scientific abduction occur without continuous sensorimotor embodiment? Recent arguments in AI and philosophy of science hold that genuine hypothesis generation requires an agent continuously coupled to the physical world. We defend a narrower claim: online embodiment is not necessary for every abductive scientific act. Our focus is identity abduction: the inference that two independently developed structures are one object under an explicit correspondence, reached through representational grounding rather than bodily interaction. An agent may acquire new inferential affordances not through physical interaction but through transformations into representations that expose latent invariants. Scientific diagrams are a practical substrate because they embody independently evolved conventions that partially canonicalize symmetry, topology, and operator structure across disciplines - a property we develop as convention space, which answers a hard retrieval problem: finding mathematically related work when two fields share no discriminating vocabulary. We operationalize the mechanism as an architecture, the Abduction Loop: representation generation, motif extraction, convention-space canonicalization, cross-domain retrieval, identity-hypothesis generation, and adversarial verification, with abstention as the designed default. A documented episode, in which a multimodal model given a figure of a gravitational-memory transport model generated and then verified the hypothesis that its central differential complex is equivalent to the spherical Kaiser-Squires mass-mapping complex of weak-lensing cosmology, serves as a motivating possibility witness from which the architecture is abstracted, not as evidence of general capability. We close with a falsifiable evaluation program, the DAB-30 benchmark. The contribution is a mechanistic proposal, an architecture, and a test program.

</details>


### [637] [Optimizing Minimax Regret in Uncertain MDPs with Small Sets of Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02509)
*Sterre Lutz,Daniël Vos,Matthijs T. J. Spaan,Anna Lukina*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出k-自适应策略综合（k-adaptable policy synthesis）问题，在不确定马尔可夫决策过程（UMDPs）下，预先优化一组k个策略以在模型不确定性解决后选择最合适的策略，目标是最小化最大遗憾（minimax-regret）。作者证明该问题为NP-hard，并开发了KAPS算法——一个精确的嵌套分支定界算法，包含问题特定的边界和启发式方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界的顺序决策常面临环境模型不确定性。传统方法要么优化单个策略而牺牲性能，要么为每个可能的MDP准备独立优化的策略，但可能违反操作、监管或可解释性约束（策略数量有限）。实际场景中模型不确定性在执行前才被解决，因此需要一种在预先准备有限策略集的情况下优化决策的方法。

Method: 1) 形式化定义k-自适应策略综合问题，目标是在minimax-regret目标下优化一组k个策略。2) 证明该问题为NP-hard。3) 开发KAPS算法：精确的嵌套分支定界算法，包含问题特定的边界函数和启发式规则。4) KAPS联合优化两个关键方面：哪些MDP共享同一策略，以及各策略本身的最优参数。

Result: 在多个UMDP基准实验上，最大的遗憾减少发生在策略数量从1增加到2时。在单策略设置下，KAPS在解质量上与现有方法具有竞争力，并且证明最优性的频率显著更高。

Conclusion: KAPS为UMDPs下的有限策略集优化提供了精确的解决方案，其有效性和最优性保证在实验中得到了验证，特别是在策略数量较少时能够显著降低遗憾。

Abstract: Sequential decision-making in real-world applications often involves uncertainty about the environment's model. Uncertain Markov decision processes (UMDPs) represent the possible environments as a set of MDPs with shared states and actions but potentially different transition probabilities and rewards. Optimizing a single policy across all possible MDPs may sacrifice performance, while preparing an individually optimized policy for every MDP may violate operational, regulatory, or interpretability constraints on the number of policies that can be prepared and deployed. We consider settings in which model uncertainty is resolved shortly before execution, allowing the most suitable policy to be selected from a limited set prepared in advance. We introduce $k$-adaptable policy synthesis, which optimizes such a set of $k$ policies under a minimax-regret objective. We prove that the problem is NP-hard and develop KAPS, an exact nested branch-and-bound algorithm with problem-specific bounds and heuristics. KAPS jointly optimizes which MDPs share a policy and the policies themselves. Experiments across various UMDP benchmarks show that the largest reduction in regret consistently occurs when increasing from one to two policies. In the single-policy setting, KAPS is competitive with existing methods in solution quality and proves optimality substantially more often.

</details>


### [638] [Magnet: Detecting Cross-Session AI Misuse Through Capability Accumulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02518)
*Natalie Isak,Matthew Dressman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出现有AI滥用检测框架仅覆盖单轮或单会话威胁模型，无法应对攻击者将有害目标分解为看似无害的单元并在多个隔离的代理会话中执行（跨会话目标分解）以逃避检测的问题。作者提出Magnet检测方法，通过在高层级关联器（用户ID）聚合跨会话、跨时间累积的能力证据，将分散在良性会话中的"针"吸引成紧凑的证据包供检测器处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最先进的AI部署是多个专门代理协调运作的集合体，这引入现有监控框架无法应对的新风险。现有滥用检测文献主要针对单轮或多轮（单会话）威胁模型，存在关键空白：攻击者可将有害目标分解为无害单元，在隔离的代理会话中分别执行。代理在会话间无状态，但攻击者有状态，这种不对称性使跨会话轨迹能有效逃避检测。

Method: 1) 演示跨会话目标分解作为逃避技术，表明其可能激发比等效单会话或多轮攻击更强的有害能力；2) 提出Magnet检测方法：跨时间和代理会话建模累积的相关能力，在更高层级关联器（用户ID）而非逐会话状态进行聚合。核心挑战是组装证据包——通过吸引（而非逐会话检查）方式，将散布在大量良性会话中的有害"针"跨会话跨时间抽取出紧凑证据包供检测器使用。

Result: 实验证明跨会话目标分解作为一种逃避技术，可能比等效单会话/多轮攻击激发更多的有害能力（表现为产物与工具调用结果等可组合的有害能力）。Magnet作为检测方法，能够高效且稳健地建模跨会话累积的能力，将分散的证据组装为可操作的紧凑证据包。

Conclusion: 跨会话攻击是现有检测框架的重要盲区，需将检测视角从逐会话状态提升到用户层面的跨会话聚合。Magnet通过"吸引针"式的证据组装方式，为检测跨会话分布式有害行为提供了高效稳健的方案。

Abstract: The most capable AI deployments are not single models but ensembles of specialized agents that delegate and act in coordination. This architecture unlocks powerful new capabilities, and it also introduces risks that existing frameworks for monitoring, detection, and mitigation were not designed to address. Most state-of-the-art AI abuse detection literature focuses on single-turn or multi-turn (single-session) threat models. This leaves a critical gap: an attacker can decompose a harmful goal into innocuous-looking units and execute each in isolated agentic sessions. The agent is stateless between conversations, but the attacker is not. This asymmetry allows for cross-session trajectories that are effective at evading detection. Our contributions are twofold. First, we demonstrate cross-session goal decomposition as an evasion technique, showing it may elicit more harmful capability than equivalent single-session or multi-turn attacks. By capability we mean an artifact produced at one step of an objective, evidenced by what an interaction produced (model responses and tool-call results), and composable with capabilities accrued elsewhere into a harmful whole. Second, we propose Magnet: an efficient and robust detection approach that models relevant capabilities accrued over time and across agentic conversations, aggregated at a higher-level correlator (in this case, a user ID) rather than per-conversation state. The main challenge is assembling the evidence bundle Magnet reasons over. The incriminating artifacts may be needles scattered through a haystack of benign sessions that are individually harmless, dangerous only once collected. Rather than searching the haystack straw-by-straw (i.e. per-session inspection), Magnet does what its name implies: it attracts the relevant needles out of the hay, across sessions and across time, into a compact evidence bundle a detector can act on.

</details>


### [639] [A Taxonomy of Cognitive Capability Gaps in Generative and Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02553)
*Taye Akinrele,Sindhuja Penchala,Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz,Sudip Mittal,Shahram Rahimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于分类法的认知AI综述，围绕五个维度（持久状态建模、目标导向自主性、自我监控与控制、环境交互、学习与适应）系统梳理了认知AI中的能力缺口，并提出自适应认知智能架构（ACIA）和认知中心评估框架，为迈向AGI提供路线图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管生成式和代理式AI在广泛任务上展现了强大能力，但许多基本的认知功能仍然碎片化或发展薄弱，限制了系统在长时间跨度上的可靠运行。作者希望通过系统化的分类学分析，明确认知AI当前存在的关键能力缺口，为未来研究提供统一框架和指导方向。

Method: 本文采用分类法驱动的综述方法，将现有文献组织在五个认知维度下：持久状态建模、目标导向自主性、自我监控与控制、环境交互、学习与适应。对每个维度回顾最新进展、识别反复出现的局限性、讨论开放研究挑战，并在此基础上提出概念性的自适应认知智能架构（ACIA）以及面向认知中心的评估框架。

Result: 论文产出了三个核心成果：一个统一的认知能力分类体系；一个概念性的自适应认知智能架构（ACIA）；以及一个认知中心评估框架。这些共同构成了组织现有研究、识别未解决问题和指导未来认知智能系统设计的路线图。

Conclusion: 该综述指出，认知AI需要在持续推理、自适应决策和持续学习方面取得突破。所提出的分类学、架构视角和评估框架为构建更可靠、更自适应、更具认知能力的AI系统奠定了基础，也为最终迈向AGI指明了关键研究机会。

Abstract: Cognitive AI seeks to move beyond language generation and autonomous task execution toward systems capable of sustained reasoning, adaptive behavior, persistent memory, and self-regulation. While generative and agentic AI have demonstrated impressive capabilities across a wide range of tasks, many fundamental cognitive functions remain fragmented or weakly developed, limiting reliable operation over extended time horizons. This paper presents a taxonomy-driven survey of the major cognitive capability gaps that continue to constrain the development of Cognitive AI. The literature is organized around five dimensions: persistent state modeling, goal-directed autonomy, self-monitoring and control, environment interaction, and learning and adaptation. For each dimension, we review recent advances, identify recurring limitations, and discuss open research challenges. Building on these insights, we outline a conceptual Adaptive Cognitive Intelligence Architecture (ACIA) and examine emerging directions in cognition-centric evaluation. The proposed taxonomy provides a unified framework for organizing existing research, identifying unresolved challenges, and guiding the design of future cognitively capable systems. Together, the taxonomy, architectural perspective, and evaluation framework offer a roadmap for advancing AI systems that exhibit more reliable long-term reasoning, adaptive decision-making, and continual learning. The survey highlights key research opportunities toward more adaptive, reliable, and cognitively capable AI systems, providing a foundation for future progress toward Cognitive AI and, ultimately, Artificial General Intelligence (AGI).

</details>


### [640] [AtumAI: A Principled Framework for Agentic Generation of Datacenter Control-Plane Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02569)
*Qiushi Lin,Chaojie Zhang,Íñigo Goiri,Aditya Akella,Ricardo Bianchini,Jovan Stojkovic*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了AtumAI，一个利用智能体AI自动生成数据中心控制面策略的框架。它通过两个核心组件——数据中心任务编译器（将自然语言目标编译为形式化、可搜索的规范）和进化设计发现循环（结合扩散模型、进化算法和代理模型扩展搜索空间）——实现了策略生成的正式化、可迁移性和系统性，并在工作负载放置、资源扩展和电源管理三个任务中优于专家设计的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心控制面策略（如工作负载放置、资源扩展、电源管理）的设计越来越困难，因为硬件软件栈快速演进、设计空间庞大且相互依赖、单个策略原型开发需要数月时间。现成的智能体AI在三个关键方面存在不足：不够形式化（缺乏结构化问题表述，难以保证硬约束）、不可迁移（每个任务从零开始解决）、不系统（过度依赖LLM作为唯一候选来源，探索空间狭窄且容易陷入局部最优）。

Method: AtumAI包含两个核心组件：1）数据中心任务编译器（Datacenter Task Compiler）：将自然语言目标自动编译为形式化、机器可检查、可搜索的任务规范，涵盖目标、约束、决策变量和评估方法；2）进化设计发现循环（Evolutionary Design Discovery Loop）:在编译出的规范上执行搜索，通过扩散模型、进化算法和代理模型扩展超越LLM本身的搜索空间，实现系统化的候选策略生成与迭代优化。

Result: 在三个不同问题范围、设计空间和权衡的控制器任务（工作负载放置、资源扩展和电源管理）上，AtumAI生成策略一致优于专家设计的基线，同时将新任务的引入从数月工程工作简化为仅需编写任务描述。

Conclusion: AtumAI证明了通过将形式化方法、可迁移的知识和系统化搜索机制整合到智能体AI框架中，可以自动化数据中心控制面策略的发现过程，大幅降低任务引入成本，并生成优于人工专家的策略。

Abstract: The efficiency of a datacenter rests on its control plane policies. Designing these policies is increasingly hard: the hardware-software stack grows fast, the design space is vast and interdependent, and prototyping a single policy takes months. Agentic AI promises to automate this search. Off the shelf, however, it falls short on three fronts. It is not formal: with no structured, searchable statement of the problem, the search has little structure to exploit and hard constraints are not guaranteed. It is not transferable: each task is solved from scratch, so nothing learned on one task carries to the next. Finally, it is not systematic: relying on the LLM as the sole source of candidates, it explores a narrow slice of the design space and settles into local optima. We introduce AtumAI, a framework that generates datacenter control-plane policies with agentic AI, making the process formal, transferable, and systematic. From a goal stated in plain language, AtumAI autonomously proposes, tests, and refines candidate policies until one satisfies the request. It does so through two components. The Datacenter Task Compiler automates problem formulation: it compiles the request into a formal, machine-checkable, and searchable specification of the task's objectives, constraints, decision variables, and evaluation methodology. The Evolutionary Design Discovery Loop then searches this specification, expanding the search beyond the LLM itself via a diffusion model, an evolutionary algorithm, and a surrogate model. Together, they reduce onboarding a new task from months of engineering to writing its description. We evaluate AtumAI on three control-plane tasks with distinct problem scopes, design spaces, and trade-offs: workload placement, resource scaling, and power management. Across all tasks, the policies generated by AtumAI consistently outperform expert-engineered baselines.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [641] [Cross-Benchmark Generalization in Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00181)
*Sushant Mehta,Logan Ritchie,Liudas Panavas,Edwin Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文探讨了RL训练中策略可能利用环境特定规律而非获得可迁移技能的问题，并提出跨基准迁移作为判别性测试。通过在363个MCP任务上对Qwen3.5-122B-A10B进行两阶段SFT-then-RL后训练，模型在五个外部评测基准上均获得提升（即使训练数据不含软件工程任务），配对轨迹分析发现四种可迁移的行为模式差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习在自包含环境中训练时，策略可能通过利用环境特有的规律（如工具模式、评分器解析、任务模板）而非获取可迁移技能来获得奖励。分布内验证集无法区分这两者，因为分布内划分共享这些规律。因此作者认为"行为"层面的跨基准迁移才是判断训练是否真正改变工作方式的正确标准。

Method: 1) 使用Qwen3.5-122B-A10B混合专家模型，在363个长时程MCP任务（27个类别）上用两阶段SFT-then-RL流水线进行后训练。2) 工具性能（Toolathlon）仅用于选择基座模型和SFT教师，外部基准任务/评分器/奖励/超参数/检查点选择均不进入训练。3) 在五个外部评测基准上以贪心pass@1评估。4) 进行探索性配对轨迹分析以识别行为差异。

Result: 训练模型在greedy pass@1下于五个外部基准均优于基座：Toolathlon提升9.6个百分点，τ²-Bench提升5.3个百分点，BFCL-V4提升3.5个百分点，SWE-Bench Pro提升5.8个百分点，Terminal-Bench 2提升2.8个百分点。尽管训练数据不含软件工程任务，两个软件工程基准仍获提升。配对轨迹分析识别出四种反复出现的行为差异：更谨慎的局部目标形成、构建目标相关的工作状态、通过局部修复保持父目标稳定、以及验证完成状态。

Conclusion: 长时程多工具后训练可以改变"工作方式"并超越训练领域迁移。跨基准迁移的实证证据表明，训练确实产生了可迁移的行为能力而非仅仅是环境特定的过拟合，且这些行为模式在办公室工作流与代码编写中呈现类似形式。

Abstract: For reinforcement learning (RL) in self-contained environments, a policy can get rewards by exploiting environment-specific regularities (tool schemas, grader parsing, task templates) rather than by acquiring transferable skill, and an in-distribution holdout shares those regularities. We argue that the discriminating question is behavioral, namely how a trained agent acts, and that cross-benchmark transfer is the right place to look for it. We post-train an open-weight mixture-of-experts model (Qwen3.5-122B-A10B) on 363 long-horizon Model Context Protocol (MCP) tasks across 27 categories, using a two-stage SFT-then-RL pipeline. Toolathlon performance informed the initial base-family and SFT-teacher choices, but no external-benchmark task or grader entered training and no external score informed the reward, training hyperparameters, trained-checkpoint selection, or stopping. At greedy pass@1, the trained model improves over the base on five reported external evaluations: Toolathlon (+9.6 pp), $τ^2$-Bench (+5.3 pp), BFCL-V4 (+3.5 pp), SWE-Bench Pro (+5.8 pp), and Terminal-Bench 2 (+2.8 pp). Both software-engineering benchmarks improve despite the training collection containing no software-engineering tasks. An exploratory paired-trajectory analysis identifies four recurring behavioral differences (more careful local-goal formation, building goal-relevant working state, keeping parent goals stable through local repairs, and verifying completion) that appear in analogous forms across office workflows and code. These results provide descriptive evidence that long-horizon multi-tool post-training can change ways of working that transfer beyond its training domain.

</details>


### [642] [Source Code Authorship Attribution Does Not Generalize from Competitions to Classrooms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00227)
*Serhii Yemets,Marek Horváth*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文使用CodeBERT在多种数据源（Google Code Jam和课程作业）上进行源代码作者归属任务，发现其在GCJ数据上表现优异（1000作者时Top-1达70.7%），但在课程作业数据上表现与随机基线相当（0.2%和0.06%），表明GCJ基准高估了该任务在教育场景中的实际应用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有源代码作者归属研究多基于竞争性编程数据集（如Google Code Jam）进行评估，但这些数据集可能无法反映真实教育场景中课程作业的特征。作者希望检验基于GCJ训练的模型在实际教学环境中的泛化能力，揭示数据集差异对任务评估的影响。

Method: 对预训练Transformer模型CodeBERT进行微调，在三种数据源上评估：Kaggle上的GCJ开源数据、精选GCJ存档、技术大学的课程作业数据集。同时构建多模型基准（多种模型家族）进行跨模型一致性验证，并分析数据特性和任务属性以解释性能差距。

Result: GCJ数据上CodeBERT在10位作者时Top-1准确率达92.6%，1000位作者时Top-1为70.7%（Top-10为88.2%）；但在课程作业数据集上性能极低：闭合作业数据集（690作者）Top-1仅0.2%，开放式作业（812作者）Top-1仅0.06%，均处于随机基线水平。多模型基准显示性能差距在所有模型家族中一致存在。

Conclusion: 基于GCJ的基准会显著高估源代码作者归属在教育场景中的实际应用效果，除非在目标课程作业语境下进行验证。数据集和任务特性的差异（如GCJ代码风格的独特性）是导致性能差距的可能原因。研究警示研究者需谨慎评估模型在真实教育环境中的部署价值。

Abstract: Source code authorship attribution aims to identify the author of a program fragment from its writing style. We fine-tune the pre-trained transformer CodeBERT on three sources of data: publicly available Google Code Jam (GCJ) submissions from an open Kaggle repository, a curated GCJ archive, and institutional coursework datasets collected at a technical university. On multi-round GCJ data, CodeBERT reaches 92.6% Top-1 accuracy for 10 authors and retains 70.7% Top-1 (88.2% Top-10) for 1000 authors. On the examined coursework datasets, the same pipeline performs at or below the corresponding chance baselines: 0.2% Top-1 on a closed-assignment dataset of 690 authors and 0.06% Top-1 on open-ended assignments evaluated over 812 authors. A companion multi-model benchmark provides consistent cross-model evidence across additional dataset configurations, indicating that the observed performance gap is not specific to CodeBERT and persists across the evaluated model families. We analyze dataset and task properties that plausibly explain this gap and argue that GCJ-based benchmarks overestimate the practical applicability of authorship attribution in educational settings unless they are validated on the target coursework context.

</details>


### [643] [Modelling Android applications through static analysis and systematic exploratory testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00228)
*Jordan Doyle,Thomas Laurent,Anthony Ventresque*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: DroidGraph是一个用于Android应用的综合控制流模型生成框架，结合传统静态分析和高效的系统性探索测试，生成从底层方法语句到高层用户界面结构的详细模型，以支持自动化测试生成。在19个应用上的实验表明，其探索测试平均比随机探索多交互18%的应用内容，且少了345次交互，同时补充了静态分析，平均多发现51个组件和49%的界面回调链接。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动应用开发节奏快、发布频繁，需要自动化测试生成；基于模型的测试生成是最常见且有效的方法之一，但Android平台给应用建模带来了诸多困难——静态分析难以应对事件驱动特性及多样化的开发机制，而动态分析（如随机测试生成器）速度慢、效率低且缺乏应用知识。

Method: DroidGraph框架结合了传统静态分析和高效的系统性探索测试：静态分析用于理解应用代码结构，系统性探索测试用于动态发现应用行为，两者互补以生成全面的控制流模型，涵盖从底层方法语句到高层用户界面结构的多个层次。

Result: 在19个多样化应用上的实验表明：高效探索测试平均比常用随机探索多交互18%的应用内容，且少了345次交互；将动态分析结果与静态分析整合后，平均多发现51个组件和49%的界面回调链接。

Conclusion: DroidGraph通过结合静态分析与高效的动态探索，能够生成更全面的Android应用控制流模型，比纯随机探索效率更高、覆盖率更大，并能有效补充静态分析的不足，为自动化测试生成提供更可靠的支持。

Abstract: Mobile application development is a fast paced industry with frequent releases. While the development pace increases, so too does the need for automated test generation. Model-based test generation is one of the most common and successful approaches to support this need. Understanding and modelling the application under test is integral to producing comprehensive, dependable and effective tests. Unfortunately, mobile platforms such as Android, introduce a host of difficulties. Static analysis struggles with Android's event-based nature and the growing variety of mechanisms available for developers to implement different features. Additionally, dynamic analysis, implemented by popular random test generators, is slow, inefficient, and limited by a lack of application knowledge.
  This paper introduces DroidGraph, a framework to generate a comprehensive control flow model of Android applications using traditional static analysis and efficient systematic exploratory tests. DroidGraph provides a detailed model of an Android application, from low level method statements to high level user interface structures. This model can be used to support automated test generation. We apply DroidGraph to 19 diverse apps and show that our efficient exploratory tests, on average, interact with 18% more of the app than commonly used random exploration in 345 less interactions. Integrating the dynamic analysis results provided by these tests complements our static analysis, and uncovers on average 51 more components and 49% more interface callback links in the application code.

</details>


### [644] [PADRAIG: Precise Android Automated Input Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00230)
*Jordan Doyle,Thomas Laurent,Anthony Ventresque*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出PADRAIG，一个基于模型的Android自动化测试输入生成框架，利用详细的控制流模型在更短时间内生成高行覆盖率的测试。在19个F-Droid应用上，相比三种最先进工具，平均覆盖率提高16%，生成运行时降低84%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Android自动化测试输入生成方法各有不足：随机输入生成效率低下；系统性和基于搜索的方法虽然能生成有效测试但需要过长的生成时间；模型驱动的方法虽能加快测试生成，但建模应用本身带来额外开销。需要一种能在保证高覆盖率的同时降低生成运行时的方法。

Method: 提出PADRAIG框架，该方法基于应用的详细控制流模型来生成测试输入。利用控制流建模指导测试输入生成，实现在较低生成运行时下获得更高的行覆盖率。在19个随机选取的F-Droid应用上与三种采用不同测试输入生成技术的最先进工具进行对比实验。

Result: 在19个随机选取的F-Droid Android应用上进行评估，PADRAIG相比最先进工具平均实现16%更高的行覆盖率，同时生成测试的平均运行时减少了84%。

Conclusion: PADRAIG证明了基于详细控制流模型的测试输入生成方法能够在显著降低生成运行时的同时提高行覆盖率，在效率与效果之间取得了优于现有方法的平衡。

Abstract: Android automated test input generation has been a highly researched topic for over a decade and has shown promising results with a variety of approaches. Random input generation is commonly used and the easiest to maintain, but ultimately inefficient. Systematic and search-based approaches produce effective tests but require a disproportionally large generation runtime. Model-based approaches have the additional overhead of modelling the application under test (AUT) but they result in a faster test generation.
  In this paper we present Precise AnDRoid Automated Input Generation (PADRAIG), a model-based test input generation framework that uses a detailed control flow model of the AUT to generate tests that can achieve higher line coverage, with a lower test generation runtime than the state of the art. We compare the line coverage achieved, and the generation runtime of PADRAIG against 3 state of the art tools, each of which uses a different test input generation technique. Our results, using 19 randomly selected Android apps from the F-Droid application store, show that PADRAIG achieves, on average, 16% more coverage of the AUT than the state of the art and it can generate tests with, on average, 84% less runtime.

</details>


### [645] [Improving Mobile User Interface Testing with Model Driven Monkey Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00236)
*Jordan Doyle,Takfarinas Saber,Paolo Arcaini,Anthony Ventresque*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的控制流结构来表示Android应用程序的代码及交互元素，通过将该结构与深度优先搜索算法结合，显著提升了Android测试工具Exerciser Monkey的测试效率和覆盖率，使测试套件比随机测试快一个数量级并实现用户交互元素的完全覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Android测试工具（如Exerciser Monkey）通过随机生成事件进行测试，但缺乏对应用程序结构的了解，导致测试速度慢、覆盖率低且无法有效发现bug。开发者手动设计测试场景又过于耗费人力。

Method: 提出一种新颖的控制流结构来表示Android应用代码及其所有交互元素，赋予测试工具对测试环境的认知能力。通过在该控制流结构上执行深度优先搜索（DFS）来生成测试套件，替代随机事件生成方式。

Result: 对比实验表明，与随机测试的Exerciser Monkey相比，基于深度优先搜索的Monkey++测试套件速度提升一个数量级，并实现了用户交互元素的完全覆盖率。

Conclusion: 该控制流结构结合深度优先搜索能有效提升Android自动化测试的效率和有效性，并有望为基于搜索的Android测试技术提供更好的目标导向方法。

Abstract: Testing mobile applications often relies on tools, such as Exerciser Monkey for Android systems, that simulate user input. Exerciser Monkey, for example, generates random events (e.g., touches, gestures, navigational keys) that give developers a sense of what their application will do when deployed on real mobile phones with real users interacting with it. These tools, however, have no knowledge of the underlying applications' structures and only interact with them randomly or in a predefined manner (e.g., if developers designed scenarios, a labour-intensive task) -- making them slow and poor at finding bugs.
  In this paper, we propose a novel control flow structure able to represent the code of Android applications, including all the interactive elements. We show that our structure can increase the effectiveness (higher coverage) and efficiency (removing duplicate/redundant tests) of the Exerciser Monkey by giving it knowledge of the test environment. We compare the interface coverage achieved by the Exerciser Monkey with our new Monkey++ using a depth first search of our control flow structure and show that while the random nature of Exerciser Monkey creates slow test suites of poor coverage, the test suite created by a depth first search is one order of magnitude faster and achieves full coverage of the user interaction elements. We believe this research will lead to a more effective and efficient Exerciser Monkey, as well as better targeted search based techniques for automated Android testing.

</details>


### [646] [SMS Opt-In/Opt-Out Consent Record Architecture in Enterprise CRM Systems: Compliance Patterns for Multi-Tenant Managed Packages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00248)
*Devam Gupta*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在CRM多租户托管包中实现合规同意记录（consent record）的生产级架构，应对TCPA等法规对短信营销的严格同意要求。该架构包含数据模型设计、基于关键词的同意捕获、基于哈希的唯一性去重策略、发送时抑制执行等核心组件，并考虑了多租户市场分发场景下的架构约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TCPA等法规要求企业消息系统必须获取并记录明确的用户同意才能发送短信，且需立即处理退订请求。然而CRM平台虽然提供了丰富的联系人和线索数据模型，却没有将同意状态作为一等公民（first-class record）原生建模。这一问题在多租户托管包场景下尤为严重，因为包无法假设或修改安装组织的schema。

Method: 从CRM原生消息托管包的实际生产模式中泛化出一套同意记录架构，涵盖：(1) 数据模型设计；(2) 基于关键词的同意捕获机制；(3) 基于哈希的唯一性去重策略；(4) 消息发送时的抑制执行；(5) 多租户约束驱动的设计决策。

Result: 论文描述的架构已在医疗、金融、销售运营等多个独立企业组织的生产环境中部署验证，证明了该同意记录架构在真实多租户场景下的可行性和有效性。

Conclusion: 该研究填补了CRM平台在原生同意状态建模上的空白，为多租户托管包场景下的合规消息发送提供了可复用的架构模式和设计经验。

Abstract: Regulatory frameworks such as the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) impose strict consent requirements on enterprise messaging systems: organizations must obtain and record explicit opt-in consent before sending SMS communications, and must immediately honor opt-out requests. While CRM platforms provide rich contact and lead data models, they do not natively model consent state as a first-class record type. This gap becomes architecturally significant in multi-tenant managed packages distributed via enterprise application marketplaces, where the package cannot assume or modify the installing organization's schema. This paper presents a production consent record architecture, generalized from patterns implemented within a CRM-native messaging managed package serving independent enterprise organizations spanning healthcare, financial services, and sales operations. We describe the data model design, keyword-based consent capture, a hash-based uniqueness strategy for deduplication, suppression enforcement at message send time, and the multi-tenant constraints that shaped these design decisions.

</details>


### [647] [LoopsBench: From Harness Engineering to Loop Engineering in Benchmarking Coding Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00267)
*Han Li,Zhemin Fang,Rili Feng,Yingqi Zhao,Jiaheng Liu,Pengfei Gao,He Ye,Dayi Lin,Qingwei Lin,Saravan Rajmohan,Dongmei Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LOOPSBENCH是一个面向编码智能体"循环工程"（loop engineering）评估的长时程基准，包含112个来自真实来源的任务，每个任务是一个依赖DAG（有向无环图），涵盖8种编程语言和9个领域。实验表明最强的配置（Opus-4.7 + Claude Code + 外部续接）仅解决25.00%的任务，揭示了现有编码智能体在持续执行场景下的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体基础设施正从"护栏工程"（harness engineering）转向"循环工程"（loop engineering），因为智能体被部署用于持续的长时程软件开发。现有基准往往聚焦于局部任务或最终状态结果，难以提供对持续执行过程的深入洞察，缺乏评估长时间循环执行能力的基准。

Method: LOOPSBENCH将每个任务建模为依赖DAG，其中每个节点是独立可测试的开发单元，边由源代码证据支撑的前置关系构成。基准包含112个来自真实来源的任务，覆盖8种编程语言和9个领域。其流感知运行时（flow-aware runtime）沿就绪边界（ready frontier）发布测试，并保留已完成节点作为回归义务。作者评估了前沿编码智能体搭配常用循环实现的组合配置。

Result: 最强配置Opus-4.7与Claude Code及外部续接组合仅解决25.00%的任务。记录的规划仅能恢复部分源码推导的前置依赖DAG，且回归事件在各评估的循环配置中均可观察到。

Conclusion: 现有编码智能体在长时程软件开发任务上表现有限，循环工程仍有大量改进空间。论文开源了全部基准数据、5300多个开发单元及可执行测试，为社区提供了评估和推动循环工程发展的基础设施。

Abstract: Coding agent infrastructure is shifting from harness engineering toward loop engineering as coding agents are deployed for sustained long-horizon software development. Existing benchmarks often center on localized tasks or end-state outcomes, offering limited insight into sustained execution. We introduce LOOPSBENCH, a long-horizon benchmark for loop engineering in coding agent evaluation. Each task is a dependency DAG over separately testable development units with source-evidenced prerequisite edges. LOOPSBENCH comprises 112 tasks from authentic sources spanning 8 programming languages and 9 domains. Its flow-aware runtime releases tests along the ready frontier and retains completed nodes as regression obligations. We evaluate frontier coding agents paired with widely used loop implementations. The strongest configuration, Opus-4.7 with Claude Code and outer continuation, resolves 25.00% of tasks. Recorded plans recover only part of the source-recovered prerequisite DAG, and regression events remain visible across the evaluated loop profiles. We open source the benchmark data and code, including all tasks, more than 5,300 development units, and executable tests, at microsoft/Loopsbench.

</details>


### [648] [OrEdge: Efficient Multi-Modal Anomaly Detection in Distributed Software Systems via Orthogonal-Domain Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00309)
*Amr M. Zaki,Farhoud Jafari Kaleibar,Honggeun Ji,Komal Sarda,Marin Litoiu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: OrEdge是一种轻量级实时多模态异常检测框架，利用正交域时间表示替代昂贵的注意力/图架构，在保持竞争性能的同时将重建模型压缩至最多9.6K参数，并在树莓派等边缘设备上实现亚秒级推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态分布式系统异常检测方法依赖计算昂贵的注意力机制和图神经网络架构，难以在资源受限的边缘设备上实时部署。作者希望探索一种更轻量级的替代方案，在不牺牲检测精度的前提下显著降低计算复杂度和模型规模。

Method: OrEdge采用正交域时间表示来联合分析日志、指标和轨迹等多模态监控数据。核心组件OrEdgeCore是一个轻量级正交域重建模块，通过捕获重复出现的时间模式并抑制瞬时变化来实现异常检测。整体框架旨在提取时间依赖关系并减少观测信号间的冗余。

Result: 在MSDS、SN和TT三个真实微服务数据集上，OrEdge取得了与现有方法相当的检测性能，同时将重建模型规模从现有方法的20K-143K参数缩减至最多9.6K参数。在树莓派平台上，推理延迟降低了一个数量级以上，实现亚秒级推理。广泛的消融实验、敏感性分析、正交基评估和定性案例研究验证了各设计组件的有效性。

Conclusion: 正交域时间建模为计算密集的注意力/图架构提供了一种有效替代方案，在检测准确性与计算效率之间取得了良好平衡，适用于边缘环境中的实时多模态异常检测。

Abstract: We introduce Orthogonal-Edge (OrEdge), a lightweight framework for real-time anomaly detection in multi-modal distributed software systems. Unlike existing approaches that rely on computationally expensive attention- and graph-based architectures, OrEdge leverages orthogonal-domain temporal representations to achieve accurate anomaly detection with substantially lower computational complexity and model size. It jointly analyzes heterogeneous monitoring data, including logs, metrics, and traces, to identify abnormal software behavior, capture temporal dependencies, and reduce redundancy across observability signals. At its core, OrEdge incorporates OrEdgeCore, a lightweight orthogonal-domain reconstruction module that captures recurring temporal patterns while suppressing transient variations. Evaluated on three real-world microservice datasets (MSDS, SN, and TT), OrEdge achieves competitive detection performance while reducing the reconstruction model size to at most 9.6K parameters, compared with 20K--143K parameters in existing methods. This compact design enables efficient deployment on resource-constrained edge devices: on Raspberry Pi platforms, OrEdge achieves sub-second inference and reduces inference latency by over an order of magnitude compared with existing approaches. Extensive ablation studies, sensitivity analyses, orthogonal basis evaluations, and qualitative case studies further validate the effectiveness of each design component. Overall, OrEdge demonstrates that orthogonal-domain temporal modeling provides an effective alternative to computationally intensive attention- and graph-based architectures, achieving a favorable balance between detection accuracy and computational efficiency for real-time multi-modal anomaly detection in edge environments. The code is available at https://github.com/theamrzaki/MicroService_Twin_Original.

</details>


### [649] [Artificial Intelligence and Modeling & Simulation: An Overview](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00366)
*Niclas Feldkamp,Philippe J. Giabbanelli,Istvan David*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文报告了人工智能与建模与仿真（M&S）之间日益交织的关系，从模型规格、输入建模到执行、实验、验证与确认以及输出分析等M&S各阶段，系统性地梳理了AI与仿真的双向交叉：AI支持/增强/替代仿真组件，而仿真为AI提供数据生成、训练环境和评估平台，并提供了概念路线图以帮助读者导航这一快速变化的生态系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI与M&S两个领域的研究需求日益趋同，生成式AI等技术的快速进步以及数据和计算资源的增长，使得两者之间的交叉变得愈发重要，但缺乏一个结构化、系统性的综述来组织这一不断演进的景观。

Method: 按M&S流程的各阶段（模型规格、输入建模、执行、实验、验证与确认、输出分析）对该交叉领域进行结构化梳理，并在每个阶段选取代表性研究进行说明，同时提供概念路线图。

Result: 展示了如大型语言模型等技术在各M&S阶段如何重塑仿真实践，指出了现有方法的局限性和开放挑战，并提供了帮助读者导航该快速变化生态系统的概念路线图。

Conclusion: AI与M&S的交叉是双向且全面的，需要通过结构化框架来理解和导航这一迅速演进的研究生态系统，同时仍需解决各阶段中存在的局限与开放挑战。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) and Modeling & Simulation (M&S) are increasingly intertwined, reflecting converging research needs across both communities, rapid technological advances such as the rise of generative AI, and the growing availability of data and computational resources. This report provides a structured overview of the intersections of AI and M&S. The relationship goes both ways: AI can support, augment, or even replace components of simulation studies, while simulations can serve as data generators, training environments, and evaluation platforms for AI. We organize this landscape along the stages of M&S from model specification and input modeling to execution, experimentation, verification and validation, and output analysis. Selected studies at each stage illustrates how techniques such as Large Language Models have reshaped simulation practices, while highlighting limitations and open challenges. This report also provides a conceptual roadmap that helps readers navigate a rapidly changing ecosystem.

</details>


### [650] [CASPER-Change-Aware Slice Prioritization for Efficient Regression Testing of LLM-based systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00378)
*Biruk Asmare Muse,Lionel Briand,Yiwei Lu,Keheliya Gallaba*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出CASPER，一个针对LLM系统回归测试的变化感知切片优先级排序框架。CASPER通过进化式切片识别方法找出语义相关且性能特征一致的回归切片，并根据执行日志中的行为信息对切片进行优先级排序，在软件问题解决领域验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM系统的回归测试面临独特挑战：单个测试实例的失败信息有限，无法充分判断是否构成系统性回归或定位受影响行为；而仅基于整体系统性能变化的检测又过于粗粒度，无法识别具体受影响的behavior。因此需要在中间层面（测试套件切片）分析回归实例。

Method: CASPER框架包含两个核心步骤：(1) 使用进化式切片识别方法，将语义相关且性能特征一致的实例聚类为回归切片；(2) 针对LLM应用的变更，利用从执行日志中提取的行为信息，按回归可能性对切片进行优先级排序。框架支持prompt级别和model级别的变更测试。

Result: 在软件问题解决领域，CASPER生成的切片比基于聚类的基线方法更一致，同时保持相当或更好的语义连贯性；在不同LLM系统变更和测试预算下，CASPER在回归切片优先级排序方面优于随机排名基线。

Conclusion: CASPER通过中间粒度的切片分析有效弥补了单实例和整体性能两级分析之间的鸿沟，为LLM系统回归测试提供了更高效、更精准的解决方案。

Abstract: Regression testing for LLM-based systems poses unique challenges because individual regression instances provide limited information about system-level regressions. A failure in a single instance does not necessarily indicate a meaningful regression or provide sufficient information to diagnose affected behaviors. Conversely, detecting regressions based only on overall system performance changes is too coarse-grained, as it does not identify which behaviors are affected. This motivates analyzing regression instances at an intermediate level through test suite slices.
  To address this challenge, we propose CASPER, a change-aware slice prioritization framework for efficient regression testing of prompt-level and model-level changes in LLM-based systems. CASPER first identifies regression slices containing semantically related instances with consistent performance characteristics using an evolutionary slice identification approach. Given a change to an LLM-based application, CASPER prioritizes slices according to their likelihood of regression using behavioral information extracted from execution logs. We instantiate CASPER in the software issue resolution domain and evaluate slice identification against clustering-based baselines and regressed slice prioritization against a random ranking baseline. Results show that CASPER generates more consistent slices while maintaining comparable or better semantic coherence and improves regressed slice prioritization across different LLM-based system changes and testing budgets.

</details>


### [651] [Distilling Reasoning Traces into Advisory Prompts for Software Engineering Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00437)
*Faizan Faisal,Prem Devanbu,Toufique Ahmed*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需额外训练的推理时错误减少方法：先识别低资源LLM在"思考模式"下能避免的编码错误，再用大LLM分析这些错误与规避过程生成总结性解释，最后将其提炼为简短建议提示词（advisory prompts），可应用于模型本身或迁移到其他模型，从而在不总是付出推理成本的情况下提升代码处理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在代码生成和处理中可能犯错，且训练数据（人类编写的代码）本身含缺陷，难以获得完全无bug的大规模语料。虽然"推理/思考"模式可以减少错误，但消耗额外资源。作者希望借鉴人类编程学习中的苏格拉底式教学方法（识别错误→反思认知失误→提炼通用规则→内化为规则），在不总是付出推理成本的前提下获得更好性能。

Method: 三步流水线方法：(1) 识别低资源LLM中"思考模式"避免错误的实例；(2) 由更大的LLM检查这些错误及其被思考模式规避的过程，生成总结性解释；(3) 由大LLM将这些解释进一步浓缩为简短的建议提示词（advisory prompts）。这些提示词可作用于原模型或迁移到其他模型。

Result: 该方法在多个中等规模模型上有效；在某些情况下，学习到的建议提示词可以成功迁移到其他模型。论文还提供了对LLM编码错误本质的调查研究，以及对该方法何时适用的特征描述。

Conclusion: 通过"错误识别→反思→规则提炼→内化"的教学式流程，可以蒸馏出小型建议提示词，在不总是启用昂贵的推理模式下减少LLM编码错误，并且具备跨模型迁移的潜力。

Abstract: Language models are widely used for generating and otherwise processing code (e.g., identifying code hallucinations, possible inputs, or predicting outputs); however, LLMs can make mistakes, which can be serious. One key issue is that models are trained on (still) largely human-written, and thus imperfect, code; it's not easy to find sufficiently large code corpora that are entirely free of bugs. Thus, other inference-time ways of reducing LLM errors, without additional training, are desirable. "Reasoning" or "thinking" modes, exposed as a togglable feature by hybrid reasoning models, do reduce errors; however, reasoning consumes additional resources. This paper asks if better performance can be achieved without always incurring the cost of reasoning. Human students of programming learn to avoid mistakes by (a) identifying them, (b) reflecting upon the cognitive lapses that led to them (essentially, "thinking through" the errors), (c) inferring general rules or lessons from these reflections, and (d) internalizing these lessons into rules. In tutorial sessions with an instructor, this is a common Socratic interaction. Examples of such internalizable rules might include the nugget "Before coding, restate the requirements to clarify them." Inspired by this process, this paper describes an approach where we first identify examples in which "thinking mode" in a (low-resource) LLM avoids errors. These errors, and their avoidance via "thinking" in the same LLM, are then examined by a bigger LLM to generate summary explanations; these are then summarized by a large LLM into brief advisory prompts. This approach works on many modest-sized models; in some cases, the "advisory prompts" thus learned can also be gainfully transferred to other models. We also present investigations into the nature of coding errors that language models make, and a characterization of when this approach can be helpful.

</details>


### [652] [AiFlow: Token-Native Reactive Orchestration with Bounded Backpressure for Streaming LLM Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00558)
*Qunhui Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出AiFlow，一个基于token级流式响应式编排模型，将provider增量标准化为类型化Context<T>事件，通过有向流图传播，并由Node Guardian管理队列边界、并发、排序、溢出策略、取消传播和重试纪律，在保持provider端TTFT不变的情况下将应用端TTFPT降低70.9-94.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM应用日益成为流式工作流，结合检索、工具调用、安全过滤和多智能体协调，但现有框架将生成视为粗粒度的请求-响应步骤，队列管理、worker分配、排序和背压依赖于临时回调代码，缺乏系统化的流式编排机制。

Method: AiFlow提出token原生的响应式编排模型：(1) 将provider增量标准化为类型化Context<T>事件，通过有向流图传播；(2) 每个节点由Node Guardian管理，声明并强制执行本地队列边界、worker并发、排序、溢出策略、取消传播和重试纪律；(3) 形式化有界内存属性；(4) 提供紧凑DSL和JSON图形式的编译；(5) 进行类型安全、状态并发和注入兼容性的静态验证。

Result: 控制微基准测试、DeepSeek trace回放（30次运行）、在线运行、LangGraph基线对比、流式RAG工作负载和Ollama本地后端检查表明：AiFlow不改动provider端Model TTFT，但将Application TTFPT降低70.9-94.7%（相比聚合方式），并将运行时队列深度维持在声明边界内（相比无界策略MaxQ降低93.7-96.5%）。

Conclusion: AiFlow通过token原生流式编排和图节点级资源治理，实现了对LLM流式工作流的高效有序管理，同时附带完整的可复现工件和公开实现。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) applications increasingly operate as streaming workflows combining retrieval, tool calls, safety filters, and multi-agent coordination. Although contemporary frameworks expose provider deltas, workflow nodes often treat generation as coarse request-response steps, leaving queue management, worker allocation, ordering, and backpressure to ad hoc callback code. This paper presents AiFlow, a token-native reactive orchestration model that normalizes provider deltas into typed Context<T> events propagated through a directed streaming graph. Each node is managed by a Node Guardian that declares and enforces local queue bounds, worker concurrency, ordering, overflow policy, cancellation propagation, and retry discipline. We formalize the bounded-memory property, present the compilation from a compact DSL and JSON graph form, and provide static validation for type safety, state concurrency, and injection compatibility. Controlled microbenchmarks, captured DeepSeek trace replay (30 runs), descriptive online runs, LangGraph baselines, a streaming RAG workload, and an Ollama local-backend check show that AiFlow does not alter provider-side Model TTFT but reduces Application TTFPT by 70.9-94.7\% versus aggregation and keeps runtime-owned queue depth within declared bounds (93.7-96.5\% MaxQ reduction versus unbounded policies). The supplementary artifact contains scripts, raw traces, machine-readable tables, checksums, and an API-free smoke test; the public implementation is available through the FIT Framework repository.

</details>


### [653] [Can Perplexity Serve as a Cognitive Signal for Code Understandability?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00624)
*Xiaokai Rong,Mohammadali Sefidi Esfahani,Aashish Yadavally,Rigby Peter,Tien N. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过多个基于人类标注的数据集进行实证研究，发现简单的token困惑度聚合方法（如平均、中位数、峰值）并不能可靠地关联片段级代码可理解性，并深入分析了导致这一现象的三个原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究表明token级困惑度能对齐人类在代码理解过程中的局部困惑，但能否将这一信号提升到片段级代码可理解性层面尚不清楚。作者希望验证困惑度能否作为片段级信号用于衡量代码可理解性。

Method: 作者在多个人类标注数据集上（包括方法级可理解性判断、输出预测任务、可理解性改进补丁）进行了实证研究，测试简单困惑度聚合方法（平均、中位数、峰值）与人类可理解性的相关性，并从统计分析角度探究为何token级信号无法迁移到片段级。

Result: 研究发现简单的困惑度聚合方法无法可靠地与人类可理解性关联。原因有三：（1）token困惑度高度偏斜且重尾分布，极端值不仅来自语义结构，还来自标识符、字面量、类型、分隔符等tokenization伪影；（2）人类可理解性标注缺乏一致性，使片段级难度成为噪声目标；（3）困惑度分布及其与人类难度的对齐在不同模型和tokenizer间差异显著。

Conclusion: 困惑度是有前景但需要谨慎处理的认知信号：适合局部代码困惑检测，但要用于可靠的代码可理解性测量，需要代码感知的聚合方法、考虑标注者共识的评估方式以及模型敏感性分析。

Abstract: Recent work suggests that token-level perplexity from large language models can align with localized human confusion during code comprehension. This raises a natural question: can perplexity also serve as a snippet-level signal for code understandability? We conduct an empirical study of this question across multiple human-grounded datasets, including method-level understandability judgments, output-prediction tasks, and accepted understandability-improvement patches. Despite prior token-level evidence, we find that simple snippet-level aggregations of token perplexity, such as average, median, or peak perplexity, do not reliably correlate with human understandability. We then investigate why this happens. First, token perplexity is highly skewed and heavy-tailed across code structures; extreme spikes arise not only from semantically meaningful constructs, but also from identifiers, literals, types, separators, and tokenization artifacts. Second, human understandability labels often lack consensus, making whole-snippet difficulty a noisy target. Third, perplexity distributions and their alignment with human difficulty vary substantially across models and tokenizers. These findings explain why prior token-level perplexity--confusion alignment does not directly transfer to snippet-level understandability. Overall, our study positions perplexity as a promising but delicate cognitive signal: useful for localized code confusion, but requiring code-aware aggregation, consensus-aware evaluation, and model-sensitivity analysis before it can support reliable code-understandability measurement.

</details>


### [654] [Understanding Online Failure Prediction in Linux Through Complementary Multi-View Explainability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00651)
*Diogo Dória,João R. Campos*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文报告了在Linux操作系统中构建可解释在线故障预测(OFP)管道的实践经验。该管道结合共识特征选择、时间起点分析、子系统级因果分析和补充诊断机制，在跨工作负载严格评估下实现91-94%的检测率和低于1%的误报率，但诊断性能对工作负载变化更为敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线故障预测虽然已证明在OS环境中可行，但仅预测不足以实际采用——缺乏诊断洞察使运维人员难以信任告警或决定响应方式。此外，即使预测准确率高，也不清楚模型是捕捉了有意义的故障过程，还是仅利用了特定工作负载的噪声和偶然相关性。

Method: 构建可解释OFP管道，包括：(1)基于共识的特征选择用于检测；(2)时间起点分析(temporal onset analysis)；(3)子系统级因果分析；(4)互补诊断机制支持故障解释。在严格跨工作负载条件下使用冻结的训练工件进行评估，包括Leave-One-Mode-Out(LOMO)评估。

Result: 检测方面：在未见工作负载上无需重训练即达到91-94%的检测率，误报率低于1%。但故障模式诊断对工作负载变化显著更敏感，部分诊断机制对特定故障类型效果有限。提前预警能力因故障模式而异(38-215秒)。LOMO评估下对未见故障模式的诊断准确率为0%。

Conclusion: 三大经验教训：(i)检测的泛化性比诊断更鲁棒于工作负载变化；(ii)早期预警能力强烈依赖故障模式；(iii)未见故障模式无法仅从相关训练模式可靠诊断。总体表明互补可解释性机制对解读准确预测的价值，揭示了预测信号何时反映可迁移的故障结构，以及诊断泛化何时在工作负载变化下失效。

Abstract: Accurate Online Failure Prediction (OFP) has been shown to be feasible in Operating Systems (OSs) settings, but prediction alone is not sufficient for practical adoption. Without diagnostic insight, operators have limited basis to trust alerts or decide how to respond. Moreover, even when predictive accuracy is high, it is often unclear whether models are capturing meaningful failure processes or merely exploiting workload-specific noise and incidental correlations in telemetry. This paper reports a practical experience building and evaluating an explainable OFP pipeline for Linux OSs. We combine consensus-based feature selection for detection with temporal onset analysis, subsystemlevel causal analysis, and complementary diagnostic mechanisms to support failure interpretation. Evaluated under strict crossworkload conditions with frozen training artifacts, it achieved 91-94% detection on unseen workloads without retraining, while maintaining false alarm rates below 1%. However, failure mode diagnosis proved substantially more sensitive to workload shift, and several diagnostics mechanisms showed limited effectiveness for specific failure types. Our experience highlights three main lessons: i) detection generalizes more robustly than diagnosis across workload changes; ii) early-warning capability depends strongly on the failure mode, ranging from 38 to 215 seconds in our study; and iii) unseen failure modes are not reliably diagnosable from related training modes alone, providing 0% accuracy under Leave-One-Mode-Out (LOMO) evaluation. Taken together, these results show the value of complementary explainability mechanisms for interpreting accurate failure predictions, revealing when predictive signals reflect transferable failure structure and when diagnostic generalization breaks down under workload variation.

</details>


### [655] [Unreliable in Practice? A Comprehensive Study of Errors in LLM-Generated Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00661)
*Rodrigo Pato Nogueira,Marco Vieira,João R. Campos*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文分析了由7个LLM在4种编译语言中生成的86,726个含编译或运行时错误的代码样本，使用LLM进行错误分类并人工验证，系统性地揭示了LLM生成代码中的常见错误模式及其随模型、语言和问题难度的分布规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被广泛用于编码且生成越来越多的生产代码，但它们仍难以应对复杂编程任务。理解LLM生成代码中的错误模式对设定合理预期和设计缓解策略至关重要。然而以往研究范围有限（单一语言、少量问题或有限模型），缺乏对不同模型和语言间错误共性和差异性的全面理解。

Method: 研究者收集了7个LLM在4种编译语言上生成的86,726个包含编译或运行时错误的代码样本；使用LLM对错误按其根本原因进行分类，并通过人工验证确保分类准确性；随后按模型、语言和问题难度对错误发生率进行测量，识别常见错误模式，并开展比较分析。

Result: 错误类型在不同语言和模型间存在显著差异；即使是最大的模型也频繁犯简单的错误；生成代码常缺少基本的输入验证或内存安全检查，可能导致溢出、资源耗尽或其他可靠性/安全性问题。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了LLM生成代码错误模式的全面画像，揭示了错误在不同语言和模型间的分布特征，指出即使最先进的LLM也存在基础性错误和安全隐患，为改进LLM代码生成质量和设计针对性缓解策略提供了数据支撑。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are being widely used for coding, with reports indicating that AI now generates an increasing share of production code. Studies show that LLMs can significantly improve developer productivity, yet they still struggle with more complex coding tasks. Just as understanding error modes in human-written code has been central to improving software quality, identifying and characterizing the errors in LLM-generated code is critical for setting realistic expectations and designing mitigation strategies. Prior research has been limited in scope, often focusing on a single language, a small number of problems, or a limited selection of models. As a result, there is still no comprehensive understanding of which errors are common and which are specific to certain models or languages. To address these gaps and develop a deeper understanding of the quality of LLM-generated code, we analyzed a corpus of 86,726 code samples that contained compilation or runtime errors. These samples were generated by seven LLMs across four compiled languages. We classified errors by their underlying causes using an LLM, manually validated these classifications, and performed a comparative analysis. This labeled data is then used to measure error prevalence by model, language, and problem difficulty, to identify common error patterns. Results show that, although error types vary strongly across languages and models, even the largest models frequently make simple mistakes. We also observe that generated code often omits basic input validation or memory-safety checks, which can lead to overflows, resource exhaustion, or other reliability/security issues.

</details>


### [656] [Vul4Py: Benchmarking Automated Vulnerability Repair in Python with Paired Exploit and Functional Oracles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00692)
*Tan Bui,Ting Zhang,Ferdian Thung,Yunpeng Xiong,Penghao Jiang,Xin Zhou,David Lo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出Vul4Py，一个Python自动化漏洞修复（AVR）基准测试集，包含100个来自60个开源项目的真实漏洞，每个漏洞都配有双Oracle（利用Oracle和功能性pytest Oracle）。通过该基准比较了六种AVR方法，发现软件工程代理表现最佳（OpenHands修复41个漏洞），远超直接提示的LLM（4个）和专用工具（2个）。配对Oracle能够拒绝119个仅通过利用Oracle验证的补丁中的15个，确保修复不会破坏功能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Python漏洞修复基准存在严重缺陷：要么仅以概念验证漏洞利用作为补丁通过标准（会导致功能回归），要么仅在部分上游项目提供测试的子集上应用功能测试。因此缺乏一个可信的、可验证的、同一平台上的AVR方法比较基准，无法评估修复是否在消除漏洞的同时保留了原有功能。

Method: 构建Vul4Py基准：收集100个真实漏洞（来自60个开源项目、覆盖60个CWE、跨2017-2025年），每个条目配备配对Oracle——利用Oracle（必须在漏洞版本失败、修复版本通过）和项目原生的pytest功能Oracle（两个版本都必须通过）。然后使用该基准比较三类六种方法：专用漏洞修复工具、直接提示的LLM、软件工程代理（三者共享相同的骨干模型）。

Result: 软件工程代理表现最佳：OpenHands修复41/100个漏洞，远超最强的直接提示LLM（4个）和专用工具（2个）。配对Oracle拒绝了119个仅通过利用Oracle的补丁中的15个（占12.6%），表明仅依赖利用Oracle会高估修复成功率。被接受的104个补丁中有98个经人工确认为与开发者补丁语义等价。

Conclusion: Vul4Py提供了一个可靠、可复现的Python AVR评估基准，揭示了修复质量验证的重要性——功能回归检测不可或缺。研究结果表明，软件工程代理在自动化漏洞修复上显著优于直接提示LLM和专用工具，而配对Oracle机制是确保修复可信度的关键。

Abstract: Automated Vulnerability Repair (AVR) has advanced rapidly across program analysis, machine learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs), but a verifiable, head-to-head comparison of AVR approaches on Python is still missing. Python underpins critical web, data, and machine-learning infrastructure, yet existing Python benchmarks accept a patch on the strength of a proof-of-concept exploit alone, or apply a functional test only on the subset of entries whose upstream project happens to ship one. Both therefore miss functional regressions, in which a patch defeats the exploit but breaks unrelated behavior. We present Vul4Py, a Python AVR benchmark in which every entry carries a paired oracle: an exploit oracle that must fail on the vulnerable revision and pass on the fixed one, together with a project-native pytest functional oracle that must pass on both. Vul4Py comprises 100 real vulnerabilities from 60 open-source projects, spanning 60 distinct CWEs and the years 2017 to 2025, each packaged with a pinned, reproducible per-instance environment. Using Vul4Py, we compare six approaches in three categories: a specialized vulnerability repair tool, directly prompted LLMs, and software engineering agents. The agents dominate: OpenHands repairs 41 of 100 vulnerabilities, against 4 for the strongest directly prompted LLM and 2 for the specialized tool, despite all three sharing the same backbone model. The paired oracle is what makes these counts trustworthy: it rejects 15 of the 119 patches that an exploit-only oracle would accept, and 98 of the 104 patches it admits are manually confirmed to be semantically equivalent to the developer's patches

</details>


### [657] [EduPluginBench: Executable Assurance for AI-Generated Educational Plugins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00739)
*Nizam Kadir*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出EduPluginBench，一个用于受治理软件生态系统中生成插件的可执行基准和分阶段准入方法。通过1,440个激活检查的一阶突变体实验，P0-P4相比P0-P2将发布阻断缺陷召回率提升了74.7个百分点，且120个干净引用中零误拒绝。然而迁移研究表明，600个由当前编码模型生成的样本中无一通过P0或P0-P4一致性检查，下游保证估计无法定义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码生成模型能产生可执行组件，但编译和功能测试无法验证最小权限、遥测同意、来源、特权写权限、生命周期约束或有界失败等治理合规要求。现有评估方法缺乏对这些治理属性的系统性验证。

Method: 构建EduPluginBench可执行基准，提出P0至P4的分阶段准入方法，对生成插件进行多维度治理属性检查。通过1,440个激活检查的一阶突变体（来自30个规格）评估方法有效性，并进行600个未修改生成的冻结迁移研究和1,440个诊断实验验证。

Result: P0-P4比P0-P2在发布阻断缺陷召回率上提升74.7个百分点（95% CI 73.4-75.8），120个干净引用零误拒绝（95% Wilson上限3.1%）。但600个迁移生成中300个成功解析，无一通过P0或P0-P4一致性检查（95%上限0.64%）；后验有界修复实验中112个P0通过但全部不符合规范。

Conclusion: 分阶段准入方法在受控基准上表现优异，但迁移实验揭示了严重的外部效度限制：当前编码模型生成的插件无法通过治理合规检查，且后验修复不能实现真正的规范一致性。这些负迁移结果意味着不能将受控合同一致性解读为独立真实缺陷有效性；需要重新审视生成模型的治理合规能力及评估方法论。

Abstract: Code-generation models can produce executable components, but compilation and functional tests do not establish compliance with least privilege, telemetry consent, provenance, privileged-write authority, lifecycle constraints, or bounded failure. We introduce EduPluginBench, an executable benchmark and staged admission method for generated plugins in governed software ecosystems. Across 1,440 activation-checked first-order mutants from 30 specifications, P0-P4 increased release-blocking-defect recall by 74.7 percentage points (specification-clustered 95% CI 73.4-75.8) over P0-P2, with no observed rejection among 120 clean references (95% Wilson upper bound 3.1%). A frozen transfer study of 600 unmodified generations from two current coding models found that 300/600 parsed, but none passed P0 or achieved P0-P4 conformance (95% upper bound 0.64%); downstream assurance estimands were undefined. An independently labelled Moodle study retained 16 vulnerable/fixed pairs; the frozen generic PHP detector found no vulnerable revisions. These negative transfer results prevent controlled contract consistency from being read as independent real-defect effectiveness. An earlier 540-generation diagnostic found that post-hoc bounded repair yielded 112 P0 passes, all nonconforming, with recall increasing from 13.4% to 100%. The artifact retains protocols, public-source provenance, raw generations, row-level decisions, audits, analysis code, and reproduction instructions.

</details>


### [658] [Less Is More: Tuning Configurable Systems with Imperfect Fidelity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00759)
*Yulong Ye,Miqing Li,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出MFTune，一种利用"不完美保真度"（相似但更便宜的测量环境）来优化高度可配置系统性能调优的方法。通过主动探索超过10^4种可能的保真度设置，MFTune能够在预算有限的情况下实现更优的调优效果，在83.33%的案例中优于10种最先进的调优器，性能提升最高达19.34%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 配置调优对于高度可配置系统的性能优化至关重要，但面临两大挑战：可调选项众多、配置测量成本高昂。现有方法在预算受限时效果不佳，作者希望探索是否能在"较低保真度"（相似但更便宜的测量环境）下进行部分调优，从而实现更优的预算利用。

Method: 作者首先构建了一个针对可配置系统的"保真度"概念框架，基于此提出MFTune调优器。MFTune主动在超过10^4种可能的"不完美保真度"设置空间中探索，找到近似有用的保真度设置以拓宽调优范围，产生高质量种子，进而在完美保真度下保证调优的深度。

Result: 在10个真实世界系统上运行19个月（24×7）的实验中，MFTune与10种最先进调优器对比，在83.33%的案例中表现更优，性能提升最高达19.34%，并且通常能节省数小时的预算。

Conclusion: 研究验证了"少即是多"的现象：在不完美保真度环境下进行部分调优，可以显著改善系统配置调优效果和预算利用效率。MFTune通过平衡调优的"广度"（探索多种保真度设置）与"深度"（完美保真度下的精细调优），为配置调优提供了一种新的有效范式。

Abstract: Configuration tuning is essential for optimizing the performance of highly configurable systems, e.g., throughput or runtime, under a given environment. Yet, this is a challenging process as there can be many options to tune, and configuration measurement is often highly expensive. In this paper, we demonstrate the phenomenon of ``less can be more'': system configuration tuning can be greatly improved with much superior budget utilization by partially tuning under the imperfect-fidelity---an environment that is similar, but cheaper to measure, compared with the concerned perfect-fidelity of environment under which the system should be tuned. We codify a conceptual framework of fidelity for configurable systems, drawing on which allows us to propose MFTune, a tuner that proactively explores in the space of $>10^4$ possible imperfect-fidelity settings to approximate a useful one, which strikes for the wideness of tuning. This creates high-quality seeds for the perfect-fidelity, which in turn ensures the tuning depth. Experiment results against $10$ state-of-the-art tuners, obtained from running diverse real-world systems for $19$ months $24 \times 7$, show that MFTune performs considerably better on $83.33$\% cases with up to $19.34\%$ improvement while achieving hours of budget saving in general.

</details>


### [659] [Turning Interaction History into Execution State: A Runtime Layer for Long-Horizon Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00808)
*Zehao Wang,Yisen Xu,Chenglin Li,Chao Peng,Bram Adams,Ahmed E. Hassan,Tse-Hsun,Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Ledger是一个确定性的运行时层，通过维护显式的执行状态账本（记录已观察、已修改、已尝试的操作），帮助长时程编码智能体避免基于过时信息行动或重复执行无效工作。无需额外LLM调用即可集成到未修改的智能体中，在SWE-bench Verified上将GPT-5 mini的Pass@1从56.2%提升至64.2%，并将成本降低28.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程编码智能体在数千步轨迹中积累了大量行动和观察，但历史记录中没有任何信息能直接表明当前仓库的实际状态。模型每次决策前都需要从原始历史中隐式推断执行状态，当推断失败时，智能体会基于过期的文件内容行动，或重复执行结果仍然有效的操作，导致效率和准确率下降。

Method: Ledger提出一个确定性的运行时层，包含两部分：1) inform路径：在模型行动前将紧凑的运行时状态视图附加到提示中；2) govern路径：在命令执行前检查其与账本的一致性，返回仍有效的旧结果而非重新执行，并标记可能冗余的重复操作。该层不引入任何语言模型调用，直接包裹未修改的原有智能体。

Result: 在全部500个SWE-bench Verified实例上，Ledger将GPT-5 mini的Pass@1从56.2%提升至64.2%，将MiniMax M2.5从75.8%提升至81.0%，同时降低总成本28.9%和31.8%。在OpenAI Codex上增加3.4个百分点的Pass@1并降低24.4%成本。消融实验表明，govern主要贡献了解决率提升，inform主要贡献了效率提升，两者结合效果最佳。

Conclusion: 长时程智能体真正缺失的不是更短的历史视角，而是对自身执行状态的显式记录。通过确定性运行时层提供显式的执行状态账本，可以在不增加计算成本的情况下同时提升准确率和效率。

Abstract: Long-horizon coding agents accumulate hundreds of actions and observations in their trajectories, yet nothing in this record indicates which observations still describe the repository as it currently stands. Before every decision, the model must implicitly infer the execution status from raw history, and when this inference falls short, the agent acts on outdated file contents or re-executes work whose results are still valid. We propose Ledger, a deterministic runtime layer that distills an agent's completed interactions into an explicit execution state: what has been observed, what has been modified, and what has been attempted. Ledger keeps this state in an online execution ledger and applies it at two boundaries of every step. Before the model acts, an inform path appends a compact runtime state view to the prompt; before a proposed command runs, a govern path checks it against the ledger, returning still-valid earlier results in place of re-execution and flagging likely-redundant repetition. The layer adds no language-model calls and wraps an otherwise unmodified agent. Across all 500 SWE-bench Verified instances, Ledger raises Pass@1 from 56.2% to 64.2% with GPT-5 mini and from 75.8% to 81.0% with MiniMax M2.5, while cutting total cost by 28.9% and 31.8%. Attached to OpenAI Codex, it adds 3.4 percentage points of Pass@1 at 24.4% lower cost. Ablations attribute most of the resolution gain to govern and most of the efficiency gain to inform, with their combination performing best. What long-horizon agents lack, we conclude, is not a shorter view of their history but an explicit account of their own execution state.

</details>


### [660] [Structure-Aware Semantic Chunking with Title-Chain Prefixes: A 1600-Query Evaluation and the Measurement Trap in Text-Transform Ablations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00824)
*Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个仅作用于分块侧的三阶段语义分块流水线（标题分割、语义合并、标题链前缀），利用文档自身的标题层级而非生成摘要，实现了零额外LLM调用的分块。在1600个查询的生产级Markdown知识库评估中，MRR@5从0.374提升至0.463（+23.8%），可回答子集从0.828提升至0.925（+11.7%）。更重要的是，论文揭示了分块研究中常见的评估陷阱：在相同提示下进行前缀开启/关闭消融实验时，双标注者Cohen's kappa从0.45骤降至0.04，说明剥离标题链上下文会破坏标注者所需的消歧信号，这使常见的评估实践失效，并推动作者推荐检索时逐候选前缀评估的方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分块是RAG中首要且影响最深远的步骤，所有下游检索决策都继承分块边界。然而现有语义分块方法通常依赖生成摘要（消耗额外LLM调用），且缺乏对评估协议可靠性的审视。作者旨在提出一种零额外LLM调用的分块方法，并揭示分块研究中普遍存在的评估方法论缺陷。

Method: 提出三阶段、仅分块侧的语义分块流水线：(1) header-split——基于文档自身的标题层级进行分割；(2) semantic merge——语义合并相邻块；(3) title-chain prefixing——将文档自身的标题链作为前缀注入分块，复用文档标题层级而非生成摘要，因此零额外LLM调用。同时进行系统性的失败实验报告，包括三个设计死胡同、一个度量失败和协议级失败。

Result: 在主评估中，流水线将MRR@5从0.374提升至0.463（全量集+23.8%），可回答子集从0.828提升至0.925（+11.7%），双标注者Cohen's kappa为0.45（未加权，16,000个评分对）。在相同池前缀开/关消融实验中，kappa从0.45骤降至0.04，表明标注一致性崩塌，揭示了一个评估陷阱。

Conclusion: 标题链上下文是标注者判断相关性的关键消歧信号，剥离它会破坏评估可靠性。常见的"同样本池消融"评估实践在分块研究中无效。作者推荐改用检索时逐候选前缀评估，并指出这是从全部证据中得出的方向。论文的中央方法论发现是：评估协议本身可能失效，分块研究的评估需要重新设计。

Abstract: Chunking is the first and most consequential step in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): every downstream retrieval decision inherits the chunk boundaries. We present a three-stage, chunk-side-only semantic chunking pipeline---header-split, semantic merge, and title-chain prefixing---that costs zero additional LLM calls: the title chain reuses the document's own header hierarchy instead of a generated summary. On a 1600-query stratified evaluation over a production Markdown knowledge base, the pipeline improves MRR@5 from 0.374 to 0.463 (+23.8%) on the full set and from 0.828 to 0.925 (+11.7%) on the answerable subset (n=563), with dual-annotator Cohen's kappa 0.45 (unweighted, 16,000 score pairs). We then report what we tried and what failed: three query-side or architecture-level follow-ups are design dead ends (unevaluated---no comparable run artifacts), one measured failure (prefix weight decay), and one protocol-level failure that is the paper's central methodological finding. In a same-pool prefix on/off ablation, dual-annotator agreement collapsed from kappa 0.45 to 0.04 under identical prompts---stripping the title-chain context strips the disambiguation signal annotators need to agree on relevance. This measurement trap invalidates a common evaluation practice in chunking research and motivates retrieval-time per-candidate prefix evaluation, the direction we recommend from all our evidence.

</details>


### [661] [Documentation vs. Code Patterns: What Drives LLM-Based Exception Oracle Generation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00884)
*Soneya Binta Hossain,Matthew B. Dwyer,Tasfia Tasnim*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模干预实验研究LLM生成测试预言（特别是异常预言）时依赖的证据，发现Javadoc @throws子句并非主要驱动因素，模型实际依赖的是快捷信号（如少量结构token或大量词汇线索），而非真正的异常语义理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM测试预言生成方法在异常预言生成上报告高准确率，但缺乏对其预测依据的深入理解——模型是靠显式异常文档（如@throws）还是依赖测试、代码和文档中的重复模式？这种黑盒式的高准确率可能掩盖了模型对异常语义的真实理解程度。

Method: 对三个TOG系统（涵盖分类器和生成架构，模型规模110M至7B参数）在三个真实基准上（两个生成测试数据集和一个新构建的开发者编写测试基准）进行干预式研究。首先删除Javadoc @throws子句观察准确率变化，然后采用归因引导的替换消融（attribution-guided substitution ablations）识别预测所依赖的信号。

Result: 删除@throws子句后准确率变化很小，最大降幅不足1个百分点，表明结构化异常文档并非预测的主要驱动。归因消融显示高准确率可由捷径信号驱动：部分模型对少量结构token高度敏感，而其他模型则依赖分布广泛的词汇线索。

Conclusion: 研究挑战了"高异常预言准确率反映对异常语义的鲁棒使用"这一假设。未来TOG系统的评估不应仅看预测的正确预言类型，还应检查预测是否基于有意义的异常触发证据。

Abstract: LLM-based test oracle generation (TOG) methods report high accuracy on exception oracle generation, but it remains unclear what evidence drives these predictions. In particular, do models use explicit exceptional-behavior documentation such as Javadoc @throws clauses, or do they rely on recurring patterns in tests, code, and documentation?
  We investigate this question through a large-scale intervention-based study of three TOG systems spanning classifier-based and generative architectures and model sizes from roughly 110M to 7B parameters, evaluated on three real-world benchmarks comprising two generated-test datasets and a new benchmark of developer-written tests. We first remove Javadoc @throws clauses and find that accuracy changes only marginally, with the largest drop below one percentage point. This indicates that structured exception documentation is not the primary driver of exception-oracle prediction. We then apply attribution-guided substitution ablations to identify the signals that predictions depend on. The results show that high accuracy can be driven by shortcut signals: some models are highly sensitive to a small number of structural tokens, while others distribute reliance across many lexical cues. These findings challenge the assumption that strong exception-oracle accuracy reflects robust use of exception semantics. Future TOG systems should therefore be evaluated not only by whether they predict the correct oracle type, but also by whether their predictions are grounded in meaningful exception-triggering evidence.

</details>


### [662] [Joint Optimization of Human Headcount and Stochastic AI Resource Capacity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00886)
*Marco Montes de Oca*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个在固定预算下同时分配人力与生成式AI token容量的随机优化模型，通过机会约束与Cornish-Fisher偏度修正，推导出闭式最优解，并揭示了token消耗波动性与偏度对人员配置的替代效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI工具虽能提升生产力，但其不可预测且高昂的成本给组织带来财务压力。组织领导者必须在人力与AI token容量之间分配固定预算，但传统确定性规划忽略了token消耗的重尾波动性和审计AI输出的认知成本，因此需要一个新的随机优化框架。

Method: 将认知摩擦调整的生产函数与机会约束随机预算前沿相交以建模联合分配。假设人均token使用量为i.i.d.、非负、右偏，仅用均值、方差和偏度描述，不假设参数族。通过中心极限定理加Cornish-Fisher偏度校正将机会约束化为确定性等价形式，求解拉格朗日问题获得闭式最优解。

Result: 得到闭式最优人员规模、人均token强度的超越方程条件以及bordered-Hessian二阶条件。比较静态分析显示：个体token波动率上升会提高最优人均token强度同时收缩人员规模（预算约束下人力与token在边际上呈替代关系）；个体使用偏度作为纯无谓税缩小预算但不改变替代动态。若离散度随均值成比例扩展，替代关系发生反转。

Conclusion: 该模型为组织在不确定性下的人力-AI资源联合分配提供了可解析的理论框架，并指出波动性与均值之间是固定离散还是成比例的离散关系，将决定人力与token是替代品还是互补品，这构成一个可实证检验的判断。

Abstract: Generative AI tools are rapidly becoming standard for coding and other business operations. However, while these tools can drive productivity, their unpredictable, and often significant, costs are putting severe financial strain on organizations. The leadership of such organizations must split a fixed budget between human headcount and generative-AI token capacity, yet standard deterministic planning ignores both the heavy-tailed volatility of token consumption and the cognitive cost of auditing AI-generated output. We model the joint allocation by intersecting a cognitive-friction-adjusted production function with a chance-constrained stochastic budget frontier. Per-engineer token usage is treated as i.i.d., non-negative, and right-skewed; no parametric family is assumed, as only its mean, variance, and skewness enter the analysis. The chance constraint is reduced to a deterministic equivalent via the Central Limit Theorem with a Cornish--Fisher skewness correction. Solving the resulting Lagrangian yields a closed-form optimal headcount, a transcendental condition for optimal per-capita token intensity, and a bordered-Hessian second-order condition that holds for any reasonable volatility-to-headcount ratio. Comparative statics show that rising individual token volatility raises optimal per-capita token intensity while contracting headcount: although human labor and tokens are complements in production, the stochastic budget makes them substitutes at the margin. Individual usage skewness acts as a pure deadweight tax that shrinks the budget without altering the substitution dynamics. Both conclusions presuppose that usage dispersion is invariant to the planned mean allocation. In the case where dispersion instead scales proportionally with the mean, the substitution reverses, so which regime applies is a sharp, empirically testable question.

</details>


### [663] [RefactorAssist: Agentic Refinement for Reliable Code Refactoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00924)
*Jonathan Cordeiro,Shayan Noei,Ying Zou*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出RefactorAssist智能体，用于修复LLM生成的代码重构中引入的功能错误。通过分析10个Java开源项目中LLM重构失败的根本原因，设计了结合单元测试日志、错误解释、项目上下文检索和代码差异的迭代修复方法，在最佳配置下实现了70.8%的剩余失败修复率和94.2%的累计通过率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的重构常常引入细微错误，导致功能行为改变和单元测试失败，限制了其在实际开发中的采用。目前缺乏对LLM重构失败根本原因的系统分析以及有效的修复方法。

Method: 首先在10个Java开源项目上手动分析LLM重构失败单元测试的根本原因；然后设计RefactorAssist智能体，采用两阶段策略：先用静态修复（无需LLM）处理缺失导入、括号不平衡和编译错误，再对剩余失败利用错误日志、代码差异和项目上下文进行迭代智能体修复。

Result: 识别出8类失败原因（如上下文误解/幻觉24.3%、重命名不一致15.3%等）；RefactorAssist在最佳配置下对剩余失败达到70.8%的修复率，累计通过率达94.2%。

Conclusion: 静态检查和测试引导的上下文感知智能体修复能显著提高LLM生成重构的可靠性，使其更接近实际开发者工作流的集成应用。

Abstract: Code refactoring aims to enhance the internal structure of source code without affecting its functional behavior. The recent advancements of Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential for automating software engineering tasks, such as code refactoring. However, the refactorings produced by LLMs often introduce subtle errors, leading to functional behavior changes and failed unit tests, which limit their practical adoption. To address the limitations of LLM-generated refactorings, we analyze the root causes of their failures and develop the RefactorAssist agent to improve the functional correctness of LLM-generated refactorings. To this end, we use 10 open-source Java projects with their native test suites and manually evaluate why LLM-generated refactorings fail unit tests. We then design an agentic approach that leverages unit-test logs, error explanations, project context retrieval, and code diffs to guide the iterative refactoring. Our findings show that the main reasons for failure are context misunderstanding/hallucination (24.3%), incorrect or inconsistent renaming (15.3%), adding new functionality or variables (13.7%), code incompleteness (11.3%), syntax and structural errors (9.7%), edge cases not handled (9%), improper type handling (8.7%), and variables outside scope (8%). To make our approach cost-effective, RefactorAssist first applies a static repair step for missing imports, unbalanced brackets, and compilation errors without LLMs. For remaining failures, RefactorAssist incorporates error logs and code diffs, achieving up to a 70.8% repair rate on the remaining failures and a 94.2% cumulative pass rate under the best-performing configuration. These results indicate that static checks and test-guided, context-aware agentic repair can increase the reliability of LLM-generated refactorings, bringing them closer to practical integration within developer workflows.

</details>


### [664] [Claim Plane: Reliability Gains and the Limits of Selective Concurrency for Parallel Coding Agents: A 30-Pair, Three-Seed Confirmatory Study of Deterministic Pre-Write Admission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00947)
*Maxim Nikolaev*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文报告了对Claim Plane这一确定性预写准入机制的验证性研究。基于30对CooperBench冻结特征对、3个编码器种子、4个协调臂和360次完整执行，静态Claim Plane将配对通过率从23.3%提升至50.0%，集成成功率从65.6%提升至96.7%。但静态准入序列化了96.7%的执行（含93.3%的干净案例），其可靠性提升主要来自退回串行执行。动态准入更选择性（仅序列化66.7%冲突和13.3%干净案例），但46/90执行因未声明范围而失败关闭，配对通过率降至22.2%。研究支持预写准入作为可靠性机制，但未建立有用的墙钟并行加速，因为提供商调用物理上顺序执行且保守策略基本序列化了工作负载。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行编码智能体可能产生局部正确但组合时失败的变更。论文旨在解决这一失效模式，并验证Claim Plane作为确定性预写准入机制的有效性。

Method: 使用30对冻结的CooperBench特征对（15冲突、15干净），3个编码器种子、4个协调臂、360次执行。DeepSeek V4 Pro生成60个特征级规划声明（冻结），DeepSeek V4 Flash执行编码。对比无约束并行、静态Claim Plane和动态准入三种方案。

Result: 静态Claim Plane将配对通过率从23.3%提升至50.0%（+26.7个百分点，95%引导CI 9.6-60.0），集成成功率从65.6%提升至96.7%。冲突标签对的配对通过率从6.7%提升至60.0%。但静态准入序列化了96.7%执行，动态准入更选择性但46/90执行失败关闭，配对通过率降至22.2%。45/46阻塞针对已冻结声明中的文件，表明区域覆盖不足和修改处理不充分。

Conclusion: 预写准入可作为可靠性机制，但当前实现未能建立有用的墙钟并行加速：提供商调用物理顺序执行，保守策略基本序列化工作量。研究工件、哈希和聚类引导分析已公开供复现。

Abstract: Parallel coding agents can produce locally valid changes that fail when combined. Claim Plane addresses this failure mode as deterministic pre-write admission over versioned change intents. This paper reports a confirmatory study on 30 frozen CooperBench feature pairs, balanced between 15 conflict and 15 clean labels, with three coder seeds, four coordination arms, and 360 completed executions. DeepSeek V4 Pro generated 60 feature-level planner declarations once; the declarations were frozen across all arms and coder seeds, while DeepSeek V4 Flash performed the coding work. Static Claim Plane raised pair pass from 23.3% under unconstrained parallel execution to 50.0%, a paired task-cluster difference of +26.7 percentage points (95% bootstrap CI 9.6 to 60.0), and raised integration success from 65.6% to 96.7%. On conflict-labeled pairs, pair pass rose from 6.7% to 60.0%. However, static admission serialized 96.7% of executions, including 93.3% of clean cases, and therefore recovered reliability largely by collapsing toward serial execution. Dynamic admission was more selective, serializing 66.7% of conflict cases and 13.3% of clean cases, but 46 of 90 executions failed closed on undeclared scope, reducing pair pass to 22.2%. Forty-five of those 46 blocks targeted files already present in the frozen declarations, indicating region undercoverage and insufficient amendment handling rather than wholly unknown files. The results support pre-write admission as a reliability mechanism, but they do not establish useful wall-clock parallel speedup: provider calls were physically sequential, and the conservative policy largely serialized the workload. The complete study artifacts, hashes, and clustered bootstrap analysis are publicly released for reproduction.

</details>


### [665] [AgenTag: Attribution of AI Coding Agents from Behavioral Fingerprints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00966)
*Taher A. Ghaleb*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出AgenTag，一个用于开放世界AI编码代理归因的多模态框架。在包含33,580个AI代理PR和6,618个人类PR的AIDev数据集上，AgenTag通过文本、行为和代码多模态表示，结合监督对比学习实现开放集识别，加权F1达到0.96，并能以AUC 0.84检测未见过的代理。研究发现PR描述和提交信息提供了几乎全部的归因信号，而代码差异贡献甚微，说明AI代理主要通过沟通方式而非代码生成方式被区分，且这些行为指纹在去除自我披露标记后依然存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码代理越来越多地以开发者账户名义创建PR，掩盖了变更的真实作者。可靠的归属对于仓库治理、AI辅助软件开发的实证研究以及衡量AI编码代理的影响至关重要。现有研究仅关注已知代理的闭集识别，开放世界中AI编码代理归因的实际局限性尚未被探索。

Method: 提出AgenTag框架，使用文本、行为和基于代码三种模态表示每个PR；对比传统分类与监督对比学习用于开放集识别和新代理的少样本注册；在包含5个AI代理和人类PR的AIDev数据集上评估。

Result: AgenTag在代理识别上加权F1为0.96（宏F1为0.84），区分AI与人类PR的平衡F1为0.89，检测未见代理的AUC为0.84。PR描述和提交信息提供了几乎全部归因信号，代码差异贡献有限；去除显式自披露标记后指纹仍然存在。

Conclusion: 可靠的AI编码代理归因是可行的，研究阐明了归因准确性与所需信息之间的实际权衡。AI代理主要通过沟通风格而非代码生成来区分，这为理解AI辅助软件开发提供了新的洞见。
